labels.symptom: Opening a very large document runs out of GPU memory and the app hangs while it falls back to drawing on the CPU.
labels.root_cause: The GPU canvas keeps every pixel at full resolution, and the CPU fallback reads the whole document every frame.

labels.symptom: There is no way to install the app with Homebrew.
labels.root_cause: No Homebrew cask or formula is published.

labels.symptom: JPEG 2000 images cannot be opened or saved.
DICOM medical images cannot be opened.
DPX frames cannot be opened or saved.
Exports carry no C2PA Content Credentials, and existing credentials cannot be inspected.
Layer style presets cannot be imported or exported as .asl files.
Automation refuses to run Crop and Straighten Photos.
labels.root_cause: The command is missing from the automation allow-list.

labels.symptom: Shape layers cannot get gradient fills or dashed strokes from the Properties panel.
labels.root_cause: The engine supports these options, but the Properties panel does not expose them.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking on the canvas with the Path Selection tool shows no context menu.
The pencil cursor snaps to the pixel grid, does not hide the system cursor, and shows a square outline for large sizes.
Invert changes the layer's pixels instead of the selected layer mask.
labels.root_cause: Image adjustments are applied to the layer's pixels even when its mask is the selected target.

labels.symptom: Users want support for the GIMP file format.
Users want text that follows a path or fills a shape.
Users want to import add-on styles and actions, not only brushes.
The Healing Brush blurs the area instead of filling it with matching content.
Opening a crafted document with a Color Lookup adjustment crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: An unchecked size calculation on a value read from the file can overflow, pass the length check, and index past the table.

labels.symptom: Customizing the toolbar in the Toolbar dialog does not change the toolbar.
labels.root_cause: The toolbar is drawn from a fixed constant and ignores the saved hidden and order preferences.

labels.symptom: Some toolbar and panel buttons do nothing when clicked.
labels.root_cause: The code throws away the result of the button click and never connects it to a command.

labels.symptom: The Paint Bucket 'All Layers' option has no effect on fills.
labels.root_cause: The option is never passed to the fill command, and the engine has no parameter for it.

labels.symptom: Several View menu toggles change only their checkmark and leave the canvas the same.
labels.root_cause: The view flags are stored in state, but no rendering code reads them.

labels.symptom: Layer masks can't be moved on their own, the Disable menu label never switches to Enable, and filters and copy apply to the layer instead of the selected mask.
labels.root_cause: Many operations ignore which target is selected (mask or layer pixels).

labels.symptom: Custom .act palette files can't be loaded.
The color picker can't sample colors from outside the app window and has no zoom loupe.
Layer groups are always expanded in the Layers panel and can't be collapsed.
Double-clicking text or a text layer with the Move tool doesn't start text editing.
Report with only an image attached and no description.
There is no way to find and install Google Fonts, or download missing fonts, from inside the app.
With the layer mask selected, adjustments such as Invert change the layer's pixels instead of the mask.
labels.root_cause: Clicking the mask thumbnail highlights it but doesn't switch the edit target to the mask.

labels.symptom: There is no clipping mask, and brushes can't be added or edited.
Document tabs can't be pulled out into floating windows, and you can't drag an image from one document into another to make a layer.
Arabic text in UI labels such as layer names shows as empty boxes, and there is no Arabic or right-to-left interface.
labels.root_cause: The egui font definitions have no fallback font that covers Arabic or other non-Latin scripts.

labels.symptom: There is no way to generate images with local Stable Diffusion models.
Working in a document with very many layers crashes with a wgpu validation error instead of falling back to CPU rendering.
labels.root_cause: The uniform buffer size isn't checked against max_buffer_size before the buffer is created and written.

labels.symptom: Clicking a toolbar tool that has a group arrow doesn't open the flyout with the other tools in its group.
A user asks whether a Houdini-style procedural 3D app is planned.
Shortcuts can't be remapped, opening a file from outside starts a second window, dropping preset files does nothing, and cropping leaves stray pixels.
On Windows the pen barrel button doesn't act as a right click, and the arrow cursor stays visible over the brush outline.
labels.root_cause: winit drops Windows Ink PEN_FLAG_BARREL, and the native cursor isn't hidden when the canvas draws its own brush cursor.

labels.symptom: Selecting text with the text tool, including with Ctrl+A, deletes it.
Dropped images always open as new documents, and layers can't be dragged to other documents or to the trash icon.
Open documents can only be shown as tabs, not as floating windows side by side.
Spot colors with different names but the same color values are missing from the swatches list.
labels.root_cause: Spot colors are deduplicated by color value instead of by name.

labels.symptom: Dropping an image onto the window opens a new document instead of adding it as a layer.
HEIC/HEIF images fail to open with an error saying support isn't included in this build.
labels.root_cause: The build doesn't include the HEIF codec.
bug_markers: HEIC/HEIF support isn't included in this build

labels.symptom: Animated WebP files can't be imported with one layer per frame.
Theme choices differ between apps, and the highlight colour doesn't match the title bar.
Images can't be saved or exported as AVIF.
In the web build, a file menu command that should open a file chooser does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The web file-picker service starts AsyncFileDialog asynchronously, and the result is apparently not passed to the Place Embedded action.

labels.symptom: Panel tabs can't be rearranged, pulled out into floating panels, or docked into other panels.
Opening a large document with GPU rendering on makes the app exit silently, with no error dialog.
labels.root_cause: egui-wgpu panics with "Failed to create staging buffer for index data", and the panic is not reported because GUI binaries have no attached stderr or crash dialog.
bug_markers: Failed to create staging buffer for index data

labels.symptom: Each app ships its own copy of the geometry, color, font and render code, so fixes in one app don't reach the others.
labels.root_cause: There is no shared workspace for the base crates.

labels.symptom: Menu transition animations make moving between sub-menus unreliable, and there is no way to turn animations off.
labels.root_cause: The animated menu transition interferes with sub-menu hover navigation, and there is no reduced-motion setting.

labels.symptom: Opening a PSD fails with 'Wrong file type. Must be image or json.'
labels.root_cause: The open path rejects the PSD extension, possibly the drag-and-drop route.
bug_markers: Wrong file type. Must be image or json.

labels.symptom: Vector shape layers in PSD files open empty.
labels.root_cause: PSD vector shape layers are not imported or rasterized.

labels.symptom: iPhone HEIC/HEIF images and Pixelmator files can't be opened.
labels.root_cause: There is no HEIF decoder.

labels.symptom: There is no Perspective Crop tool to straighten skewed photos.
The app can't be installed or updated through winget on Windows.
labels.root_cause: No winget manifest is published for the MSI installer.

labels.symptom: There is no Perspective Crop tool.
A gradient can't be dragged shorter than a minimum length, and the other end point jumps around.
Only a few layer label colors are offered and custom colors can't be set.
Dragging several selected layers onto a group moves only one layer into it.
labels.root_cause: Layer drag-and-drop sends layer.moveTo with only the dragged layer's ID.

labels.symptom: Agents can't find commands and check their parameters from the command list because it has no machine-readable schema.
labels.root_cause: The command registry exposes params only as a prose-like string, with no JSON Schema, description or headless flag.

labels.symptom: On Linux systems with older glibc (such as Rocky 9) the app will not start and reports that GLIBC_2.35 was not found.
labels.root_cause: Release binaries are built on a system with glibc 2.35 or newer and link versioned libm symbols such as hypot.

labels.symptom: Filters on a smart object cannot be reordered, deleted, masked or given a different blend mode.
Files dropped onto the window or passed on the command line always open as new documents; they cannot be added as layers, and there is no single-instance mode.
Dragging a layer with the Move tool freezes for a while and then the layer seems to disappear.
The background eraser leaves patches of background behind after one pass.
Files saved by the app cannot be reopened in Photoshop, which reports a version-related error.
On macOS, pasting an image from the clipboard produces a wrongly scaled or cropped image, possibly with mixed-DPI displays.
labels.root_cause: Clipboard image size/DPI or representation is likely misinterpreted.

labels.symptom: Brush angle set to pen rotation or tilt does not respond to the stylus barrel roll or tilt.
labels.root_cause: Pen rotation/tilt input is not passed to brush shape dynamics.

labels.symptom: On macOS, pen strokes end with large blobs when the stylus is lifted.
labels.root_cause: Pressure value on pen release is likely misread or jumps before stroke end.

labels.symptom: Text layers in PSD files made in Photoshop open as non-editable layers.
labels.root_cause: PSD text layer data is not imported as editable text.

labels.symptom: Images can't be saved or exported as DDS texture files.
The mouse cursor visibly lags behind the pointer, which makes precise work hard.
labels.root_cause: eframe's default wgpu surface config is HIGH_THROUGHPUT, which allows a frame latency of 2 and queues extra frames.

labels.symptom: Content-aware fill gives blurry results and you cannot choose sample areas.
The release pipeline downloads unpinned tools and actions alongside signing secrets.
labels.root_cause: Release workflows use mutable action tags and unpinned, unchecked downloads such as the Trusted Signing client and nfpm.

labels.symptom: Turkish is not offered as a UI language, and Turkish systems fall back to English.
labels.root_cause: There is no Turkish translation catalog and no tr locale mapping.

labels.symptom: The crop area cannot be readjusted once drawn.
Panels cannot be moved freely or arranged into custom workspaces.
On Linux Wayland, scroll bars are not visible.
Layer blend mode and opacity cannot be changed while a free transform is active.
labels.root_cause: The transform tool rejects layer property edits until the transform is committed.
bug_markers: Commit or cancel the transform first

labels.symptom: Blending effect color settings have no eyedropper to pick a color from the image.
The pen tool has no path operations such as combine, subtract, intersect or exclude.
The window flashes constantly as soon as the app opens, here on a high-refresh-rate monitor.
A text layer gets rasterized as soon as you click away from it and can't be edited as text anymore.
Arabic text in UI panels shows as tofu boxes.
labels.root_cause: The bundled UI fonts have no Arabic glyphs and no fallback font.

labels.symptom: No Flathub package is offered, even though Flathub policy now allows AI-assisted apps.
No supported Android or Samsung DeX build is available.
On Windows, maximizing or restoring the window flashes black, hides the auto-hide taskbar, breaks unsnapping and puts the pointer in the wrong place.
labels.root_cause: The maximized state behaves like exclusive fullscreen and the custom title bar doesn't handle the native DWM frame properly.

labels.symptom: On Apple Silicon Macs drawing runs at 10-20 fps and strokes look jagged.
On Linux a Wacom pen tablet gives no input and no cursor, though the mouse works.
Dragging a placed image pauses for about a second before moving smoothly.
labels.root_cause: Semi-transparent resampled edges bypass the opaque preview cache, causing repeated compositing and tile uploads.

labels.symptom: A user asks for a new app that copies Substance 3D.
Text from an imported document becomes bolder and more compressed when you click into it to edit.
labels.root_cause: Imported text properties (size, leading, tracking) are not preserved when the text is re-laid out for editing.

labels.symptom: Brush strokes look harsher and more pixelated than in the reference app.
CMYK values drift after entry (pure cyan becomes C73 M15), and custom swatch palettes cannot be loaded.
Pasting into a selected layer mask creates a new layer instead.
Right-to-left languages are not supported: there is no bidi text, no RTL alignment and no mirrored UI.
labels.root_cause: Text layout and UI assume left-to-right with no bidi handling.

labels.symptom: On Linux the app fails to start with a wgpu device lost or no graphics adapter error, and forcing Vulkan crashes with a font family not bound panic.
labels.root_cause: Adapter selection fails on some Linux setups without falling back to another backend, and the custom 'medium' font family is used before it is registered.

labels.symptom: Persian and Arabic text in the UI (file names, tabs, titles, panels) shows as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: The bundled UI fonts have no Arabic-script glyph coverage and there is no fallback font.

labels.symptom: Pressing Save on an existing file always opens the file picker, as if it were Save As.
labels.root_cause: Save doesn't remember the current file's path.

labels.symptom: On macOS 27 the window's traffic-light buttons use the old flat design instead of Liquid Glass.
labels.root_cause: The app draws its own window controls instead of using the native ones.

labels.symptom: While drawing with the pen tool you can't adjust the last point's handle, and Make Selection from a path has no options.
DDS texture files can't be opened or saved.
The user asks for the separate apps to be merged into one all-in-one app.
Files with upper-case extensions such as .JPG don't show up in the file picker.
labels.root_cause: The file dialog's extension filters are case-sensitive and only list lower-case extensions.

labels.symptom: There is no Android build or touch-friendly mobile interface.
Shapes can't be filled with a gradient.
A locked layer can still be edited.
Opening a file from the file manager starts a new window instead of a new tab in the running instance.
labels.root_cause: No single-instance handling forwards file-open requests to the running instance.

labels.symptom: Palettes, brushes, presets and other resources can't be saved, loaded, copied or pasted.
There are no custom ComfyUI extension nodes for local generative AI models.
Screenshots in the Linux software-store listing are broken.
labels.root_cause: The screenshot URLs in the metainfo templates are broken.

labels.symptom: The installer does not offer to add a desktop shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The installer has no optional desktop-shortcut step.

labels.symptom: Suggestion to rename the apps to one unified, easy-to-remember naming scheme.
The canvas view cannot be rotated (for example with the R key) while drawing.
Documents cannot be saved in Affinity .af format.
labels.root_cause: No Affinity container or object-stream writer exists, and there is no way to validate output in Affinity.

labels.symptom: Opening Affinity documents drops or simplifies effects, adjustments, brushes, master pages, special shapes and other features.
labels.root_cause: The native Affinity importer does not yet map these record types.

labels.symptom: Empty issue with no content.
Thank-you note, not a bug.
Printing offers no custom paper size or access to the printer's own setup dialog for paper type, quality and duplex.
A page embedding the web build cannot hand it a document or receive the edited document back; saving always triggers a browser download.
labels.root_cause: The web build has no JavaScript embedding API for opening bytes, returning saved bytes, or reporting changes.

labels.symptom: In the web build, Chinese, Japanese and Korean text renders as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: The wasm build has no system fonts and embeds no CJK fonts because of the wasm size limit.

labels.symptom: On Linux the headless CLI is only available inside the large desktop package.
MCP tools return only images and JSON, with no interactive preview view.
Painting lags with a large, soft brush.
Backspace or Delete does not delete the selected item and cannot be assigned as a shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut editor does not accept the Backspace key.

labels.symptom: On an older Mac with dual AMD/Intel graphics a side panel renders as raw text instead of its normal widgets, and an error report appears on exit.
Smooth antialiased text on a dark background has different edge brightness than expected with default color settings.
labels.root_cause: The default text blend gamma (1.45) is applied during smooth text rasterization, changing glyph edge brightness.

labels.symptom: Headless automation uses many times the image size in memory and gets killed under sandbox memory limits.
labels.root_cause: Not profiled; extra full-resolution copies for undo, adjustments and export are suspected.

labels.symptom: The browser build has no official hosted URL, so users must download and serve it themselves.
On Windows inside VMware virtual machines the window stays completely black.
The browser build has no official hosted URL, so users must download and serve it themselves.
Heavy operations use only one CPU thread and the app hangs on large images.
labels.root_cause: Heavy computations are not parallelized.

labels.symptom: Brushes using bristle, erodible or airbrush tips do not work.
labels.root_cause: 3D-based brush tip types are not implemented in the brush engine.

labels.symptom: The app does not start on Windows 7 or Windows 8.x.
There is no option to turn off anti-aliasing for brushes and the fill tool.
Clicking the delete button on a layer does not remove the layer.
No color can be selected when using the color plating feature.
Arabic text in UI lists such as layer names shows as empty tofu boxes, and existing Arabic text breaks when edited.
labels.root_cause: The UI fonts have no fallback that covers Arabic glyphs.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app closes without warning under heavy disk and CPU load, and on the next launch it shows no sign of the crash.
labels.root_cause: Probably resource exhaustion that isn't handled, and no crash detection or recovery runs on the next launch.

labels.symptom: Setting up frequency separation for retouching takes several manual steps instead of one command.
After a lasso selection, the move tool moves the whole layer instead of only the selected pixels.
Pasting a large image into a small document splits it into several cropped layers and gives no clear way to resize it.
Discord promotion buttons appear prominently on the start screen, in the title bar and in the About dialog.
labels.root_cause: The Discord button is placed in the primary UI chrome.

labels.symptom: Selecting by colour range does nothing.
Pull requests get no automated code review.
Several open pull requests conflict with each other and fail to compile when merged together.
Grain is only available as a destructive filter, not as an adjustment layer.
There is no Remove tool to paint over an object and fill the area from its surroundings.
The Healing Brush stops responding after switching to another tool and back.
labels.root_cause: Possibly drag or clone-source state is not reset when the tool changes.

labels.symptom: Selection modify dialogs don't show a live preview on the canvas.
Right-clicking a panel tab doesn't open a menu to close it.
Camera Raw is only available as a destructive filter, not as an adjustment layer.
The Path Blur path can't be drawn or shaped on the canvas.
Preferences have no setting for the LUT and Actions folder locations.
At some zoom levels, retouch brushes change a larger area than the cursor outline shows.
labels.root_cause: Probably the retouch tools' padding or blend spread, or display scaling.

labels.symptom: Color Lookup adjustment layers in an imported large document open turned off with no warning.
labels.root_cause: A LUT parse failure becomes an unsupported adjustment without a warning, and oversized LUTs are dropped silently.

labels.symptom: There is no built-in way to record steps, timings, logs and screenshots for a bug report.
Action (.atn) and pattern (.pat) files from other sources can't be loaded.
In a VMware Windows virtual machine the window is black unless maximized.
Resizing the Save As dialog window makes the app crash immediately.
Zooming in above 3200% zooms out instead.
labels.root_cause: The zoom step table stops at 32x while the maximum zoom is 64x, and the fallback returns 32x.

labels.symptom: Tool and panel windows cannot be detached into floating windows.
On macOS the unsaved-changes prompt shows key letters in its button labels and does not look like the native alert.
labels.root_cause: Key letters added for keyboard answers are shown in the labels on every platform.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland, the window and taskbar show the generic Wayland icon instead of the app icon.
labels.root_cause: The app id or desktop file does not match, so the compositor cannot find the icon.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland, dragging and dropping files into the window does nothing.
There is no way to update the app from inside it.
labels.root_cause: No built-in updater.

labels.symptom: Fujifilm RAF raw images cannot be opened.
On older Intel Macs running a patched macOS, the app bounces in the Dock and quits without showing a window.
labels.root_cause: The wgpu device request fails with Device(Lost) on legacy Metal GPUs.

labels.symptom: Color Range selection only picks colors from the small preview, not the canvas, and the selected area isn't shown.
User asks for a clone of Clip Studio Paint.
A percentage-based grid on a non-square canvas draws square cells instead of following the canvas height.
labels.root_cause: Vertical grid spacing is computed from the width percentage instead of the height.

labels.symptom: On an Intel MacBook an error appears the first time the app is opened.
An external GPU isn't detected unless set by hand, and when it is used, drawing is laggy.
labels.root_cause: There is no way to choose the GPU, so the wgpu adapter selection ignores the eGPU.

labels.symptom: Request to move the UI framework from egui to gpui.
Mouse clicks land in the wrong place or don't register in the window.
There is no panel for browsing texture overlays and applying them as layers.
On Wayland, dragging files onto the window does nothing.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 doesn't support Wayland drag-and-drop, and xwayland-satellite doesn't bridge drag-and-drop between Wayland and X11 apps.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app fails to start with an access-denied error for VCRUNTIME140.dll.
Changing the font of selected text makes memory grow until the app crashes, and Thai text renders wrongly in newly applied fonts.
labels.root_cause: Font loading appears to leak memory, and Thai complex-script shaping is incomplete.

labels.symptom: A menu item copies a 'Legacy' label from the original product even though the app has no older version of the feature.
Tracking issue for bringing the crop tool up to feature parity.
Floating dialog windows can only be dragged from a very small area of the title bar.
labels.root_cause: The drag hit area of floating windows is too small.

labels.symptom: Dialogs cannot be moved outside the main window.
labels.root_cause: Dialogs are drawn as egui windows inside the main viewport, not as separate OS windows.

labels.symptom: There is no option to make stroke corners sharp instead of rounded.
Light stylus taps paint at full pressure instead of following pressure sensitivity.
labels.root_cause: Tap events probably arrive without pressure data and default to full pressure.

labels.symptom: Recorded actions do not play back, cannot be saved or loaded, and Alt/Ctrl layer modifiers do nothing.
In a Windows virtual machine the app opens only a black window.
labels.root_cause: Probably GPU adapter or backend selection fails on virtual GPUs.

labels.symptom: Gradient Overlay ignores the Smooth interpolation method and renders opacity ramps as Classic.
labels.root_cause: The gradient interpolation method (gs99) is ignored for opacity stops.

labels.symptom: An embedding app cannot hide the dock icon rail or the in-window menu bar.
labels.root_cause: The panel state has no flags for the rail and the menu bar.

labels.symptom: Gradient maps need draggable stops, a saved library and interpolation methods.
User asks which command-line invocation removes a portrait background without altering the subject.
On Windows with AMD graphics the app crashes on startup with an access violation inside the AMD OpenGL driver.
labels.root_cause: Startup uses an OpenGL path that crashes inside the AMD driver (atio6axx.dll).

labels.symptom: There is no tool to rotate the canvas view without changing the image.
A stylus right-click acts as a left-click and paints, instead of opening the context menu.
labels.root_cause: The pen's barrel-button right-click is not recognised as a secondary click.

labels.symptom: Fast inertial touchpad scrolling is throttled and choppy, so the view barely moves.
labels.root_cause: Smooth-scrolling animation throttles fast trackpad scroll input and cannot be turned off.

labels.symptom: On older Intel Macs with two GPUs the app crashes on startup with a GPU device lost error instead of falling back to the CPU.
labels.root_cause: wgpu device creation fails with Device(Lost) on the Metal backend, and the error is fatal instead of triggering the CPU fallback.

labels.symptom: Painting with the brush tool lags badly.
There is no option to run generative expand and generative fill locally.
There's no infinite canvas or infinite zoom option.
Images can't be saved as PSD, and saving a photo appears to fail.
A user disputes the project's claim to be clean-room code because an LLM is the main contributor.
Brush folders can't be dragged into other folders to nest them.
On older Intel GPUs the app crashes when an image is opened, with the error 'Rgba32Float is not renderable'.
labels.root_cause: A render pipeline targets Rgba32Float without checking that the adapter can render to it and without falling back to another format.

labels.symptom: The tool panel can't be resized to make it wider.
There is no GitHub wiki documenting the code and how to use the tool.
The New Document dialog doesn't default to the size of the image on the clipboard.
Double-clicking inside the crop area doesn't apply the crop.
Pasting while a layer mask is selected creates a new layer instead of pasting into the mask.
The gradient map adjustment has no color picker and no way to paste a hex code.
On Windows, pen pressure lags and then jumps in steps instead of changing smoothly along a stroke.
Canon CR2 raw files open with the wrong colours.
Brush strokes lag behind the mouse and look like they glide.
Dropdown menus cannot be changed with the mouse wheel or arrow keys without opening them.
Nikon NEF raw files open as a small embedded JPEG preview instead of the full raw data.
labels.root_cause: No NEF raw decoder; falls back to the embedded preview.

labels.symptom: Stacking focus-bracketed images does not produce a depth map that Lens Blur could use.
On macOS you cannot use the system color picker to choose colors.
Creating a new document freezes the app and Windows shows 'Not Responding'.
Clicking the eye icon next to a layer effect in the Layers panel does not turn the effect off or on.
Text in single-line input boxes sits too low instead of being centred vertically, while dropdowns look right.
A PSD with a hidden background layer opens with the background visible and smart objects drawn wrong.
Moving a layer, changing its properties, or undoing redraws the whole document and feels slow.
labels.root_cause: Session::edit and undo/redo set last_damage to None, so everything is recomposited.

labels.symptom: Context menus are cut off at the edge of the window and can't be scrolled, so some options can't be reached.
labels.root_cause: Popup menus are confined to the app window and have no scrolling.

labels.symptom: Contributors can't easily tell which documents to read for a task or where to report performance measurements.
The contributing docs don't say how PRs should report which revision checks ran on, which checks didn't run, and open decisions.
In the web build on Android Chrome, menus and dropdowns open once and then only show a hover highlight when tapped.
Long operations freeze the window and cannot be cancelled.
labels.root_cause: Every long operation runs synchronously on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: Feathering, Content-Aware Scale, Select Subject and Liquify are very slow on large images.
labels.root_cause: The algorithms are naive, single-threaded and recompute results on every call.

labels.symptom: The Discord link in the README leads to an error page.
labels.root_cause: The invite link in the README is invalid or has expired.

labels.symptom: Working with very large content crashes instead of showing an out-of-memory error.
labels.root_cause: Allocations that cannot fail abort the process, and the panic guard cannot catch that.

labels.symptom: Desktop theming tools can't supply custom colors from a theme file; only built-in themes are available.
labels.root_cause: Loading a theme from a JSON file only works in debug builds.

labels.symptom: Copy and paste ignore the active channel, mask or quick mask, so they create new layers or paste stale content.
labels.root_cause: Clipboard operations are not aware of channel or mask editing context.

labels.symptom: On macOS a crash report appears every time the app is closed.
The swap foreground/background colors button is not in the top-right spot where Photoshop users expect it.
Several painting and retouching tools are missing, and most brush tools only apply when the mouse is released.
User asks for a free AutoCAD alternative.
The installer finishes so quickly with no confirmation that users can't tell whether the app was installed.
labels.root_cause: The installer runs without UI and shows no completion message.

labels.symptom: On Windows the installer closes right away with no setup wizard or choice of install folder, but installs silently to Program Files.
labels.root_cause: The MSI installer is built without a UI sequence, so it runs as a silent per-machine install.

labels.symptom: User asks for a brush engine and drawing feel like Clip Studio Paint.
Fast brush strokes with smoothing turn curves into straight segments with visible corners.
labels.root_cause: Brush stroke points are joined with straight lines instead of smooth curves.

labels.symptom: Selection, transform and drawing tools are missing several behaviours.
Menu and UI text looks blurry on Windows compared with native apps.
labels.root_cause: UI text is drawn with grayscale antialiasing instead of subpixel or native system text rendering.

labels.symptom: Discussion of whether reimplementing the interface is legal.
The color picker in layer styles has a mode that does nothing and no buttons to confirm or close it.
labels.root_cause: Layer styles use their own color picker instead of the shared one.

labels.symptom: Gradients are limited to two colors, with no multi-stop gradient editor.
Small icons look blurry because they don't line up with the pixel grid.
labels.root_cause: Icons are drawn at positions that are not snapped to whole pixels.

labels.symptom: Brush edges and falloff look ragged, and strokes come out thinner than expected.
Smart Objects and Smart Filters are flattened or dropped when a PSD is saved or opened.
labels.root_cause: PSD export writes Smart Objects as flat pixels and import throws away Smart Filters.

labels.symptom: Typing a very long string into a text field fills video memory, which is not freed, and makes the frame rate drop sharply.

labels.symptom: File compatibility tests only run on machines that have the corpus files and do not cover several formats.

labels.symptom: There is no type on a path, no paragraph direction control, no variable font sliders, no OpenType feature UI and no manual kerning.

labels.symptom: Stereo images (MPO, JPS, PNG sTER) open with only one eye or as a flat packed image, and cannot be saved back in stereo formats.

labels.symptom: Some menus have uneven padding and different hover colors, and highlighted items show gray text on light blue that is hard to read.

labels.symptom: Recorded actions replay against the wrong layer in another document, and batch and plug-in options are limited.

labels.symptom: The gradient editor is missing the classic editor dialog, the preset library and number fields.

Running the local test suite is slow because of long linking and test binaries running one after another.

labels.symptom: With the UI set to Simplified Chinese, interface text does not display correctly.

labels.symptom: Nowhere shows measured, up-to-date numbers for performance, tools, compatibility and features.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+S always opens a save dialog instead of saving over the open file.

labels.symptom: On macOS a color space warning dialog covers the tool area at startup and cannot be closed.

Discussion of upcoming upstream features and AI integration priorities.

labels.symptom: There is no editor for viewing, searching or customizing keyboard shortcuts.

labels.symptom: There is no dedicated drawing workspace that keeps brush, color and layer panels visible.

labels.symptom: Pasting an image creates two or three copies instead of one.

On Windows the interface drops frames heavily and feels choppy.
On Windows 7 the 32-bit build shows an error and does not open.

Text drop shadows look blocky, oversized, clipped to a box and streaky.
There are no optional downloadable local AI models for image editing features.
There is no in-app update check or automatic update on startup.
Passing the automation read-root flag more than once silently keeps only the last folder.

labels.symptom: Slice tools and Save for Web don't show clear slice boundaries, automatic slices or numbering the way the reference app does.
Some installed Japanese fonts don't appear in the font list.
Theme colours taken from LGPL desktop stylesheets have no attribution row or licence file, which may break the permissive-asset rule.

labels.symptom: On old Intel integrated graphics the window opens like a fullscreen app, the screen goes black for a moment on open and close, and hovering over buttons causes one-frame glitches.
A layer can't be found and always stays at the bottom of the stack.
Copying a fill or gradient layer fails with 'the active layer has no pixels' because only pixels can be copied, not whole layers.
After a layer is deleted, the selection jumps to the top layer instead of the layer next to it.
The Save for Web dialog shows a transparent background and opens in 2-Up view instead of Optimized.
Holding Option+Shift while transforming doesn't scale uniformly from the center the way it does in the reference app.
Pressing F2 does not rename a file.
The paint bucket is hidden behind the gradient tool instead of being the default tool in that group.
In the font dropdown you can't move through fonts with the arrow keys, and there is no preview of each font.
New Document doesn't default to the size of the image on the clipboard.
Saved images show a stale thumbnail of the original image instead of the edited one.

labels.symptom: There is no in-app update button or auto-update, so users have to download new releases by hand.

Newly installed fonts don't show up until the app is restarted.
labels.root_cause: The system font list is only loaded once, at startup.

labels.symptom: Users can't tell which download website is official and which ones are fake.
Some large JPG images look ghosted and duplicated on the canvas, as if motion-blurred.
On Intel Macs, raw display color profile data appears as a long text block in a side panel and in Color Settings, covering the tool panels.
labels.root_cause: The raw ICC profile data is shown as the profile name instead of a short description.

labels.symptom: On Windows no hardware GPU is detected, so the app falls back to the Microsoft Basic Render Driver and software rendering.
Web export has no WebP or AVIF option and no quality slider.
Several contributors open competing PRs for the same issue.
labels.root_cause: AGENTS.md has no step telling agents to check whether an issue is already claimed.

labels.symptom: On Intel HD Graphics a black line appears along the top of the window.
An imported layer sometimes does not appear until another layer is clicked.
Free transform shows no apply or cancel buttons in the options bar.
Menus become extremely slow when a document has thousands of layers.
labels.root_cause: Every menu item checks all layers to decide whether it is enabled, on every animated frame.

labels.symptom: A touchpad pinch gesture scrolls the view instead of zooming.
labels.root_cause: Pinch zoom input is handled as a scroll when wheel zoom is turned off.

labels.symptom: Smart objects in files saved by Photoshop CS2 can't be opened and show 'contents are unavailable'.
A saved PSD fails to open in Photoshop with a program error.
Copying and pasting several selected layers pastes only the last selected layer.
Floating document windows can't be edited and stay duplicated as maximized tabs, so you can't work on two images side by side.
The mouse wheel scrolls the canvas instead of zooming it as the original app does.
The CLI MCP bridge and serve commands ignore the control port environment variable and silently start a headless session instead of connecting to the running app.
labels.root_cause: The CLI mcp and serve subcommands only read the port from explicit flags, not from the CONTROL_PORT environment variable.

labels.symptom: On Wayland, automation control requests time out while the display is asleep or the window is fully covered, even though the app is healthy.
labels.root_cause: Control requests are drained inside the egui frame update, which stops running when the compositor stops sending frame callbacks.

labels.symptom: Shape tools are missing many options, and toolbar settings don't apply to the shape just drawn.
Painting on a mask lags badly, and presets and actions cannot be imported.
UI fixes must be ported separately to each app and the apps drift apart in UX.
labels.root_cause: Each app has its own duplicated ui-egui crate.

labels.symptom: In full screen mode a taskbar glitch artifact stays visible until leaving full screen.
The web version shows only a fully black screen.
No luminosity masking to select dark tones, midtones or highlights.
On macOS, choosing the text tool freezes the whole app for over a minute.
On Linux with no usable GPU adapter the app exits at startup with 'no graphics adapter found' instead of falling back to software rendering.
labels.root_cause: GPU startup plans a CPU backend but wgpu adapter selection still fails with no software adapter fallback.

labels.symptom: Non-destructive smart objects and embedded documents are not supported.
There is no setting to pick the interface language, so the UI always follows the system language.
labels.root_cause: The language picker described in the docs is missing from preferences.

labels.symptom: Custom ABR brushes picked for the eraser or blur tool carry over into the brush tool.
On Linux Wayland desktops, pasting a copied image says the clipboard holds no image.
There is an extra gap above the top ruler that the left ruler doesn't have.
On macOS the window's traffic-light controls are out of line with the title bar.
Creating a new group does not automatically put the selected layers into it.
The brush cursor outline stays a round circle even for brushes with a custom tip shape.
labels.root_cause: The cursor preview ignores the brush tip shape.

labels.symptom: The mouse cursor visibly lags behind the physical mouse when over the canvas on Linux Wayland with NVIDIA.
labels.root_cause: Probably the canvas draws its own cursor tied to frame presentation latency.

labels.symptom: The Group button creates an empty group instead of grouping the selected layers, and text sometimes disappears when a shape is scaled.
The color picker has no HSB sliders.
Duplicating a smart object layer makes an independent copy instead of a linked instance.
labels.root_cause: Layer duplication deep-copies the smart object's source instead of sharing it.

labels.symptom: Automation preview fails with 'automation preview source exceeds 67108864 pixels' for large print-size documents.
labels.root_cause: The preview source budget is checked against the whole canvas, and there is no option to render only a region.

labels.symptom: Headless automation previews of very large documents are refused because of a fixed pixel limit.
labels.root_cause: MAX_RENDER_SOURCE_PIXELS is a hard-coded 64 Mi pixel limit.

labels.symptom: There is no color wheel panel with color harmony modes.
Image adjustments can't be applied to smart objects, and smart filters brought in from Photoshop have no effect.
Copying and pasting a layer crops away its transparent area, so pasted pieces lose their alignment.
There is an empty vertical gap between the document tab bar and the top ruler.
labels.root_cause: egui's default item_spacing.y is applied between the tab strip and the ruler.

labels.symptom: On Windows, toolbar buttons only respond to a click after the pointer has hovered over them, and there is a blank offset along the top and left edges of the window.
labels.root_cause: Possibly a window coordinate or hit-testing offset that was introduced after 0.3.0.

labels.symptom: Several selected layers can't be converted into one smart object.
On Linux the app draws its own window controls, which don't match the system and can't be turned off for tiling window managers.
labels.root_cause: The app uses client-side decorations instead of the system's server-side decorations.

labels.symptom: The Liquify tool moves blocks of pixels instead of smoothly warping the image.
Drawing with a very large brush is very laggy.
On Linux Wayland, a pen tablet moves the cursor but never clicks inside the window, whether through Xwayland or native Wayland.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 doesn't bind zwp_tablet_v2, and pen clicks routed through Xwayland never reach the window.

labels.symptom: On Windows, images copied to the clipboard by other programs aren't recognized, or are pasted with a black background instead of transparency.
labels.root_cause: Clipboard image reading on Windows doesn't handle every clipboard format or its alpha channel.
bug_markers: Nothing to paste: the clipboard holds no image

labels.symptom: Legacy 32-bit .8BF filter plugins can't be used.
There is no auto-update, so you have to download each new version by hand from GitHub.
labels.root_cause: No built-in update mechanism.

labels.symptom: There is no Refine Hair option, and selections around hair are poor.
Holding Z for a temporary zoom does not show a magnifier cursor or switch back to the previous tool when Z is released.
Copying a single colour channel puts all RGB channels on the clipboard.
Request for local Stable Diffusion/ComfyUI backends for generative editing.
On old Intel integrated graphics the window flashes black, shows rendering glitches on hover, and CPU rendering runs at about 5 fps.
CI cache exceeds the 10 GB limit so the nightly job's cache is always evicted.
labels.root_cause: rust-cache saves a new generation on every Cargo.lock change and old ones are never deleted.

labels.symptom: The Linux RPM package fails to install on Fedora with an rpm transaction error.
On Windows, print jobs never reach the printer, the printer must be typed in by hand, and there's no driver settings dialog or installed ICC profile list.
labels.root_cause: Printing has no Windows spooler integration and relies on CUPS 'lp'.

labels.symptom: A plain click on the canvas selects the layer under the cursor instead of needing Cmd+click.
There is no floating contextual taskbar near selections and text layers.
Imported .abr brushes paint differently from the original.
Nikon NEF raw files open nearly grayscale and desaturated.
Photoshop can't open a PSD/PSB re-saved from a complex imported PSB, even with no changes.
Tracking issue for brush tool parity, covering smoothing, falloff, pressure and shortcuts.
Printing fails with a CUPS 'lp' error on Flatpak, Windows, or Linux without a default printer, and a temp PDF is left behind.
labels.root_cause: Printing spawns the Unix 'lp' command without checking for printers or the platform, so it fails in sandboxes and on Windows.

labels.symptom: Switching between light and dark appearance changes the interface layout and which controls are visible, not just the colors.
labels.root_cause: Visual themes are coupled with UI layout and feature presentation.

labels.symptom: The gradient tool edits the existing gradient layer instead of creating a new one when a gradient layer is selected.
Using the color dodge blend mode on stacked gradient layers shows fringed colours and noise in high-contrast areas.
With a pen tablet the brush and clicks land a few pixels below the pen tip, while the mouse works correctly.
With the Adwaita theme the Properties panel disappears and only comes back after switching themes.
Arabic text in the interface shows as empty squares, and panels cannot be dragged and docked freely.
labels.root_cause: The UI fonts have no Arabic glyphs or fallback font.

labels.symptom: Opening a second file replaces the open document instead of opening it alongside.
labels.root_cause: The app supports only one open document at a time.

labels.symptom: An image jumps position and a cut-out piece disappears when dropped onto another image.
There is no Photo Restoration filter to repair scratches and stains on scanned prints.
Select Subject, Object Selection and Remove Background produce poor masks on hair, fur and low-contrast edges.
labels.root_cause: Selection uses heuristics instead of an ML segmentation model.

labels.symptom: JPEG XL (.jxl) images cannot be opened.
labels.root_cause: The codec layer has no JPEG XL decoder or format variant.
bug_markers: AVIF decoding and JPEG XL are unavailable

labels.symptom: There is no filter that colorizes and modernizes an old photo using a local model.
GIMP .xcf files can't be opened.
Animated GIFs can't be imported with all their frames, and there is no AI background removal.
Automation scripts can't place or export files inside the allowed root folders because those commands are disabled and have no scoped replacement.
labels.root_cause: Commands that use ambient filesystem paths are blocked, and no capability-scoped equivalents exist.
bug_markers: uses ambient filesystem paths and is disabled

labels.symptom: There are no control-point local adjustment tools for targeted retouching.
Clone Stamp darkens the target area while painting but copies no pixels from the source.
The Open As dialog only lets you scale by percentage, not enter pixel dimensions.
Panels can't be freely docked, regrouped, or popped out into floating windows.
labels.root_cause: The panel layout only supports fixed preset groupings with no free docking or floating.

labels.symptom: PDF files cannot be imported as images.
The move tool cannot move only the selected pixels.
On Windows with older Intel graphics using OpenGL, the window frame is black and the interface is shifted.
The font dropdown does not show recently used fonts at the top.
There is no light version of the Pro theme, and switching theme changes the panel layout and hides the Properties panel.
The font picker shows no preview of each typeface and no recently used fonts.
The launcher cannot select several apps and install them in one step.
Levels and Curves adjustment layers lack an Auto Options button.
AI agents can drive the app but cannot point at UI, demonstrate slowly, wait for the user and check their work.
Curves and Levels adjustment layers have no Auto Options.
The desktop app has no guided setup that finds the CLI and produces a working MCP configuration for an agent client.
labels.root_cause: Installing the desktop app and configuring an agent are separate manual steps with no in-app help.

labels.symptom: Desktop installs give no documented, reliable way to run the bundled CLI from scripts or agents without relying on PATH.
labels.root_cause: Each platform's package handles the CLI differently, and macOS ships it as a separate download.

labels.symptom: The AppImage rewrites its desktop shortcut on every launch, which wipes out the user's custom environment variables and options.
labels.root_cause: AppImage desktop integration always overwrites the .desktop file without checking whether one already exists.

labels.symptom: On older Intel Macs with Iris Pro graphics running Monterey, the app quits at launch before any window opens, even in safe GPU mode.
labels.root_cause: The Metal shader compiler hits an internal error, so the wgpu device is lost during request_device and there is no fallback.

labels.symptom: The opacity stops in the gradient editor do nothing.
Opening a received document can make the app read arbitrary files through linked embedded sources.
labels.root_cause: Linked source paths are resolved through the general file reader rather than a capability-scoped one.

labels.symptom: Layer masks cannot be copied or pasted between layers or documents.
Opening a document that declares a huge canvas can exhaust GPU memory.
labels.root_cause: The declared canvas size reaches GPU texture creation without an aggregate byte budget.

labels.symptom: Opening a document that declares a huge canvas can use unbounded CPU and memory.
labels.root_cause: The native loader does not check the manifest canvas size against a resource budget before CPU reduction.

labels.symptom: The Windows release signing client is downloaded unpinned and loaded without verification.
labels.root_cause: sign.ps1 fetches Microsoft.Trusted.Signing.Client from an unversioned NuGet URL with no digest or signature check.

labels.symptom: The Linux AppImage build downloads and runs appimagetool without checking its integrity.
labels.root_cause: package.sh downloads the continuous appimagetool release and runs it without verifying a digest or signature.

labels.symptom: Decoding a large PNM image can allocate more memory than the configured limit allows.
labels.root_cause: The PNM decoder's intermediate Vec<u32> buffer is not counted against max_alloc.

labels.symptom: The release workflow uses third-party actions referenced by tags that can change, not by fixed commits.
labels.root_cause: The release.yml workflow references actions by tag rather than by commit SHA.

labels.symptom: The color picker has no configurable modes.
Upscaling by 2x to 4x looks soft and rings because there is no AI upscaler.
There is no AI denoise or JPEG artifact removal filter.
There is no neural style transfer filter.
A misspelled canvas-size anchor silently resizes with an unexpected anchor instead of the default center.
labels.root_cause: The anchor parser handles each axis separately with different case rules instead of validating against the nine named anchors.

labels.symptom: The ruler zero point cannot be dragged to a new position or reset.
The Gradient Map editor has no movable colour stops like the gradient tool has.
There are no options to flip horizontally or vertically.
The History panel lacks snapshots, a panel menu, History Options and automation commands.
A radial gradient cannot be squished or stretched into an oval.
Pasting clipboard text into a text box while editing does nothing.
Stroke Path supports only a few tools and has no Simulate Pressure option.
Variable fonts show no axis sliders, and optical size does not follow the type size.
labels.root_cause: The Character panel has no UI for variation axes, opsz is not set automatically, and choosing a named instance does not reset the axes.

labels.symptom: A meta ticket lists open issues that are already fixed, duplicates, or expected behaviour so they can be closed.
A test run intermittently reports a command as hung because the first system font scan takes too long.
labels.root_cause: A one-time lazy font scan on the first text command goes over the per-command test timeout.

labels.symptom: Select and Mask cannot send its output to a new document.
Saving and reopening a document loses all but the current frame of a video layer.
labels.root_cause: Video layer frames are not saved in the document file.

labels.symptom: Animated GIFs with varied frame delays play and export at the wrong speed.
labels.root_cause: The timeline has a single frame rate and no per-frame duration.

labels.symptom: The Save for Web preview shows a still frame instead of playing the animation.
Warping live type fails on commit instead of offering to rasterize it first.
labels.root_cause: No rasterize prompt is wired up for Warp on type layers.

labels.symptom: Warp, Distort and Perspective on shape layers can be edited but fail on commit.
labels.root_cause: The engine refuses non-affine transforms on live shapes instead of transforming their paths.

labels.symptom: A modifier-drag of a Free Transform corner distorts editable type, then the commit fails and the transform is lost.
labels.root_cause: The corner-drag code ignores the layer kind and allows a non-affine box on type layers.

labels.symptom: Some labels in generated dialogs stay in English when another UI language is selected.
labels.root_cause: Translations are missing for the dynamic parameter labels of some generated dialogs, and no test checks them.

labels.symptom: The app freezes, sometimes for over a minute, the first time a text tool or font picker is opened.
labels.root_cause: The system font scan runs lazily on the UI thread on first use instead of in the background.

labels.symptom: Many additional image formats cannot be opened.
Distort and Perspective drags on a path in Free Transform are lost when committed.
labels.root_cause: path.transform only takes an affine matrix, so the projective quad is rejected.
bug_markers: can't be applied to a path

labels.symptom: A Gradient Map adjustment layer from a PSD file looks different than it does in Photoshop.
Selections made with the Single Row or Single Column Marquee show up in History as Rectangular Marquee.
labels.root_cause: select.rect picks the history step name only from the ellipse flag.

labels.symptom: The Artboard tool has no '+' buttons for adding an adjacent board, and Shift does not keep proportions while resizing.
The app inside the macOS release dmg fails strict codesign verification because of Finder information detritus.
labels.root_cause: Empty com.apple.FinderInfo extended attributes on bundle resources are not removed before signing.

labels.symptom: Type Mask always replaces the selection (Shift/Alt modifiers are ignored), and the hidden working layer shows in the Layers panel.
labels.root_cause: The tools never pass the operation parameter to type.createSelection.

labels.symptom: Saving an export copy takes several dialog steps; users want a one-click quick save.
Exporting an indexed-color image to PNG drops its print resolution, so it reopens at 72 ppi.
labels.root_cause: The indexed PNG export path does not write the pHYs resolution chunk.

labels.symptom: Opening an OpenRaster file removes leading and trailing spaces from layer and group names.
labels.root_cause: The ORA reader trims whitespace from name attributes.

labels.symptom: An adjustment layer in Dissolve mode exports as uniform gray instead of scattered pixels.
labels.root_cause: The adjustment layer composite path ignores Dissolve and blends as Normal.

labels.symptom: Adding a layer style to a Dissolve layer turns its scattered coverage into uniform gray.
labels.root_cause: The layer style composite path ignores Dissolve and blends as Normal.

labels.symptom: A clipped Dissolve fill layer exports as uniform gray instead of scattered pixels.
labels.root_cause: The clipping composite path ignores Dissolve and blends as Normal.

labels.symptom: Gradients with stops very close together render differently on the GPU than on the CPU.
labels.root_cause: The GPU lookup-table gradient arithmetic cannot resolve close distinct stops, and the coincident-stop fallback does not catch them.

labels.symptom: CLI batch fails on recorded zoom, fit or save steps instead of skipping them.
labels.root_cause: CLI batch does not filter out view and save steps the way the engine batch does.

labels.symptom: In text with large line spacing, moving the caret up or down a line leaves it on the current line.
Recorded actions contain both a command and its inner steps, so playback applies the effect twice.
labels.root_cause: Nested Session::execute calls are journaled, and action recording copies every replayable journal entry.

labels.symptom: An artboard moved left of or above the canvas origin ends up partly off-canvas.
labels.root_cause: fit_canvas only grows the canvas right and down and never shifts the document for negative coordinates.

labels.symptom: Content-Aware Move cannot scale or rotate the moved patch before committing.
Inserting text with CRLF line endings returns a caret position beyond the end of the stored text.
labels.root_cause: The caret is computed from the input length before CRLF is normalized to LF.

labels.symptom: History Brush and Fill with History report a missing source when the chosen history state had locked pixels.
labels.root_cause: Looking up the history source treats pixel-locked layers as nonexistent.

labels.symptom: Arbitrary canvas rotation fails with a layer-lock error when a position-locked layer is inside a group.
labels.root_cause: The lock check for arbitrary rotation handles grouped children differently from the 90-degree rotation path.

labels.symptom: An identity transform on a feathered selection makes opaque edge pixels translucent.
labels.root_cause: The transform applies the feathered selection alpha again when it writes pixels back.

labels.symptom: Clearing the transparent palette entry in an indexed image leaves the image transparent, and that carries into RGB exports.
labels.root_cause: Clearing the color table transparency does not restore the composite's alpha.

labels.symptom: Extending the canvas left with Crop on a Background layer adds a transparent border that stays invisible after an opaque Fill.
labels.root_cause: Crop creates transparent pixels on a layer still treated as a locked Background, and Fill keeps the transparency locked.

labels.symptom: Solarize and Add Noise report success on a fresh Reveal All mask but leave it unchanged.
labels.root_cause: Likely the filters skip an untouched mask that has no allocated pixel data.

labels.symptom: Perspective Warp on a selection also moves linked-mask coverage outside the selection.
labels.root_cause: The warp transforms the whole linked mask instead of only the selected area.

labels.symptom: The Freeform Pen has no Alt straight-segment mode, and Cmd/Ctrl does not switch the new pens to Direct Selection.
The interface cannot be switched to Arabic.
labels.root_cause: There is no Arabic translation, and right-to-left support may be missing.

labels.symptom: Curves cannot draw the curve freehand or smooth it, and pencil-drawn Curves layers from PSD files are misread.
labels.root_cause: The Curves map flag byte is treated as padding, and there is no pencil mode.

labels.symptom: Recording Last Filter in an action replays the wrong filter, or fails in a new session.
labels.root_cause: The wrapper command is journaled instead of the concrete filter it ran.

labels.symptom: The interface is only available in English.
labels.root_cause: No localization support.

labels.symptom: The text of a fully locked type layer can still be replaced.
labels.root_cause: The type edit command does not check the layer's All lock.

labels.symptom: A fully locked gradient fill layer still accepts reverse and color-stop edits.
labels.root_cause: Gradient fill edit commands do not check the layer's All lock.

labels.symptom: Brush strokes can still change a layer mask when the layer is fully locked.
labels.root_cause: The lock check is applied to pixel targets but not to mask targets.

labels.symptom: Content-Aware Scale opens a parameter dialog instead of an on-canvas transform box with live preview.
labels.root_cause: The command is only wired to a dialog; no scale-only transform box with a preview exists.

labels.symptom: Number fields reject typed units, their labels can't be dragged to change the value, and double-clicking most sliders doesn't reset them.
labels.root_cause: The shared value-field and slider widgets do not parse units, make labels draggable, or reset on double-click.

labels.symptom: Shift+Plus/Minus do not cycle blend modes, and dropping layer effects on the Trash does nothing.
The Puppet Warp mesh has a staircase outline and joins nearby shapes into one mesh.
labels.root_cause: The mesh is built from square grid cells instead of following the object's outline.

labels.symptom: On a German keyboard layout, shortcuts bound to [ ] and similar keys can't be triggered.
labels.root_cause: egui has no key for layout-specific characters and reports physical keys, and shortcut matching rejects AltGr/Option modifiers.

labels.symptom: The Properties panel for a Curves adjustment layer has no black, gray or white point eyedroppers.
Dragging a layer mask thumbnail to the Trash deletes the whole layer instead of offering to apply or delete the mask.
labels.root_cause: The mask thumbnail cannot be dragged by itself; dragging it drags the whole layer row.

labels.symptom: Levels has no black, gray or white point eyedroppers in either the dialog or the Properties panel.
Dragging a vector mask thumbnail to the Trash deletes the whole layer instead of just the mask.
labels.root_cause: The vector mask thumbnail starts a drag of the whole layer row instead of a mask-only drag.

labels.symptom: Vanishing Point planes have to be typed in as JSON coordinates; there is no on-canvas plane editor.
labels.root_cause: filter.vanishingPoint only opens the generic parameter dialog.

labels.symptom: Using the Curves eyedropper on a smart object does nothing.
labels.root_cause: adjust_as_smart_filter records the raw eyedropper params instead of the resolved curve.

labels.symptom: The Recent tab in the New Document dialog shows a fixed list instead of recently created documents.
labels.root_cause: The Recent tab is a hard-coded preset list.

labels.symptom: Alt+Click with the Zoom tool does not zoom out.
On Windows, maximizing the window makes the taskbar render as a garbled, unclickable strip.
labels.root_cause: The maximized window covers the taskbar area or conflicts with shell patchers like ExplorerPatcher.

labels.symptom: Typing a crop ratio always resets it to 0, and dragging a crop handle back makes it jump without undo support.
The app crashes when creating a new file, possibly on older graphics hardware.
The Motion Blur dialog sets the angle only with a linear slider and has no circular angle dial.
After installing the .deb or Flatpak on Linux, no app icon or launcher entry appears.
labels.root_cause: Linux packages likely do not install a proper .desktop file and icon.

labels.symptom: There is no opt-in way to back up, version or share documents on storage the user owns (NAS, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 via rclone).
There is no bundled demo project for testing or for showing features to new users.
Running the AppImage with CLI or MCP arguments opens the GUI instead of running the bundled CLI.
labels.root_cause: The AppRun script always runs the GUI binary and has no way to select the bundled CLI.

labels.symptom: On Linux the window has square corners and no shadow, and its title-bar buttons ignore the system button order.
labels.root_cause: Client-side window decorations on Linux do not round corners, draw shadows or read the desktop button layout.

labels.symptom: The application frame can't be turned off to let panels float over the desktop.
Color working space can only be set globally, isn't shown for the open document, and there are no view transforms.
Automation refuses to export layers or data sets to files, even inside the granted folders.
labels.root_cause: The export commands take ambient paths and are not routed through the capability-scoped workspace.

labels.symptom: A third party now offers a Flatpak install that updates automatically.
The app icon does not clearly show what the application is.
Users cannot add, remove or reorder items in the menu bar.
UI scale jumps from 100% to 125% with nothing in between, and there is no custom value.
labels.root_cause: The UI scale presets skip the 105–120% range.

labels.symptom: On Windows the taskbar disappears after a while and only comes back when the app is restarted.
labels.root_cause: The maximized borderless window covers the taskbar area and behaves like a fullscreen window.

labels.symptom: The bracket shortcut cannot shrink the brush below 2 pixels.
labels.root_cause: The bracket keybind clamps brush size to a minimum of 2 instead of 1.

labels.symptom: White content cannot be seen against the transparency checkerboard.
labels.root_cause: The transparency checkerboard is too light and there is no outline or setting to adjust it.

labels.symptom: The app cannot be scripted with Python for batch automation.
The transform width and height fields offer no way to switch measurement units.
Vector shapes cannot be combined with non-destructive Boolean operations.
There is no image trace feature for turning raster images into editable vector paths.
Vector strokes cannot have a variable width along the path.
Dragging a panel to dock it shows only an outline, not a live preview of the new layout.
Scrollbars cannot be set to always visible, auto-hide or hidden.
The Timeline has no frame-animation mode with per-frame delays, tweening or onion skinning.
labels.root_cause: The document model holds one global timeline, not a collection of animation frames.

labels.symptom: The LUT dropdown cannot be cycled with arrow keys or the mouse wheel to preview entries.
labels.root_cause: The Color Lookup control does not use the wheel-aware dropdown and gets no keyboard navigation while closed.

labels.symptom: There are no pixel-art or game-asset tools such as tilemaps, sprite sheet slicing or indexed colour.
There are no frame-by-frame animation tools such as onion skinning or a frame timeline.
There is no colour harmony tool for generating palettes from a base colour.
There is no preference to turn off UI animations; menus, popups and scrolling always animate.
labels.root_cause: egui animation_time and scroll animation are always on, and no setting exposes them.

labels.symptom: A layer with an effect inside a group with its own effect looks clipped on the canvas but exports correctly.
On Windows 11, maximizing the window hides the taskbar like borderless fullscreen.
An image file cannot be imported directly as a brush tip.
Vanishing Point cannot tear off perpendicular planes and has no perspective Stamp tool.
User feedback praising the small download size.
A smart filter mask cannot be selected or painted after it is created.
Brush dynamics have no response curve of their own for each control.
On Windows the text tool types vertically by default, and dragging an image into the window does not work.
The clone source overlay always draws as Normal, and the W/H fields cannot be linked.
labels.root_cause: draw_clone_preview ignores the stored blend mode, and the panel has no aspect-ratio link.

labels.symptom: There are no package repositories (apt, yum, Homebrew), so users have to upgrade by hand.
labels.root_cause: Releases are shipped only as downloadable artifacts, with no package repository or Homebrew tap.

labels.symptom: With the Pen tool, Alt does not break handles while drawing, and dragging on the first anchor does not pull out handles when closing.
On Windows a maximized window covers the taskbar.
labels.root_cause: The maximized borderless window uses the full monitor area instead of the work area.

labels.symptom: On macOS a side panel shows a large block of garbled, encoded-looking text at launch.
After Save As, reopening the file shows the old document name.
labels.root_cause: The saved file's manifest is written with the originally opened document's name instead of the new one.

labels.symptom: Color Range ignores the active selection and samples the whole canvas.
labels.root_cause: The active selection is not used as a mask in Color Range sampling.

labels.symptom: Large solid-colour documents fail to reopen, or use huge amounts of memory after reopening.
labels.root_cause: Loading decodes shared deduplicated tiles once per reference with no cache by hash, and counts each one against the size limit.

labels.symptom: JSX scripts cannot be run.
Free warp, distort and perspective cannot be applied to live type without rasterizing it.
The Color panel picker uses the wrong gamma, so its midpoint shows light gray instead of neutral gray.
labels.root_cause: The Color panel applies an extra gamma or sRGB conversion that the foreground/background picker does not.

labels.symptom: The Levels dialog has no eyedroppers, no Alt-drag clipping preview and no reset.
Pressing a dialog's shortcut again does not close the dialog.
Several adjacent checkboxes cannot be toggled by dragging across them.
The selection tool flyout has no Selection Brush tool.
The Drop Shadow angle can only be typed as a number; there is no circular dial to drag.
Fonts installed on the system do not appear in the font picker; only a small fallback set is listed.
labels.root_cause: System font enumeration does not pick up user-installed TTF/OTF families.

labels.symptom: Magnetic Lasso does not snap to high-contrast edges and drifts like a freehand lasso.
Some brushes imported from an .abr file are not shown and cannot be used.
CI fails at random on tests that use a fake 'bad id' which can collide with a real id.
labels.root_cause: Sentinel ids like 9999 can be reached by the process-wide NEXT_ID counter that is shared across tests.

labels.symptom: In fullscreen, dragging a scrubby value control doesn't wrap the cursor at the left screen edge.
labels.root_cause: The cursor-wrap logic fails at the left edge in fullscreen.

labels.symptom: Changing fill, stroke color or stroke weight doesn't update a shape that has already been drawn.
Duplicating a layer offers no dialog for name or destination.
Hovering over a dropdown and turning the mouse wheel doesn't change the selection.
labels.root_cause: Combo boxes don't handle scroll on hover.

labels.symptom: A light pen touch on a drawing tablet is sometimes read as full pressure.
First-time contributors' pull request CI runs wait for a maintainer to approve them.
labels.root_cause: The repository requires approval for workflow runs from first-time contributors.

labels.symptom: Turning a layer group's visibility back on in a very large PSD file crashes the app.
The app doesn't update itself to new releases.
Images on the Windows clipboard can't be pasted, and some option changes don't stay saved after a restart.
A black rectangle appears at random at the bottom of the window.
The Render Video menu item fails because no output location is asked for.
labels.root_cause: The menu runs file.export.renderVideo without a folder and the engine rejects it instead of prompting with a save dialog.

labels.symptom: No Android build is available and there is no community discussion page.
A pending crop is not applied when switching to another tool from the toolbar.
A new adjustment layer selects its mask instead of the layer, so its settings do not appear in the properties panel.
Switching to a certain theme makes the color picker disappear.
Panels cannot be placed in extra columns, on both sides of the canvas, or floated freely.
Field Blur has no movable pins and blurs the whole layer.
Alt-clicking a layer does not create a clipping mask.
Opening the color picker does not select the hex code field, so copying or pasting it takes extra clicks.
Web users can't add their own fonts from a link or a file; only fonts bundled at build time are available.
labels.root_cause: The web font catalog comes only from a manifest file supplied by the host.

labels.symptom: Colours and contrast in the raw development preview differ from the final image.
On Linux (Wayland), pasting images from the clipboard and dragging files onto the window both fail.
On Wayland (KDE Plasma) the window can't be resized by dragging its borders, only maximized.
labels.root_cause: No client-side resize handles or decorations under Wayland.

labels.symptom: When several layers are selected, the transform bounding box covers only one of them.
Linux AppImage users have no way to run the bundled CLI or MCP server.
labels.root_cause: The AppImage entry point always starts the GUI and has no option to dispatch to the CLI binary.

labels.symptom: On Linux under Wayland, dragging and dropping files into the window does nothing.
Images on the canvas look blurry compared to other image editors.
No progress is shown while a document is saving.
Automation servers give no warning when text falls back from a missing font.
labels.root_cause: The missing-font warning is printed only by the one-shot CLI commands, not by the serve and mcp sessions.

labels.symptom: Windows installers put each app in its own Program Files folder instead of under one shared parent folder.
A headless automation session can only use installed or bundled fonts and cannot load a font file or folder.
labels.root_cause: The font scan reads only system font folders and has no option to add a font path.

labels.symptom: The eraser end of a pen stylus draws like the pen tip instead of erasing.
labels.root_cause: The stylus eraser end is not detected in pen input.

labels.symptom: The width and height typed in the New Document dialog are ignored, and a 1920x1080 canvas is created.
labels.root_cause: The dialog's size fields are not applied when the document is created.

labels.symptom: Save As is missing many file formats the commercial app offers, such as BMP, GIF and PDF.
Save As offers no PDF format.
The transform box does not follow a moved selection, and the content jumps when you switch layers.
With several layers selected, the transform tool only outlines and resizes the first layer.
labels.root_cause: The transform tool only works on the first selected layer.

labels.symptom: Tracking issue that collects several transform tool bugs.
User questions whether LLM-generated code can count as a clean-room implementation.
There are no tests checking that recorded actions with crop, filters, selections or styled text replay the same way on another document.
After opening an old PSD file, the screen keeps turning off and on.
There is no documentation of the .abr brush file format.
Restoring the window from minimized takes a noticeable moment before it is drawn and responsive.
Importing a macOS .plugin bundle fails with 'is a directory' or 'is not a file'.
labels.root_cause: The plugin loader does not treat macOS bundle directories as a single plugin.

labels.symptom: There is no way to import Photoshop action sets (.atn files).
The app can't be installed with Homebrew.
labels.root_cause: No Homebrew cask is published.

labels.symptom: The brush tool lags heavily while painting.
The Color Balance adjustment gives very different results from the reference app at extreme values.
After resizing and going fullscreen again, a taskbar-height black bar stays at the bottom of the window.
labels.root_cause: The viewport keeps the work-area height from before the fullscreen toggle.

labels.symptom: In the new theme the layer lock buttons are missing except Lock All.
The Pattern Preview view mode does nothing.
Free transform does not offer skew or distort handles, only scale and rotate.
After a long idle period or system sleep the app stops responding and does not close with the X button.
Holding the tilde key while using the brush does not switch to a temporary eraser.
On an older laptop with an NVIDIA GPU, the app does not start, and the log shows no clear fatal error.
Export Layers to Files has no option to trim layers.
On older Intel Macs the app quits at launch with a Metal shader language error.
labels.root_cause: wgpu compiles shaders with -std=metal3.2, which older GPUs don't support.

labels.symptom: The New Document dialog lacks current Android device presets and billboard sizes.
TGA images with transparency open with an opaque background.
labels.root_cause: TGA alpha channel is ignored on import.

labels.symptom: User asks for an Adobe Animate clone.
Clearing a large selection is extremely slow.
On non-Pro themes the toolbar has no chevron to switch between one and two columns.
labels.root_cause: The chevron is only drawn when the theme's pro token is true.

labels.symptom: There is no Clarity/Dehaze adjustment layer.
Sony A6000 raw photos open very dark and washed out.
Opening large project bundles is very slow because each tile lookup scans the whole archive index.
labels.root_cause: ZIP entry lookup by name is linear per reference and CRC-32 is computed byte-at-a-time instead of with crc32fast.

labels.symptom: On Linux, existing image files can't be opened, and drag and drop doesn't work either.
The Brush Settings panel lacks parity with the reference app: no Brushes button, no hamburger menu, and Brushes isn't a separate window.
A tiny file with a huge declared pattern size crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: The pattern's width and height are never checked on load, so painting it makes a huge allocation or overflows.

labels.symptom: Brush smoothing has no catch-up mode and no visual cue showing the lag between cursor and stroke.
Freeform and Curvature pen tools are missing.
On Linux with NVIDIA, one start that is interrupted leaves every later launch on slow software rendering, even though Vulkan works.
labels.root_cause: After an interrupted start on auto, the GPU fallback picks the GL backend, which can't present to the surface, then drops to llvmpipe and remembers that choice.
bug_markers: the previous start didn't finish on auto; using gl

labels.symptom: Loading a document with an unlimited blob size, or a mismatched zip entry, panics or fails.
labels.root_cause: max_blob_bytes + 1 overflows, and the zip entry slice is unchecked.

labels.symptom: An autosave that worked can be reported as failed, and leftover recovery files are never cleaned up.
labels.root_cause: Cleanup after the commit fails hard with '?', and recovery bundles without a sidecar plus temp files are never swept.

labels.symptom: With multiple layers selected, the align icons in the top toolbar are cut off and the align menu shows only text, no icons.
