Triple, quadruple and quintuple clicks in text editing do not select the line, paragraph or all text.
labels.root_cause: Only double-click selection is implemented.

labels.symptom: In the studio dark theme the color swatches appear as large circles instead of squares.
Panel buttons can change the document directly without going through a command, so automation and history don't see those actions.
labels.root_cause: No xtask check makes UI actions dispatch through command ids.

labels.symptom: Monochrome LinearRaw DNG files fail to open with an unsupported camera raw error.
labels.root_cause: The raw decoder handles only 3-sample LinearRaw data.
bug_markers: LinearRaw data with 1 samples per pixel

labels.symptom: Color settings offer only one CMYK profile, cannot import ICC profiles, and do not detect the display profile on Windows.
labels.root_cause: Display-profile detection is not implemented on Windows, and there is no way to load ICC profiles.
bug_markers: fallback: this platform doesn't report display profiles

labels.symptom: Drop shadow angle has no effect on text layers, and some brush, layer-style and panel-resize shortcuts are missing.
The Character panel has no dropdowns with preset values for font size, leading and tracking.
The Import Video Frames to Layers button does nothing.
PSD files with a new type layer fail to open in Photopea.
labels.root_cause: A stub document-level Txt2 block is written for fresh documents, which Photopea fails to parse.

labels.symptom: The gradient tool icon is hard to recognise.
Pressing a tool shortcut again cycles to a sibling tool when it should stay on the current tool.
labels.root_cause: The 'Use Shift Key for Tool Switch' preference defaults to false.

labels.symptom: Clip Studio Paint (.sut) and Procreate (.brush) brushes can't be imported.
Playing back a recorded Save on a flat image writes to the file used during recording instead of overwriting the current document.
labels.root_cause: A Save of a flat file is recorded as Save As with a fixed path.

labels.symptom: A unit test fails when the whole test suite runs but passes when run alone.
labels.root_cause: Shared state from a test that runs in parallel leaks into this one.

labels.symptom: A settings panel left open at exit reopens on the next launch even when no document is open.
labels.root_cause: Panel visibility is restored from the saved session without checking whether a document is open.

labels.symptom: On Windows, maximizing the window covers the taskbar.
In exported files, text layers carry an invented font name, so other apps treat the font as missing.
labels.root_cause: The font's PostScript name is made up from the family name plus "-Regular" instead of being read from the font file.

labels.symptom: Custom printer ICC profiles can't be chosen in print settings.
Several contributors end up fixing the same issue at once, so duplicate PRs get closed unmerged.
labels.root_cause: There is no process for claiming an issue before starting work on it.

labels.symptom: The selected tool in each tool group goes back to its default after the app is restarted.
labels.root_cause: The active tool variant in each group is not saved between sessions.

labels.symptom: Brush and smudge strokes leave visible gaps instead of a smooth stroke.
On Windows the right-side panels cannot be resized.
In translated interfaces such as Russian, Polish, Spanish or French, longer labels overlap other interface elements.
labels.root_cause: UI layout assumes English label widths and doesn't handle longer translated strings.

labels.symptom: A smart object pasted into another document cannot be opened.
An info panel on the right side of the window cannot be closed.
Loading a compiled .jsxbin script plugin fails with an error.
labels.root_cause: Binary-compiled JSX scripts are not supported.

labels.symptom: Copy and paste of multiple selected layers only pastes the last selected layer.
The same RAW file opens with very different brightness and colour than the camera JPEG, and differently between the two photo apps.
labels.root_cause: Two separate RAW development pipelines are maintained independently, so defaults and fixes differ.

labels.symptom: Free Transform can't be applied to several selected layers at once.
Painting with symmetry enabled is laggy and brush strokes lose continuity.
Setting image size in centimeters or inches gives the wrong size, and fill options such as pattern fill are missing.
With a Studio theme the gradient tool's options bar shows only a hint.
labels.root_cause: The Tool::Gradient options are gated by t.pro in panels.rs.

labels.symptom: The app lags while its window is dragged.
There is no face-aware liquify tool.
With an unlinked mask targeted, the Move tool moves the layer instead of the mask.
labels.root_cause: layer.translate ignores the mask target.

labels.symptom: Some image adjustments refuse to run on smart object layers.
labels.root_cause: Desaturate, Equalize and Replace Color have no smart-filter path.
bug_markers: active layer is a Smart Object layer, not a pixel layer

labels.symptom: A layer with a transform effect disappears when the canvas is panned.
Sony ARW raw files open with wrong colors.
Editing text with a custom font turns ligatures back into plain default characters.
The responsive layout solver doesn't yet cover edge-case geometry or malformed metadata.
There is no benchmark for large responsive variant sets or for preview cache memory.
Propagation conflicts between a master and its variants can only be resolved through commands, not interactively.
The responsive artboard workflow hasn't had a full accessibility or empty/error-state review.
It is unverified whether responsive-artboard PSD metadata survives a resave in other editors.
With an AppImage integrator installed, the AppImage shows two launcher entries.
labels.root_cause: The AppImage creates its own desktop entry on top of the one the integrator creates.

labels.symptom: Several selected artboards can't be exported at once, and layers dragged into an artboard aren't moved to their matching position.
The move tool lacks options to show transform controls, show layer bounds on hover and expand groups on click.
Corner handles in distort or corner-pin transforms do not snap to guides or guide intersections.
A crafted PSD file with path data can make the app reserve gigabytes of memory and abort.
labels.root_cause: PathData::subpaths preallocates capacity for every length record using counts read from the file.

labels.symptom: A crafted PSD file can make the app reserve huge amounts of memory and abort.
labels.root_cause: Descriptor lists call Vec::with_capacity with an item count read from the file, and the per-item size check is too low.

labels.symptom: When a crop frame is resized with snapping on, it stops a few pixels short of the snap line and leaves a transparent strip.
labels.root_cause: In most resize modes the snap is applied to the pointer instead of the handle, so the frame is off by the grab offset.

labels.symptom: Opening a very large or malformed PSD/PSB file can use gigabytes of memory and crash the app.
labels.root_cause: The PSD composite decode converts planes with infallible, unchecked allocation before checking the output size budget.

labels.symptom: Text on a path and Vanishing Point filter are missing.
Unclear report with only an image.
Large stroke layer effects render with faceted, low-poly edges.
Turning off the preview in one layer effect turns disabled effects back on.
After confirming one transform, Free Transform on a Smart Object shows the wrong bounding box.
On Linux, the key hints shown at startup use macOS shortcuts (Cmd) instead of Ctrl.
labels.root_cause: Shortcut hint text is hardcoded to macOS bindings rather than chosen per platform.

labels.symptom: On Windows, opening a file larger than 4 GB fails with 'The parameter is incorrect. (os error 87)'.
labels.root_cause: A 32-bit size or offset limit in the file reading or memory-mapping code, suspected from the 4 GB threshold.

labels.symptom: On Windows the mouse cursor stutters at a few frames per second when it is over the title bar or outside the focused window.
On Linux the app menu does not appear in the desktop's global menu bar.
labels.root_cause: The com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar protocol is not supported.

labels.symptom: Promotional suggestion to use a third-party AI contribution service.
On Windows with an Intel GPU the app crashes at launch inside the Vulkan driver, unless WGPU_BACKEND=dx12 is set.
labels.root_cause: wgpu picks the Vulkan backend by default, and the Intel Vulkan driver igvk64.dll crashes.

labels.symptom: There is no central app for installing and updating the apps, and no Bridge-style batch tool.
Generative AI editing such as Generative Fill and Generative Expand is missing.
Korean text shows as empty boxes in the title bar and panel lists, and text breaks when re-rendered with a fallback font.
labels.root_cause: UI fonts lack Hangul fallback coverage and text re-rendering substitutes a fallback font that mis-shapes Hangul.

labels.symptom: AVIF images cannot be opened.
labels.root_cause: AVIF decoding is declared unsupported in the codec capabilities.

labels.symptom: In the browser build the display freezes or goes blank after GPU device loss.
labels.root_cause: Lost WebGPU/WebGL device is not recreated so rendering never recovers.

labels.symptom: After sitting idle about a minute the UI becomes corrupted with white dots and distorted text and icons.
Camera RAW files such as DNG, CR2, NEF and ARW can't be opened.
labels.root_cause: There is no RAW decoder.

labels.symptom: Some installed fonts fail to load and show an error.
No Arabic language or right-to-left layout and text support.
labels.root_cause: UI lacks Arabic localization, RTL shaping and mirroring.

labels.symptom: No OpenColorIO color management option, only ICC.
Click-to-zoom jumps instantly instead of easing smoothly.
labels.root_cause: Zoom commands set the view zoom immediately without animation.

labels.symptom: Animated GIFs are imported as a single flattened frame with no playback.
labels.root_cause: GIF import reads only the first frame.

labels.symptom: Cannot manually pick a monitor colour profile per display.
Re-rendered PSD smart objects with perspective transform become flat stretched rectangles.
labels.root_cause: Parser uses Trnf bounding box and ignores nonAffineTransform corners.

labels.symptom: Canvas colours are not matched to each display's profile on macOS.
labels.root_cause: CAMetalLayer colorspace is left untagged so the OS does not colour-match.

labels.symptom: CMYK PSD colours look more saturated than in Photoshop.
labels.root_cause: Possibly different colour-management settings or CMYK conversion.

labels.symptom: No integration with a local ComfyUI server for AI inpainting.
On Windows the Japanese IME cannot be switched to Japanese mode while the app has focus.
labels.root_cause: IME is not enabled for the window (IME allowed not set on text focus).

labels.symptom: The app is not available through Homebrew.
Bevel & Emboss layer effect looks different from Photoshop.
On older Macs with patched Metal drivers (OpenCore) the app quits at launch with a wgpu RequestDeviceError.
labels.root_cause: wgpu device request fails on unsupported/patched Metal GPUs and the app exits instead of falling back.

labels.symptom: Pen pressure only works with Windows Ink and feels choppy, panels can't float, and large brushes lag.
labels.root_cause: Tablet input relies only on Windows Ink with no Wintab fallback, and brush rendering runs on the CPU.

labels.symptom: After installing from the Windows MSI, the Start Menu shortcut doesn't launch the app and the executable has no icon.
labels.root_cause: The MSI makes the shortcut point at the cached icon file instead of the exe, and no icon resource is embedded in the executable.

labels.symptom: You can't import 3D models or paint on them.
App icons are hard to read and tell apart at taskbar or dock size.
labels.root_cause: The detailed engraved animal icons lose their detail when shown small.

labels.symptom: There is no way to generate normal maps or height maps for textures.
Exporting an image throws away the RGB values of fully transparent pixels.
labels.root_cause: The exporter discards or premultiplies color channels when alpha is zero.

labels.symptom: Plug-ins can only be filters; they can't add commands, panels or file formats.
The app logos look dated and should be redesigned.
Many UI, tool, text and performance problems on Windows, including no option to choose a custom install location.
Releases come without matching debug symbols, so users can't profile the shipped binaries.
labels.root_cause: The release pipeline does not publish PDB or debug symbol files.

labels.symptom: Pasting an image from the clipboard does nothing, but pasting text works.
labels.root_cause: Clipboard handling only supports text, not image data.

labels.symptom: Stylus pressure from Wacom and XP-Pen tablets is ignored when painting with brushes.
labels.root_cause: Tablet pressure input is not read from the platform pointer events.

labels.symptom: Moving a layer that has or once had a drop shadow effect is extremely slow, even after the effect is turned off.
labels.root_cause: The layer effect appears to be recomputed on every move frame instead of being cached.

labels.symptom: Brushes are hard to find; users want them in the sidebar and grouped into collapsible categories.
A user suggests reusing ideas and code from another open-source image editor.
On macOS and Linux, pen pressure and tilt from a stylus are ignored, so strokes always use full pressure.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 / egui-winit 0.36 do not deliver tablet pressure events on macOS and Linux.

labels.symptom: The Remove and Patch retouching tools are missing.
The repository has no Discussions tab.
On Windows the central canvas stays blank, even though added elements appear in the side panels.
labels.root_cause: Probably a GPU canvas rendering failure on this setup.

labels.symptom: The new document dialog ignores the size you enter and always creates a 1920x1080 document.
The File menu has no Exit item for closing the app.
labels.root_cause: No Exit command was added to the File menu catalog.

labels.symptom: Editing a gradient stop midpoint with a huge index crashes or silently succeeds.
labels.root_cause: The index plus one was computed before the bounds check and overflowed.

labels.symptom: Colour preferences show the hex value as read-only text, so you can't type in a colour.
labels.root_cause: The preferences UI showed the hex as a label, not an editable field.

labels.symptom: Japanese text shows as boxes in menus, and IME composition doesn't work in text input.
labels.root_cause: No CJK font was registered, Event::Ime was not handled, and output.ime was never set, so the OS IME was never enabled.

labels.symptom: Several filters crash or allocate unbounded memory on extreme parameters, and some panels keep stale or wrong state.
labels.root_cause: Filter parameters and coordinates were not validated or bounded, and several UI paths had state sync errors.

labels.symptom: Cropping at extreme coordinates crashes instead of reporting an error.
labels.root_cause: Negating i32::MIN overflowed, and the translation pushed surfaces out of the i32 range.

labels.symptom: Placing a scale marker on a very short image crashes the command.
labels.root_cause: f64::clamp panicked because the minimum was larger than the maximum for images under 8 px tall.
fixed_markers: a scale marker needs at least 8 px

labels.symptom: The Color panel's hex and RGB readouts can't be edited.
Pasting an image copied in another app does nothing, and Paste stays greyed out.
labels.root_cause: The paste enablement check looked only at the internal clipboard, before the OS clipboard was imported.

labels.symptom: Grayscale deep EXR files open fully opaque with the wrong alpha channel.
labels.root_cause: The deep EXR flattening loop always wrote an RGBA quadruple, so for gray+alpha images the alpha slot got a luminance copy.

labels.symptom: Linking layers in a file that stores a maximal link group id crashes with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: The new group id was computed as max+1 without an overflow check.

labels.symptom: Stepping a timeline frame crashes after creating a timeline with an out-of-range duration.
labels.root_cause: An unvalidated duration made the i64 clamp bounds invalid, so the clamp panicked.

labels.symptom: Applying a text data set makes the text layer's text disappear, including in exported files.
labels.root_cause: The text layer cache was cleared but never re-rendered after replacing its text.

labels.symptom: The clone stamp only shows cloned pixels after release, and strokes start late after the press.
Clicking the search field in the Help menu closes the menu before you can type.
labels.root_cause: egui menus use PopupCloseBehavior::CloseOnClick, which closes the menu on clicks inside it too.

labels.symptom: The eyedropper shows a crosshair cursor instead of a pipette while sampling colours.
Gradient fills and gradient effects render slowly.
labels.root_cause: Gradient stops were rebuilt and converted for every pixel.

labels.symptom: Holding a number key types its digit twice, so 4 gives 44 instead of 40.
labels.root_cause: The key handler ignored the repeat flag on egui key events, so an auto-repeat counted as a second press.

labels.symptom: Creating or editing an artboard at extreme coordinates fails with an internal error or makes the board narrower.
labels.root_cause: Board coordinates used unchecked i32 arithmetic.

labels.symptom: A huge brush Scatter amount crashes painting with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: The unbounded scatter made dab centres infinite and the dab rect arithmetic overflowed.

labels.symptom: Shift-click straight lines with spacing off leave separate dabs instead of a line.
labels.root_cause: Untimed stroke segments got one dab because spacing depended on pointer speed.

labels.symptom: Editing a smart object's contents twice opens a duplicate document.
labels.root_cause: Edit Contents did not look for an already-open linked document.

labels.symptom: Holding Alt did not switch Dodge/Burn or Blur/Sharpen to the opposite tool.
Opening or applying layer comps with extreme offsets crashes or puts layers in the wrong place.
labels.root_cause: Comp offsets read from the file used unchecked i32 arithmetic and as i32 truncation.

labels.symptom: Pattern fills convert the whole pattern again for every render tile.
labels.root_cause: There was no shared preparation cache within a render.

labels.symptom: Retouch brushes only show their effect after the mouse is released.
Dodge and Burn strokes produce blotchy uneven results where dabs overlap.
labels.root_cause: Each dab re-applied the tone curve to pixels already toned earlier in the same stroke.

labels.symptom: The Clone Stamp cursor shows only an outline, with no preview of the sampled source.
After changing a layer mask from Reveal All to Hide All, the old drop shadow stays visible.
labels.root_cause: The effect-cache fingerprint left out the mask's default pixel value and pixel format.

labels.symptom: After a transform, exports show the drop shadow of the layer's old shape, and changing opacity is slow.
labels.root_cause: The CPU effect-map cache keyed fill layers by their fill spec instead of their cached pixels, and also included opacity and visibility in the key.

labels.symptom: Importing a 32-bit transparent flattened PSD clips HDR colour values to the 0–1 range.
labels.root_cause: The unmatte helper clamped its result even when the target surface stores float samples.

labels.symptom: The app can't be installed or updated through Homebrew on macOS.
labels.root_cause: No Homebrew cask is published.

labels.symptom: In translated interfaces, a section header shows the wrong word because one source string had two meanings.
labels.root_cause: A single translation catalog key was used for two unrelated meanings, with no context to tell them apart.

labels.symptom: Importing a UTF-8 CSV data set turns non-ASCII characters into mojibake.
labels.root_cause: The CSV splitter walked raw bytes and turned each byte into a char.

labels.symptom: Resetting a single keyboard shortcut or menu colour preference fails with "unknown preference".
labels.root_cause: Preferences::reset looked the map key up in the empty default map.

labels.symptom: Alt-clicking the line between two layers doesn't create a clipping mask.
The Move tool moves the whole layer instead of only the selected pixels.
labels.root_cause: The Move tool always translated the layer and ignored the selection.

labels.symptom: Ctrl or Cmd plus the scroll wheel zooms instead of scrolling sideways, and touchpad pinch on Windows arrives as Ctrl plus wheel.
labels.root_cause: egui's default InputOptions map Ctrl/Cmd plus wheel to zoom, and Windows sends touchpad pinch as Ctrl plus wheel.

labels.symptom: A pen tablet gives no input on Wayland, and on macOS pen pressure is lost or the ends of strokes come out thin.
labels.root_cause: winit does not bind zwp_tablet_v2 on Wayland, the macOS AppKit event monitor was installed before NSApplication existed, and the pen-up event's zero pressure overwrote the last sample.

labels.symptom: Opening a file dialog crashes the app on macOS or makes the compositor report the app as not responding on Linux.
labels.root_cause: Synchronous rfd file dialogs ran inside winit's event handler, blocking the event loop and causing panics in extern C callbacks on macOS.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland, dropping files on the window does nothing, and the suggested workaround command is wrong for AppImage and Flatpak.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 has no Wayland drag and drop, and the notice's XWayland command ignored how the app was installed.

labels.symptom: CI tests fail because new path commands are not classified and a Czech plural string is missing.
labels.root_cause: New automation commands were not added to the vector-path audit list, and the cs catalog was missing a key.

labels.symptom: CI runs are slow and Linux jobs fail with no space left on the device.
labels.root_cause: Two full debug-info builds don't fit on the Linux runner's disk, and the cache is over its quota, so it keeps being evicted.

labels.symptom: Pasting while a layer mask is targeted creates a new layer instead of writing into the mask.
labels.root_cause: Paste commands ignored the mask/channel edit target.

labels.symptom: Pass-through groups with opacity or masks look too dark over a transparent background.
labels.root_cause: Group coverage mixed straight RGB and alpha separately instead of in premultiplied space.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking with a painting tool doesn't let you pick, rename or delete brush presets.
labels.root_cause: The right-click picker was a separate, simplified copy of the Brushes panel list.

labels.symptom: Hovering a blend mode in the layers panel does not preview it on the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The dropdown only reported clicks, not hovered options.

labels.symptom: There is no Red Eye tool.
Text styling is lost when a saved PSD is reopened, because a tiny style value is written as a bare dot.
labels.root_cause: format_real stripped a tiny non-zero value down to a '.' or '-.' token.

labels.symptom: Pressing Delete with layers highlighted and no selection does not delete non-pixel layers.
labels.root_cause: The Delete key was bound only to Edit › Clear, which works only on pixel layers.

labels.symptom: Pass-through groups render slowly because the backdrop is copied when no copy is needed.
labels.root_cause: The backdrop was snapshotted every time, even when nothing needed the original pixels.

labels.symptom: A truncated ORF raw file is reported as an unsupported compressed variant instead of damaged.
labels.root_cause: Missing strip byte counts summed to zero and took the compressed branch.
fixed_markers: ORF IFD0 has no readable strip byte counts

labels.symptom: Recorded actions cannot be edited, reordered or bound to function keys.
Startup notices and welcome text stay in English or in the launch language after the interface language is changed.
labels.root_cause: Notice text was translated once when posted instead of each time it is drawn, and some strings were missing from the catalogs.

labels.symptom: Adding a layer mask ignores the active selection.
labels.root_cause: The Add Mask actions always ran Reveal All, whether or not there was a selection.

labels.symptom: Layer effects such as shadows render slowly because each tile also renders its surrounding margin.
labels.root_cause: Each tile's content was rendered over a rectangle enlarged by the effect margin.

labels.symptom: Exporting a high-bit-depth PSD drops nearly opaque alpha from the merged image.
labels.root_cause: The check for a fully opaque alpha plane rounded to 8 bits instead of using the precision being exported.

labels.symptom: Rendering documents with complex vector masks is slow because each mask is rebuilt for every tile.
labels.root_cause: Vector mask geometry was compiled again for each tile and band instead of once per render.

labels.symptom: Deep layers cannot be merged at sample level or opened as deep from EXR.
Crash recovery can be silently off while appearing to work.
labels.root_cause: The autosave thread's spawn failure was discarded with .ok().

labels.symptom: Absolute colorimetric conversions or proofs with a malformed ICC profile produce NaN colours.
labels.root_cause: The media white scale divided by a zero or non-finite white point from the profile without checking it.

labels.symptom: Layer mask parameters such as density are lost when opening some PSD files.
labels.root_cause: A length-window heuristic chose Photoshop's field order for mask records even when that reading was implausible.

labels.symptom: A stale lockfile passes CI but then breaks the release build.
labels.root_cause: CI's test and clippy steps did not use --locked.

labels.symptom: Color lookups from .cube files with a custom input domain shift colours.
labels.root_cause: The .cube DOMAIN_MIN/DOMAIN_MAX values were parsed and then discarded.

labels.symptom: An automation call to open a window for a nonexistent document reports success and acts on the active document instead.
labels.root_cause: The control handler ignored the return value of set_active for out-of-range document indices.

labels.symptom: An automation save in bridge mode reports success but ignores the requested quality and format options.
labels.root_cause: The bridge path forwarded only the path to the app and dropped the other options.

labels.symptom: When two open documents share an ID, one of them is not autosaved for recovery.
labels.root_cause: Session admission accepted duplicate persisted document IDs.

labels.symptom: Shrinking an image with Nearest Neighbor blurs and averages the pixels.
labels.root_cause: The nearest-neighbor branch was used only when scale >= 1.0.

labels.symptom: When the app fails, for example with an empty window, nothing is logged, so there is nothing to diagnose or attach to a report.
labels.root_cause: The desktop app never installed a logger, so all log::warn! and log::error! output was discarded.

labels.symptom: Closing a background document tab switches the active tab to a different document.
labels.root_cause: Session::close set the active index from the closed tab's index instead of keeping the active document.

labels.symptom: Gentoo users have no documented way to install the app.
PSD export silently drops the Quick Mask when the channel limit is reached.
labels.root_cause: There was no warning on the branch that omits the Quick Mask.

labels.symptom: Local build log files are committed to the repository root.
labels.root_cause: .gitignore did not ignore *.log files.

labels.symptom: Opening menus or the command palette repeatedly does slow linear command lookups.
labels.root_cause: Command IDs were resolved by scanning the whole command list each time.

labels.symptom: Every edit on large layered documents is slowed by tens of milliseconds of undo history bookkeeping.
labels.root_cause: History trim rebuilt a set of all retained tiles on every edit even when below the byte budget.

labels.symptom: Saving 16/32-bit PSDs uses extra memory and time.
labels.root_cause: Layer payload was buffered and neighbouring blocks cloned before writing.

labels.symptom: Selection and layer-edge bounds are recalculated on every frame for large images.
labels.root_cause: The UI recalculated bounds instead of using the existing tile-bounds cache.

labels.symptom: On Windows, brush and crosshair cursors lag behind the mouse over the canvas.
labels.root_cause: Painted cursors only moved when the canvas presented a new frame instead of using native OS bitmap cursors.

labels.symptom: Editing a layer property recomposites every layer in the damaged area, even layers that did not change.
labels.root_cause: Property edits run every GPU composite pass and reuse no unchanged lower-stack results.

labels.symptom: Clone Stamp or Healing Brush with a very distant source offset crashes with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: Saturating rect translation produced a smaller sample buffer that was relabelled full-size and indexed out of bounds.

labels.symptom: The app crashes at startup when opened with a file name that is not valid Unicode.
labels.root_cause: std::env::args() panics on non-Unicode arguments.

labels.symptom: Editing a layer property recomposites every layer in the damaged area, even layers that did not change.
labels.root_cause: Property edits run every GPU composite pass and reuse no unchanged lower-stack results.

labels.symptom: Layer and mask thumbnails are generated for rows scrolled out of view, using up textures.
labels.root_cause: Thumbnails were generated without checking whether their rectangle was visible.

labels.symptom: Switching documents during a place or copy transform undoes the last edit of the other document.
labels.root_cause: Cancelling the transform ran undo on the active document instead of the document the transform belonged to.

labels.symptom: Color lookup loads only one LUT at a time from a typed path.
A document saves successfully but can never be reopened, failing with a JSON null error.
labels.root_cause: serde_json writes NaN or infinite floats as null, which fails to deserialize into non-optional float fields.

labels.symptom: Saving a PSD whose note icon sits at an extreme position fails with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: The note icon rectangle was computed with unchecked i32 addition, which overflowed.

labels.symptom: Saving in a format that isn't the first in the save dialog adds a second extension, such as .gif.psd.
labels.root_cause: The save dialog's first filter stayed selected when the chosen extension wasn't in the list, so the panel appended its extension.

labels.symptom: Merging channels with a repeated source closes an unrelated document and loses its edits.
labels.root_cause: Repeated indices were not rejected and closing by current index shifted removals.

labels.symptom: GPU display and preview resources for closed documents are never freed, and reopening a document can show stale previews.
labels.root_cause: Per-document LUTs and preview caches were not pruned when a document closed.

labels.symptom: Fit Artboard on Screen panics or centres the view wrongly for artboards with very large coordinates.
labels.root_cause: The view centre was computed with unchecked i32 addition, and new artboard placement added without saturating.

labels.symptom: Running Camera Raw on a very large canvas crashes or fails with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: The u32 width×height buffer size overflowed at 2^32 pixels.

labels.symptom: Recording measurements on a very large document fails with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: The selection area was multiplied in u32 and overflowed.

labels.symptom: Opening and saving large PSD files is slow, and the histogram stalls the UI.
labels.root_cause: Plane interleaving ran on one thread, and the histogram was computed on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: Deleting the only layer leaves a document with no layers.
labels.root_cause: The single-layer delete path had no guard.

labels.symptom: Thumbnail textures for deleted layers and closed documents are never freed.
labels.root_cause: The thumbnail cache was never pruned to the layers and documents still open.

labels.symptom: A rectangle selection in subtract or intersect mode selects the rectangle when nothing was selected before.
labels.root_cause: The subtract and intersect cases with no existing selection fell through to replacing the selection with the shape.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Polish.
Paint Bucket and Gradient make transparent pixels opaque on a transparency-locked layer.
labels.root_cause: The lock-transparency flag was discarded and false was hard-coded into compositing.

labels.symptom: Clear, Cut and image adjustments change the pixels of a pixel-locked layer.
labels.root_cause: These commands called surface_mut() directly and never checked the layer's locks.

labels.symptom: Filters change layers whose pixels are locked, and blurs change alpha on transparency-locked layers.
labels.root_cause: run_filter never checked layer locks.

labels.symptom: The Color Picker dialog has an unbalanced layout and inconsistent padding.
Subject selection and background removal only use classical segmentation, with no option for local ML models.
Channel thumbnails are rebuilt after view-only changes that don't change any pixels.
labels.root_cause: The thumbnail cache was keyed on the session revision, which view-only commands bump, instead of on document snapshot identity.

labels.symptom: Clicking the chevron at the top of the toolbar does not switch between one and two columns.
labels.root_cause: The chevron was allocated with Sense::hover() and only painted, so it never received clicks.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window with no layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG had no background image or Finder layout settings.

labels.symptom: Holding Ctrl/Cmd while editing text doesn't show transform handles.
In the Flatpak build, Simplified Chinese menu items show empty boxes even though CJK fonts are installed on the host.
labels.root_cause: The CJK font fallback only searched hardcoded /usr/share/fonts paths and never /run/host/fonts, where Flatpak mounts the host's fonts.

labels.symptom: The roadmap lists tools as missing that are already implemented.
The Layers panel clones the active layer's metadata on every frame.
labels.root_cause: The active layer was cloned when a borrow from the document snapshot would do.

labels.symptom: The README does not list the downloadable release builds.
The airbrush, smoothing options and symmetry buttons in the brush options bar do nothing.
labels.root_cause: The buttons were placeholders with no action wired up.

labels.symptom: Alt-dragging a layer row moves the layer instead of copying it.
The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app first and lists macOS builds before Windows.
Exporting a single-layer image drops its vector mask or blending restrictions.
labels.root_cause: The single-layer export shortcut bypassed active compositing properties.

labels.symptom: A dry-run dispatch of the release workflow on a branch builds nothing.
labels.root_cause: Jobs that read no secrets still declared environment: release, which is refused on branches.

labels.symptom: Adds brush regression tests only; there is no user-visible change.
While sampling, the eyedropper doesn't show a comparison ring of the colour under the pointer and the current colour.
After one launch fails without a display, the next launch wrongly falls back from Vulkan to GL and remembers the fallback.
labels.root_cause: Windowing errors left the GPU-starting marker behind, which was misread as a GPU crash.

labels.symptom: Exporting a many-layer PSD is slow and thumbnail panels each rebuild their own reduced preview.
labels.root_cause: PSD export compressed one layer at a time, and each panel built its own proxy document.

labels.symptom: Color pickers cannot sample a color from elsewhere on the screen.
Right-clicking a ruler doesn't offer a menu to switch units.
On 4K monitors with fractional system scaling, the interface is either too large or too small, with no option in between.
labels.root_cause: The automatic UI scale forced at least 200% on 4K monitors and ignored the fractional scale the system reported.

labels.symptom: After Flatten Image the Background layer can be moved and Clear erases to transparency.
labels.root_cause: Flatten set only the transparency lock, but Background detection also requires the position lock.

labels.symptom: Color Range selects different areas than expected, and its eyedropper does not work on the image.
labels.root_cause: The colour distance model did not match the reference app's Lab box with quadratic falloff.

labels.symptom: The Zoom Clicked Point to Center preference has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The Zoom tool never read the preference.

labels.symptom: Opening a malformed pattern in a PSD, PAT or ABR file can abort the app while it allocates huge amounts of memory.
labels.root_cause: Channels were allocated one by one before the total size was checked against the budget.

labels.symptom: Live filter and adjustment previews on large images are low resolution and blocky, so fine detail can't be judged before applying.
labels.root_cause: Previews render on a reduced proxy copy of about 2.5 MP.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking a Color Balance slider does not reset it, and arrow keys do nothing below zero.
labels.root_cause: Arrow keys stepped by 0.5, which rounded away on negative values.

labels.symptom: Photoshop action files (.atn) cannot be read.
The New Guide Layout dialog resets to defaults every time it is reopened.
labels.root_cause: Dialog was initialized from hardcoded defaults instead of remembered values.

labels.symptom: While drawing a polygonal lasso, Backspace deletes the whole layer and right-click does not remove the last point.
labels.root_cause: Delete and right-click were not routed to lasso vertex removal during polygon construction.

labels.symptom: Hidden ruler guides still capture clicks and can be dragged or deleted.
labels.root_cause: Guide hit testing ignored Extras and Canvas Guides visibility settings.

labels.symptom: The quick export menu item always says PNG even when another format is configured.
labels.root_cause: Menu label was hardcoded rather than reading the export preference.

labels.symptom: Select › Modify with a negative radius reports success but leaves the selection unchanged, or clears it for Border.
labels.root_cause: The radius validation rejected only non-finite and over-maximum values, then silently clamped negatives to zero.

labels.symptom: Export preferences show JPEG quality for every format and offer no WebP quality settings.
labels.root_cause: Preferences lacked format-specific WebP lossless/quality settings.

labels.symptom: A new adjustment or fill layer ignores the active selection and gets no mask.
labels.root_cause: The layer creation commands did not read the selection.

labels.symptom: In dialogs, Tab visits every button and checkbox instead of only the text fields.
labels.root_cause: egui's default focus order includes every widget.

labels.symptom: Layers and groups cannot be given color labels.
Exported PSD files with empty layers or masks are rejected by Photoshop or other readers.
labels.root_cause: Zero-sized channels were written as empty ZIP-prediction streams instead of raw compression.

labels.symptom: Some dialog labels stay in English in every language even though translation coverage reports 100%.
labels.root_cause: The strings were painted or formatted without tl!, so they never reached the catalogs and the coverage tool couldn't see them.

labels.symptom: In Brazilian Portuguese, different commands such as View and Preview or Flip and Invert show the same label.
labels.root_cause: The pt-br catalog reused one translation for distinct English terms.

labels.symptom: With many documents open, tabs past the right edge of the tab strip are unreachable.
labels.root_cause: The document tab strip laid out tabs at natural width without clamping, scrolling or overflow menu.

labels.symptom: The Mosaic filter is very slow on large images.
labels.root_cause: Cell averages were recomputed per row and cloned per pixel.

labels.symptom: Dragging an item to the edge of a scrolling list panel doesn't scroll the list.
labels.root_cause: Drag and drop had no edge auto-scroll.

labels.symptom: Command-line rendering silently replaces missing fonts with fallback fonts and gives no warning.
labels.root_cause: The CLI never checked for missing font families.

labels.symptom: Imported PSD layers lose their real user masks.
labels.root_cause: The synthetic-mask cleanup used a different predicate from the one that selected the real mask.

labels.symptom: CI logs warn about deprecated Node.js 20 GitHub Actions.
labels.root_cause: Workflows pin old major versions of GitHub Actions that run on Node.js 20.

labels.symptom: Creating a text layer with an invalid kerning value succeeds silently instead of returning an error.
labels.root_cause: type.create did not call check_kerning before applying character properties.

labels.symptom: The automation server's reply to malformed JSON has no id field, unlike its other error replies.
labels.root_cause: The bad-JSON error path built its reply without an "id": null key.

labels.symptom: SVG files cannot be opened as shape layers or placed as vector smart objects.
Dragging one gradient handle makes the other handle move.
labels.root_cause: When scale clamped, the gradient was re-centred on the requested midpoint.

labels.symptom: Last Filter appears to do nothing or applies to the wrong layer.
labels.root_cause: Replay kept the recorded layer id instead of using the active layer.

labels.symptom: Raw files open already developed with default settings instead of in a Camera Raw dialog first.
Thumbnails and filter previews cut off artboard contents in large documents.
labels.root_cause: Proxy downsampling did not scale the artboard clip rectangles.

labels.symptom: Compressed Nikon NEF raw files open only as the low-resolution embedded preview.
labels.root_cause: There was no decoder for Nikon's compressed NEF format (TIFF compression 34713).

labels.symptom: There is no in-app way to report an issue with diagnostics already filled in.
Hovering with the eyedropper does not show a preview of the color under the cursor.
The crop frame can't be moved; dragging inside it draws a new frame.
labels.root_cause: Every drag with the Crop tool started a new frame; there was no move or resize gesture.

labels.symptom: In Show Extras Options, multi-word checkboxes always appear unchecked, and pressing OK fails with 'unknown Show item'.
labels.root_cause: The dialog used camelCase keys, but the Show struct and its command use snake_case field names.

labels.symptom: Shape layers with gradient fills render with the wrong ramp, opacity, position or banding compared to the source file.
labels.root_cause: The shape paint conversion discarded opacity stops, midpoints, offset, dither and align fields of gradient fills.

labels.symptom: Digits in number fields look vertically off-centre, sitting slightly low.
labels.root_cause: Geometric centring ignores that digits have no descenders.

labels.symptom: The up and down arrow keys do not step the value in focused numeric fields.
labels.root_cause: The shared numeric field widget did not handle arrow keys with modifier step sizes.

labels.symptom: Choosing the bit depth the image already has adds an undo step and clears redo.
labels.root_cause: A no-op depth change still opened an edit transaction.

labels.symptom: A keyboard shortcut reassigned to another command still runs its old default command.
labels.root_cause: Default shell-command bindings took priority over user-assigned keys, and panel menu ids were not mapped to the shell commands they run.

labels.symptom: The selection right-click menu has no one-click Delete and Fill Selection.
Dragging a distort corner past the opposite edge folds the box and smears the image.
labels.root_cause: Corner drags were not constrained to keep the quad convex.

labels.symptom: In some themes the Move tool's Auto-Select toggle is missing.
labels.root_cause: Studio themes rendered only a hint instead of the options bar toggle.

labels.symptom: There is no Docker image for self-hosting the browser version.
Pressing Backspace while drawing a polygonal lasso deletes the whole layer instead of the last point.
labels.root_cause: Backspace was not handled by the polygonal lasso and fell through to Edit > Clear.

labels.symptom: Contract, border or feather on a select-all selection appear to do nothing.
labels.root_cause: Selections were treated as continuing past the canvas edge with no option to use the canvas bounds.

labels.symptom: The app reads the whole system clipboard in the background several times a second without any user action.
labels.root_cause: Background polling mirrored the OS clipboard at 4 Hz.

labels.symptom: Transform width/height fields cannot scale beyond 10000% for large documents.
labels.root_cause: UI hard-clamped scale fields to 10000%.

labels.symptom: An open dropdown does not respond to the arrow keys, which act on the canvas instead.
labels.root_cause: The shared dropdown widget did not take keyboard focus when opened.

labels.symptom: After a failed start, the app keeps launching on a slower fallback or CPU renderer even though the GPU was not the cause.
labels.root_cause: Every startup error was recorded as a driver crash, and a failed CPU start left its crash marker behind.

labels.symptom: The built-in title bar buttons do nothing on tiling window managers and look out of place on some Linux desktops.
labels.root_cause: The app always draws its own client-side title bar, with no option to use the system decorations.

labels.symptom: An undo test fails intermittently on CI.
labels.root_cause: Another test changed the process-wide text gamma while tests ran in parallel.

labels.symptom: The notice for a file path that is not valid Unicode is shown untranslated.
labels.root_cause: The notice string did not go through i18n.

labels.symptom: The Brush Settings panel lacks the original app's sections and controls.
The Camera Raw dialog covers the whole window, including its title bar, instead of opening in a separate window.
The Hand tool has no 100%, Fit Screen or Fill Screen buttons.
Drawing a selection with Alt held while nothing is selected produces no selection.
labels.root_cause: Subtract mode was applied even with no existing selection.

labels.symptom: Opening a tiny crafted Netpbm image file makes the app reserve gigabytes of memory or crash.
labels.root_cause: The PNM decoder sized buffers from header dimensions before checking the file length and used unchecked multiplications.

labels.symptom: With many documents open, tabs past the edge of the tab bar cannot be reached.
labels.root_cause: The document tab strip had no eliding or overflow menu.

labels.symptom: Text layers edited in another editor lose their fill when imported from PSD.
labels.root_cause: PSD text import dropped the engine data FillFlag.

labels.symptom: Valid native project files are rejected as an unknown format when the manifest isn't the first entry in the ZIP archive.
labels.root_cause: The importer detected native bundles only when manifest.json was the first ZIP entry, and ZIP offsets were not bounds-checked.

labels.symptom: The workspace clippy gate fails on a newer Rust toolchain.
labels.root_cause: The Rust 1.99 lint chunks_exact_to_as_chunks flags chunks_exact on fixed-width rows.

labels.symptom: Color Range previews sample the wrong pixels on reduced images, and eyedropper hover is sluggish.
labels.root_cause: Previews sampled the reduced thumbnail, and every cache check formatted the full proof ICC profile.

labels.symptom: In the New Document dialog, typing a size in millimetres rewrites the field with stray decimals while you type.
labels.root_cause: The physical-unit value was converted to whole pixels and back on every keystroke, rewriting the text field.

labels.symptom: The side panel dock cannot be hidden to free up screen space.
labels.root_cause: There was no command to toggle the panel dock.

labels.symptom: Side panels resize, switch or disappear on their own, and they can't be resized, collapsed or brought back.
labels.root_cause: Dock group heights followed their content, and there was no persistent layout state for group heights, order or collapse.

labels.symptom: Cancelling a transform after switching documents undoes the last edit in the other document.
labels.root_cause: Cancelling ran undo on the active document instead of the document where the transform began.

labels.symptom: Clipping mask commands act only on the active layer when several layers are selected.
Exporting with a scale that only changes the height writes the image at its original size.
labels.root_cause: The export only computed the scaled width and skipped resizing when the rounded width was unchanged.

labels.symptom: Edits on a video layer frame disappear after moving the playhead and are missing from exports.
labels.root_cause: The video frame stack was never updated with the edited raster, so syncing put the stale frame back.

labels.symptom: The codec documentation says lossy WebP can't be written, although the app writes it.
labels.root_cause: The README was not updated after the VP8 encoder was added.

labels.symptom: Perspective Warp crashes if its planes are replaced while a corner drag is in progress.
labels.root_cause: The drag kept stale plane/corner indices into a list that had been replaced.

labels.symptom: Long translated titles spill past the edges of the cards that hold them.
labels.root_cause: Titles were drawn with Painter::text on one unwrapped line, with no wrapping or elision.

labels.symptom: You can't move several selected layers into a group in one step.
Type layers in PSD files from other tools open empty, and installed fonts are reported missing.
labels.root_cause: Type layers without pixel data were not rendered on import, and PostScript font names were not resolved to the installed family.

labels.symptom: Running Content-Aware Fill on a very large selection crashes the app instead of showing an error.
labels.root_cause: The fill window size was not checked before allocating, so a huge selection caused a panic.

labels.symptom: Keyboard shortcuts shown in menus and tooltips do nothing when pressed, and layer groups can't be expanded or collapsed.
labels.root_cause: The shortcuts shown in menus were not all wired to dispatch their commands.

labels.symptom: Puppet Warp crashes when an Expansion change leaves the mesh with no vertices.
labels.root_cause: Remeshing rebound existing pins to an empty mesh and indexed vertex 0, which does not exist.

labels.symptom: On macOS the display colour profile is not used, and a wall of raw base64 text fills the error notice.
labels.root_cause: Large display IDs coerced with AppleScript 'as integer' came back in scientific notation and failed to parse, and the error quoted the whole raw line.

labels.symptom: On macOS, clicking menu bar items while a modal dialog is open runs commands underneath it.
labels.root_cause: Native menu clicks were invoked directly without the modal check that keyboard shortcuts apply.

labels.symptom: In some themes the Type tool options bar has no font, style or size controls.
labels.root_cause: The options bar showed only a hint for Type tools outside the Pro themes.

labels.symptom: Saving an inactive document changes which document is active.
The Vibrance and Saturation adjustment gives different colours from the reference app; desaturated yellow turns mid grey instead of keeping its brightness.
labels.root_cause: Desaturation used HSL lightness in gamma space instead of a weighted grey in linear light.

labels.symptom: Drag selections and tool gestures start a few points away from where the mouse button was pressed, and text size changes are slow and leave many undo steps.
labels.root_cause: egui reports a drag only after the pointer passes the click distance, and the canvas used the pointer position at that moment instead of the press origin.

labels.symptom: On Wayland, selecting text with Ctrl+A, Shift-arrows or dragging deletes the selected text.
labels.root_cause: Empty IME preedit/commit events sent on caret moves were treated as replacing the selection with nothing.

labels.symptom: In the Layer Style dialog, effects not yet applied show no checkbox until toggled on and off once.
labels.root_cause: Rows for effects absent from the layer were drawn as plain labels without a checkbox.

labels.symptom: In the browser build, closing or reloading the tab discards unsaved work without asking.
labels.root_cause: The web shell registered no beforeunload handler to warn about unsaved documents.

labels.symptom: Some interface strings are untranslated in Polish and translation coverage tests fail.
labels.root_cause: Polish catalog landed without strings added by concurrent PRs.

labels.symptom: On large documents the canvas seems to hang for a long time with no explanation when it falls back to a CPU redraw.
labels.root_cause: The GPU budget fallback composited on the CPU inside the frame and only wrote a log line.

labels.symptom: The scorecard staleness check fails after a preference was added.
labels.root_cause: The generated scorecard was not regenerated after a new preference was added.

labels.symptom: The pipette cursor test fails on every Windows CI run.
labels.root_cause: The test expected the OS crosshair, but on Windows the canvas draws its own crosshair and hides the OS cursor.

labels.symptom: On Linux the Open dialog hides files with uppercase or mixed-case extensions.
labels.root_cause: The native file picker used case-sensitive glob patterns such as *.jpg.

labels.symptom: Playing back a recorded Transform Again action applies the transform twice.
labels.root_cause: Recording stored both the inner transform and the Again wrapper, and playback replayed both.

labels.symptom: Setting a huge view centre through automation crashes the canvas while it draws the selection outline.
labels.root_cause: Unchecked i32 arithmetic on the saturated visible-region corners overflowed.

labels.symptom: A plug-in receives a default parameter value outside its declared min..max range.
labels.root_cause: resolve_params clamped values the caller supplied but not defaults for missing values.

labels.symptom: A plug-in name with invisible or bidi-override characters is accepted and shown as-is in menus.
labels.root_cause: Manifest validation rejected only control characters, not Unicode format (Cf) characters.

labels.symptom: Opening an image whose horizontal and vertical resolutions differ silently drops the vertical resolution.
labels.root_cause: Import kept only the horizontal resolution and gave no warning.

labels.symptom: A single automation click request with a huge count freezes the app or makes it run out of memory.
labels.root_cause: The ui.click handler used count as an unbounded loop bound and queued synthetic input events with no limit.

labels.symptom: Edit › Cut in the native menu is disabled while text is selected in a text edit, though the shortcut works.
labels.root_cause: Menu enablement used the non-text command's state instead of the text editor's selection.

labels.symptom: Pressing an arrow key in a numeric field can crash the app.
labels.root_cause: The arrow-key step used f32::clamp, which panics when the range is reversed or NaN.

labels.symptom: Long translated preset titles in the New Document dialog spill past the edges of their cards.
labels.root_cause: Preset card titles were drawn on one line with no wrapping or eliding.

labels.symptom: With Preview on, changing the arbitrary rotation angle makes the image disappear.
labels.root_cause: The preview's draw parameters used the original document size instead of the grown preview canvas size.

labels.symptom: A PNG with huge text metadata can use memory past the decode limit.
labels.root_cause: Decoded PNG text and XMP chunks were not counted against max_alloc.

labels.symptom: The app crashes at startup when the saved UI font size is anything other than the default.
labels.root_cause: The UI font size rescale ran on egui's default fonts in the first frame, and its set_fonts call overwrote the app's custom font families, so named families were unbound.
bug_markers: is not bound to any fonts

labels.symptom: Cropping to a huge explicit rectangle succeeds, and a later trim or flatten crashes the app on memory allocation.
labels.root_cause: The explicit crop did not cap the canvas side length, so a later full-canvas allocation aborted.

labels.symptom: Motion blur with a long distance is very slow.
An exported PSD with a Photo Filter adjustment layer will not open in Photoshop.
labels.root_cause: The phfl block was padded to 18 bytes when Photoshop needs 4-byte alignment.

labels.symptom: Nikon D4 raw files develop with pale colours, a dark flat tone, a purple stripe and pink highlights.
labels.root_cause: There was no camera profile for the image area, white level, colour matrix or tone curve.

labels.symptom: Edit > Stroke runs right away with fixed defaults and gives no options dialog.
Ctrl/Cmd+Z can't remove the last point placed with the pen tool while drawing a path.
labels.root_cause: The in-progress pen path is not in document history and had no undo of its own.

labels.symptom: A preferences test fails on main because a now-implemented preference is still hidden.
labels.root_cause: The Zoom Clicked Point to Center preference stayed in the hidden-until-implemented list after it was implemented.

labels.symptom: A damaged project file with an extreme tile coordinate loads, then crashes when the layer bounds are read.
labels.root_cause: The loader did not check the tile index range before an unchecked i32 multiplication.

labels.symptom: Holding Alt while using the Liquify brush does not reverse Twirl or swap Pucker and Bloat.
labels.root_cause: Brush strokes ignored the Alt modifier.

labels.symptom: Selection modify commands silently do nothing for a radius of 0 or below the minimum.
labels.root_cause: modify() accepted radii below the dialog's minimum.

labels.symptom: Tools hidden in toolbar customization still appear in the toolbar.
labels.root_cause: The toolbar was built without filtering out hidden tools.

labels.symptom: The paint bucket ignores the All Layers option and samples only the current layer.
labels.root_cause: The bucket fill sampled only the active layer, not the visible composite.

labels.symptom: The CI scorecard check fails on main after several merges each regenerated the generated docs.
labels.root_cause: Several PRs regenerated docs/scorecard.md against different bases.

labels.symptom: The transparency checkerboard slides under the image when panning or zooming, and the pixel grid appears late.
labels.root_cause: The checker was anchored to the viewport instead of the document origin.

labels.symptom: Dragging a puppet warp pin very far away uses huge amounts of memory.
labels.root_cause: The renderer allocated tile bookkeeping for the whole deformed bounds with no budget.

labels.symptom: Only selected adjustment layers can't be exported as a .cube LUT.
Stroked shapes with effects show banding in 16- and 32-bit documents.
labels.root_cause: The shape split was hard-coded to RGBA8.

labels.symptom: The free transform box stays on the previous layer after another layer is selected.
labels.root_cause: The transform session did not end when the active layer changed.

labels.symptom: Radial Blur is slow on large images.
labels.root_cause: Sample transforms and coordinate checks were recomputed for every channel.

labels.symptom: Mesh-warping a selection far off the canvas uses huge amounts of memory.
labels.root_cause: A dense buffer was allocated over the union of the old and warped bounds.

labels.symptom: The arrow keys do not nudge a selection outline, and Shift+arrow moves 1 px instead of 10.
labels.root_cause: Arrows were only handled for Move and Transform, and egui consume_key matched the plain arrow before the modified ones.

labels.symptom: Dividing a slice into a huge grid makes listing the slices extremely slow.
labels.root_cause: slice.divide had no limit on the total part count, and slice resolution is quadratic.

labels.symptom: The font dropdown stays short after a search is cleared, and clicking its search field closes it.
labels.root_cause: egui popups measure their height only when they open, the search field was focused only when the query was empty, and the combo box used CloseOnClick.

labels.symptom: Clicking the Help menu's search field closes the menu or loses focus, so typing does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The mouse release that finishes the Help title click takes focus away from the search field.

labels.symptom: While a crop frame is edited, the pixels past the canvas are not shown.
A TIFF whose alpha channel comes after an unspecified extra sample opens fully opaque.
labels.root_cause: The decoder checked only the first extra sample, and the tiff crate drops samples beyond the colour type.

labels.symptom: Saving a Color Lookup layer to PSD silently changes tetrahedral interpolation to trilinear.
labels.root_cause: PSD has no interpolation setting, and export gave no warning about the loss.

labels.symptom: Users cannot save a custom New Document configuration as a named preset and reuse it later.
Optical kerning on type layers is lost after saving to PSD and reopening.
labels.root_cause: PSD export did not write a document Txt2 block with auto-kern modes or link TySh records by TextIndex.

labels.symptom: The scorecard check fails on main after several merges.
labels.root_cause: Each PR regenerated the scorecard document against its own base.

labels.symptom: UI crate tests fail to compile on main.
labels.root_cause: A test used an unqualified Vec2 whose import had been removed by another merge.

labels.symptom: AVIF images can't be opened or exported.
Undoing a paint stroke switches the selected layer back to an older layer.
labels.root_cause: Each history state stored the layer selection from when it was created, and undo restored that old selection.

labels.symptom: The Mosaic filter is slow on large images.
labels.root_cause: Each sample was read through separate coordinate checks for every channel.

labels.symptom: An automation request that timed out still runs later, so retrying it applies the edit twice.
labels.root_cause: Requests stayed in the UI queue after the reply timeout and were run anyway when the UI drained the queue.

labels.symptom: When a reply is lost, the automation bridge resends the request and the edit is applied twice.
labels.root_cause: BridgeClient::call retried any transport failure, including failures after the request had already been sent.

labels.symptom: The UI crate fails to compile on main after merging the async file dialog change.
labels.root_cause: Some code still used the removed pick_open and pick_save service fields.

labels.symptom: Surface Blur is slow on 16-bit and 32-bit layers.
The generated scorecard docs check fails on main.
labels.root_cause: Several merges each regenerated docs/scorecard.md against their own base.

labels.symptom: While a transform box is scaled or distorted, its reference point stays at its old position instead of moving with the box.
labels.root_cause: The drag handling did not carry the reference point along to the new box.

labels.symptom: Clicking text layers in an imported PSD with the Type tool makes them jump or disappear.
labels.root_cause: Legacy PSD text layers have an off-canvas origin that did not match the visible cached pixels.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Greek.
Very large Satin or Bevel sizes make rendering panic with capacity overflow.
labels.root_cause: Blur widths were not clamped before the box blur kernel was built.

labels.symptom: Pressing Delete or Backspace does not delete the selected item after a slider, dropdown or list row has been clicked.
labels.root_cause: Shortcut dispatch treated Delete and Backspace as navigation keys, so it held them back whenever a non-text widget had focus.

labels.symptom: Shape Blur filter is slow.
A very large Image Size upscale starts allocating without limit and the process runs out of memory.
labels.root_cause: No check on the total pixel count before resampling, and every band was allocated at destination size.

labels.symptom: Fill and adjustment layers cannot use the active path as their vector mask.
After switching documents while a background filter runs, Fade and other follow-up actions are tied to the wrong document.
labels.root_cause: Post-command bookkeeping ran after the previously active document was restored, so it used the wrong document.

labels.symptom: The docs list MCP tool names that the server rejects and leave out some tools.
labels.root_cause: The docs used dotted control-protocol names instead of the underscore MCP tool names.

labels.symptom: Autosave failures go unreported, and the unsaved changes are left without a recovery copy.
labels.root_cause: A revision was marked autosaved when the write was queued, not when it succeeded, and worker errors were never reported.

labels.symptom: Duplicating an artboard shows no visible copy, and the Move tool can't drag artboards.
labels.root_cause: The duplicate kept the original's rect, and auto-select picking skipped artboard groups.

labels.symptom: The marquee selection outline jumps when the mouse is released because it was not snapped to pixels while dragging.
labels.root_cause: The drag preview drew the fractional pointer rectangle instead of the snapped one.

labels.symptom: Nudging a layer at extreme coordinates crashes the app or makes it jump to the opposite side.
labels.root_cause: Rect translate and inflate used unchecked i32 addition, which overflowed.

labels.symptom: Saving a project folder that contains symbolic links can overwrite or delete files outside that folder.
labels.root_cause: Directory-bundle saves and cleanup followed symlinks and removed any .zst file without checking its path.

labels.symptom: The layer Opacity and Fill fields have no pop-up slider, and scrubbing them leaves one undo step per frame.
GPU-rendering UI tests time out on Windows CI with 'The requested Wait timed out before the submission was completed'.
labels.root_cause: egui_kittest waits only 10 s for the GPU and the WARP software adapter on Windows runners can take longer for large renders.
bug_markers: PollError: The requested Wait timed out

labels.symptom: A DNG that has only a default crop size opens uncropped at the full active area.
labels.root_cause: The default crop was applied only when both the origin and size tags were present.

labels.symptom: The Apply Image and Calculations menu items run immediately instead of opening their dialogs.
labels.root_cause: The menu commands ran directly instead of opening their parameter dialogs.

labels.symptom: Layered TIFF export falsely warns that EXIF will be dropped.
labels.root_cause: The EXIF bytes were also passed to the TIFF codec, which doesn't support EXIF, and that triggered the warning.

labels.symptom: After one automation command panics, every later automation call fails with a lock-poisoned error until the session restarts.
labels.root_cause: The headless session Mutex was poisoned by the panic, and later calls treated the poisoned lock as fatal instead of recovering it.

labels.symptom: On short displays, tall menus run past the bottom of the window and cannot be scrolled.
labels.root_cause: The menu popup height limit was too generous, so the scroll area never activated and scroll input was not enabled.

labels.symptom: Asking the automation (MCP) preview for an unsupported document index does not return an error.
labels.root_cause: The MCP preview handler did not validate the document index.

labels.symptom: The pen tool can't reshape the last anchor's outgoing handle, and rounded rectangle corners can't have separate radii.
Blur and resize are slow, and GPU textures for closed documents are not released.
labels.root_cause: Slow accumulator loops in blur and resample; canvas textures kept after a document closed.

labels.symptom: There is no Art History Brush tool.
There is no way to rotate the canvas view.
The i18n coverage test fails because new UI strings lack translations in a recently added language catalog.
labels.root_cause: Strings were added while a new language catalog was in review, so the catalog merged without them.

labels.symptom: Translation completeness test fails because a newly added language catalog lacks recently added strings.
labels.root_cause: A new locale catalog landed concurrently with new strings, missing their rows.

labels.symptom: The i18n coverage check fails because a Greek translation is missing.
labels.root_cause: A new string wasn't added to the Greek catalog.

labels.symptom: On macOS, quitting the app crashes it, or leaves it hanging with no window until you Force Quit.
labels.root_cause: Quit closed the window through eframe while AppKit's run loop was still running, so the Touch Bar KVO observer raised an exception; quitting through NSApplication terminate: avoids this.

labels.symptom: The Windows CI cursor test fails because it expects no crosshair.
labels.root_cause: The test wasn't updated after Windows began showing an OS cursor bitmap with a crosshair fallback.

labels.symptom: Linux users cannot install a release as a single-file Flatpak bundle.
labels.root_cause: Releases did not publish Flatpak bundles.

labels.symptom: The MCP ui_set tool's description leaves out fields it accepts.
labels.root_cause: The tool description was maintained by hand and not kept in sync with the accepted fields.

labels.symptom: Error messages say "a Adjustment layer", and an invalid document index is reported as "no active document".
labels.root_cause: The article in the message template was hard-coded, and the index lookup fell back to the active-document error.

labels.symptom: After saving a document to its own file through automation, the session still reports it as having unsaved changes.
labels.root_cause: A headless save without a path didn't clear the dirty flag for non-native formats.

labels.symptom: Raw decoding was tested only against synthetic files, not real camera files.
On macOS, saving or exporting to an SMB network share fails with 'Operation not supported (os error 45)'.
labels.root_cause: File::sync_all uses F_FULLFSYNC on Apple platforms, which SMB shares reject with ENOTSUP, and the atomic save treats that as a fatal error.

labels.symptom: Canon CR2 raw files ignore the camera's as-shot white balance and use an automatic estimate.
labels.root_cause: The ColorData white-balance offsets count 16-bit words, but the data was read as bytes.

labels.symptom: Alt-clicking the line between two layers to clip or release them does not behave as in Photoshop.
Turning on Small Caps leaves text as normal lowercase with most fonts.
labels.root_cause: Only the OpenType smcp feature was turned on, and nothing was synthesized for fonts that lack it.

labels.symptom: After you edit or clear a pixel mask, the old mask still takes effect.
labels.root_cause: The combined-mask cache was keyed on tile addresses but did not keep those source tiles alive, so the addresses could be reused.

labels.symptom: Images cannot be saved or exported as AVIF.
Imported PSD type layers look cut off on the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The layer's vector mask clips the text; the text bounds are correct.

labels.symptom: Large feathered masks hold a lot of memory, and Purge All does not free it.
labels.root_cause: The combined-mask cache was capped only by entry count and was not cleared by Purge All.

labels.symptom: Huge stroke coordinates sent through automation during a live drag can hang the editor.
labels.root_cause: Live stroke updates skipped the coordinate validation that runs when a stroke is committed.

labels.symptom: Concurrent requests for the same mask each rebuild it, wasting time and CPU.
labels.root_cause: The mask cache had no shared per-key initializer, so concurrent cold builds were duplicated.

labels.symptom: A failed plug-in filter reports a generic cancellation instead of the real error.
labels.root_cause: Parallel bands set only an abort flag, so sibling bands' generic errors hid the originating error.

labels.symptom: Clicking the eye icons on layer effect rows does not hide or show the effects.
labels.root_cause: The eye icons were only painted, and there was no command to toggle effect visibility.

labels.symptom: MCP automation tools follow inconsistent conventions, and a headless video render cannot be cancelled and reports no progress.
Some new interface elements have no Japanese translation.
In the Layers panel, layer names run under the fx badge and other indicators, and there is no way to collapse every group at once.
labels.root_cause: Layer rows drew the name before laying out the right-side indicators, so the name was never truncated.

labels.symptom: Menu commands invoked through automation change the document while a modal dialog is open, leaving the dialog with stale values.
labels.root_cause: The control-channel menu invocation path skipped the modal-menu eligibility check that the native menu applies.

labels.symptom: The automation UI snapshot doesn't report whether a popup picker is open.
labels.root_cause: ui.inspect did not include the picker's open state.

labels.symptom: An MCP client set up exactly as the headless docs show cannot open or save documents.
labels.root_cause: The documented headless MCP registration examples left out the read and write file-root arguments.

labels.symptom: The control-protocol reference leaves out parameters that methods accept and contradicts itself.
labels.root_cause: The method signatures in the docs drifted out of step with the handler implementation.

labels.symptom: Test coverage for reversed Liquify strokes through replay and undo/redo.
Filter dialog previews could be generated for an inactive document tab, and preview computation required a GPU.
labels.root_cause: The preview path did not check the active document index and always uploaded a GPU texture.

labels.symptom: Toggling the System Title Bar preference appears to do nothing because it only takes effect after restart and no notice says so.
labels.root_cause: The preferences dialog showed no next-launch notice for a setting applied only at startup.

labels.symptom: The control docs say Preferences Apply and OK save the settings, but automation refuses both with an error.
labels.root_cause: The docs did not reflect the security policy that refuses whole-preferences updates over control.

labels.symptom: On small displays, long menus run off the screen and can't be scrolled or navigated with the keyboard.
labels.root_cause: Menus had no scroll area or keyboard navigation when taller than the window.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking the menu buttons at the bottom of the Layers panel does not open their menus, and they show no dropdown arrow.
labels.root_cause: The footer buttons only handled primary clicks and lacked a chevron indicator.

labels.symptom: Clicking the gradient preview in the options bar does not open the gradient presets browser.
labels.root_cause: The options-bar gradient swatch was display-only and not wired to the preset browser.

labels.symptom: There is no Color to Alpha filter to make a colour transparent while keeping soft edges.
Opening and saving a PNG throws away its text metadata such as Author, Description and XMP.
labels.root_cause: The document had no field for free-form image text, and the decoder recognised XMP only in iTXt chunks.

labels.symptom: Every painting tool shares one brush instead of each tool keeping its own.
On Linux under Wayland, dragging files onto the window does nothing.
labels.root_cause: Native Wayland mode does not support file drops, and there was no setting to run under X11 or XWayland instead.

labels.symptom: Web build breakage or oversized wasm is only caught at release time.
labels.root_cause: PR CI did not build the web app or run the wasm size gate.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Japanese or other languages.
While a background job is running, the UI stops responding to controls and cancel.
labels.root_cause: Drawing from the UI thread waited synchronously on the shared Rayon pool, which the background job had filled.

labels.symptom: On Windows, building from source fails with what looks like a Cargo error (os error 4551) because Smart App Control blocks the build executables.
labels.root_cause: Smart App Control or application-control policy blocks unsigned build-script executables, and the docs did not list the MSVC C++ workload.

labels.symptom: The scorecard lists preference items as missing or partial even though they are implemented.
labels.root_cause: The scorecard source rows were not updated after the work landed.

labels.symptom: The ui.inspect control reply is missing the documented view preferences object.
labels.root_cause: inspect never serialised the view options.

labels.symptom: After Layer via Copy the selection stays active, so Free Transform moves only part of the layer and leaves a ghost edge.
labels.root_cause: layer_via did not clear the selection.

labels.symptom: After transforming a selection, the layer bounds still include the old, now transparent area.
labels.root_cause: Lifted pixels kept their colour with zero alpha, so they still counted as content.

labels.symptom: A menu command that fails with no document open seems to do nothing because the status bar never shows its error.
labels.root_cause: The default status bar returned early with no document open and skipped drawing status messages; menu-bar errors didn't set the error flag.

labels.symptom: Brush strokes lag with the Navigator panel open, worse on large images.
labels.root_cause: The Navigator thumbnail cache key changed every stroke step, forcing a full recomposite each frame.

labels.symptom: Converting to Indexed Color crashes when the forced colours fill the whole palette.
labels.root_cause: kmeans indexed into an empty list of centres when median_cut returned none.

labels.symptom: Move tool Auto-Select picks a fully locked layer instead of the unlocked layer below it.
labels.root_cause: The layer pick ignored layer locks.

labels.symptom: A CMYK Channel Mixer using the black source imports with the black coefficient silently dropped.
labels.root_cause: The keep-raw guard only fired for Channels::Other, not Channels::Cmyk.

labels.symptom: A PSD whose notes block can't be read opens with no notes and no warning, and saving deletes the notes.
labels.root_cause: Export treated an unparseable Anno block as 'no notes' and dropped it; import swallowed the parse failure.

labels.symptom: In MCP bridge mode, saving a document without a path fails with 'bridge mode needs path' instead of writing back to its own file.
