labels.root_cause: The bridge's save handler rejected a missing path before forwarding to the app's save method, which supports save-back.

labels.symptom: The scorecard's performance summary counts don't add up to the scenario total.
labels.root_cause: A catch-all match arm counted not-run scenarios as tracked.

labels.symptom: Confirming the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog with a malformed value wipes every custom shortcut.
labels.root_cause: A failed parse fell back to an empty map with unwrap_or_default, which was then applied with reset.

labels.symptom: An Inner Glow set to Precise with Center source paints nothing.
labels.root_cause: The distance-outside field was used instead of the distance-inside field.

labels.symptom: Changing or resetting the text blending gamma preference has no visible effect.
labels.root_cause: prefs_set and prefs_reset did not push the gamma to the compositor.

labels.symptom: The README's tool count does not match the app's tools.
labels.root_cause: The README list was written by hand and never updated.

labels.symptom: A layered TIFF saved in Intel byte order opens with every layer invisible.
labels.root_cause: The blending-ranges bytes were byte-swapped as u32 values.

labels.symptom: Zooming stops at 3200% and each further wheel notch slides the view toward the pointer instead of zooming.
labels.root_cause: The zoom field and navigator slider clamped the zoom to a lower limit every frame while wheel zoom moved the view centre, and each zoom path had its own limits.

labels.symptom: The Patch tool seems to do nothing and gives no feedback after you lasso an area.
labels.root_cause: The two-step tool returned early with no message when the drag offset was zero, and nothing prompted the second step.

labels.symptom: In 32-bit documents, the Add and Divide blend modes clip at white.
labels.root_cause: The blend functions always clamped to 1, whatever the bit depth.

labels.symptom: Choosing Save from the unsaved-changes prompt for a layered TIFF closes the document before it is written, and a different tab may be saved instead.
labels.root_cause: save_as returned success while the TIFF Options prompt was still pending, so close went ahead and the later write targeted the active document.

labels.symptom: Dragging an item in a list panel past its top or bottom edge stops autoscrolling.
labels.root_cause: The edge-scroll function only scrolled while the pointer was inside the panel.

labels.symptom: The toolbar colour chips sit off-centre and run into the canvas edge.
labels.root_cause: The chips block was wider than the toolbar column.

labels.symptom: Delete and Backspace cannot be assigned as shortcuts in the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog, and pressing them in a focused panel does not act on that panel.
labels.root_cause: Shortcut capture treated unmodified Backspace/Delete as clear-this-shortcut, and Delete was routed to the canvas selection regardless of panel focus.

labels.symptom: Dragging a layer effect onto another layer does nothing.
labels.root_cause: Effect rows only handled clicks, the fx badge was part of the layer row, and no command existed to move effects between layers.

labels.symptom: In 32-bit documents, the Hue, Saturation, Color and Luminosity blend modes give inverted or wrong colours when values go above 1.
labels.root_cause: The ISO 32000 ClipColor formula assumes luminosity is in the 0..1 range.

labels.symptom: Liquify hangs when a stroke has two points very far apart.
labels.root_cause: The stroke segment loop walked every dab step along its whole length with no limit.

labels.symptom: The title bar always shows a Discord button.
The brush engine lacks most professional brush options, such as tilt, projection, speed-based spacing and mixer settings.
The Indexed Color dialog freezes the window while previewing large images and accepts fractional color counts.
labels.root_cause: The preview was computed on the UI thread and the count was not checked to be a whole number.

labels.symptom: Pressing Cmd+V once pastes the content several times.
labels.root_cause: The native menu key equivalent injected a fake key release on top of the real one from winit, and the paste shortcut handler treated each V release as an image paste.

labels.symptom: Camera JPEGs open at 72 ppi instead of the resolution stored in EXIF, and saving writes a conflicting density.
labels.root_cause: The JPEG reader took the resolution only from the JFIF density and ignored EXIF, XMP and Photoshop resources.

labels.symptom: The eyedropper samples only a single composite pixel and has no sample size or layer options.
Font menus show no font previews and arrow keys do not cycle through fonts.
Undoing a Liquify stroke updates the stroke count, but the image doesn't change.
labels.root_cause: The preview texture was uploaded from proxy pixels that weren't rerendered after the deformation field was rebuilt.

labels.symptom: The eyedropper picks a colour only on the first click; dragging across the image doesn't update it.
labels.root_cause: Colour sampling ran only on pointer-down, not on pointer-move.

labels.symptom: The curve editor's endpoint handles are clipped at the graph corners.
labels.root_cause: The handles were placed on the graph edges with no inset.

labels.symptom: Equalize, Average and Clouds change the layer instead of the targeted alpha channel or Quick Mask.
labels.root_cause: map_pixels always wrote to the active layer and ignored the injected target parameter.

labels.symptom: Affinity files cannot be opened.
The Gradient Map preset picker shows a fixed list of five gradients instead of the user's gradient library.
labels.root_cause: The preset list was hard-coded.

labels.symptom: A retouch stroke between far-apart points runs unbounded work and memory growth instead of returning an error.
labels.root_cause: Retouch commands parsed stroke points without the coordinate bound used by painting commands.

labels.symptom: Document inspection does not report where each smart object's contents come from.
Code comments describe the native menu crate as Tauri's, which suggests the app breaks the no-Tauri rule.
labels.root_cause: Misleading comments calling muda Tauri's menu crate.

labels.symptom: Pressing Esc while drawing with the Pen tool discards the path instead of keeping it.
labels.root_cause: Esc cleared the pen state instead of committing the path.

labels.symptom: A filter dialog shows two competing sliders with different sensitivities for the same parameter.
labels.root_cause: Wide-range parameters created both a linear and a logarithmic slider.

labels.symptom: Adjustment commands with wrongly typed parameters succeed silently and ignore the values.
labels.root_cause: Parsers used lenient JSON accessors instead of the checked reader.

labels.symptom: Some German interface labels are literal, misleading or too long.
Turning off View > Show > Target Path only toggles the checkmark, and path outlines stay visible.
labels.root_cause: The show.target_path flag was never read by the path overlay drawing code.

labels.symptom: Scorecard rows for fixed bugs were still marked missing.
Double-clicking the Hand tool doesn't fit the image on screen.
Ukrainian is not offered as an interface language.
Applying an image adjustment such as Invert to a large layer freezes the app for several seconds.
labels.root_cause: Adjustments ran as one serial per-pixel loop over full-layer buffers on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: The command-dispatch panic guard had no test.
Layer thumbnails of tall documents show white bars at the sides.
labels.root_cause: The checkerboard was painted over the whole square thumbnail cell, including the transparent letterbox bars.

labels.symptom: With a selection active, pressing Enter in the Crop tool doesn't crop to the selection.
labels.root_cause: An untouched default crop frame was always treated as a no-op, even when it came from the selection.

labels.symptom: Rasterizing a feathered vector mask gives the layer a hard edge.
labels.root_cause: Rasterizing used raw path coverage, which ignores feather and density, instead of the combined effective mask.

labels.symptom: Scorecard row for window geometry persistence was still marked missing.
Pressing backslash does not toggle the layer mask overlay.
Dock panels get poor default heights, tab strips overflow at narrow widths, and selecting an item does not scroll it into view.
labels.root_cause: Dock groups used fixed heights and tab strips did not elide their labels.

labels.symptom: Some dialogs opened through automation are invisible to inspection and cannot be filled in, confirmed or cancelled.
labels.root_cause: The control server listed only the main dialog list and missed the separately stored shell dialog.

labels.symptom: The roadmap gives no honest estimate of how close the app is to feature parity.
Release builds queue for a long time behind macOS PR CI jobs.
labels.root_cause: PR CI used up the organisation's shared macOS runners.

labels.symptom: Clicking the mirror tool does nothing, so brush strokes cannot be mirrored.
Tall dialogs push their OK and Cancel buttons off screen in small windows, and dialogs always reopen centred.
labels.root_cause: Dialog bodies were not scrollable, and dialog positions were kept only in temporary per-instance memory.

labels.symptom: The app looks out of place on a GNOME desktop, and brush chips are hard to see on light themes.
Opening the command palette with an empty query shows an arbitrary list instead of recently run commands.
labels.root_cause: The palette kept no record of recently invoked commands.

labels.symptom: Clicking OK in a filter dialog with preview on briefly shows the unfiltered image before the result appears.
labels.root_cause: The preview was dropped before the background filter job finished.

labels.symptom: The app icon on Windows and Linux has squarer corners than the other suite apps.
labels.root_cause: The icon script cropped 22 units off each side of the master tile, cutting into the rounded corners.

labels.symptom: Move and transform ignore Shift/Alt/arrow modifiers, and the transform preview is very blurry.
labels.root_cause: Modifier handling was missing and the transform preview used a low-resolution texture.

labels.symptom: A dropped image layer disappears when you open its Smart Object contents before committing the transform.
labels.root_cause: Switching to the child document cancelled the Free Transform session, which undid the placement.

labels.symptom: Corrupt hex data in a file loads as if it were valid.
labels.root_cause: u8::from_str_radix accepts a leading '+' sign in a hex pair.

labels.symptom: Launching with --control exits with status 0 even when the control server couldn't be set up.
labels.root_cause: Token and workspace setup failures printed an error and returned Ok(()) instead of exiting with a non-zero status.

labels.symptom: The horizontal ruler loses all its ticks and labels when the view is flipped horizontally.
labels.root_cause: The flipped transform reversed the visible range, so the tick loop never ran.

labels.symptom: An image-size automation command reports a new pixel size that was never applied.
labels.root_cause: The command returned the requested size instead of the document's actual size after the command.

labels.symptom: Malformed RAW files open rotated unexpectedly.
labels.root_cause: The EXIF orientation was narrowed to u16 before the 1..=8 range check, so out-of-range values wrapped into the valid range.

labels.symptom: Contributors might add webview shells such as Tauri to a native app.
A bitmap conversion with an unknown halftone shape silently uses round dots and reports success.
labels.root_cause: HalftoneShape::from_id mapped unknown ids to Round.

labels.symptom: The Type tool's font style list shows the wrong entries for some fonts.
labels.root_cause: Style names were read wrongly from certain fonts.

labels.symptom: Strict LLM providers reject every request when the app's MCP tools are loaded.
labels.root_cause: MCP tool schemas used $ref, $defs and boolean schemas that strict validators reject.

labels.symptom: Adding a new layer gets very slow once a document has many layers.
labels.root_cause: Creating, undoing or redoing a new layer marked the whole canvas as damaged, so every layer was recomposited.

labels.symptom: Filling a large document freezes the app for over a second while the canvas refreshes.
labels.root_cause: Changed tiles were converted and uploaded one at a time on the UI thread, with no reuse of shared tiles.

labels.symptom: Simplified Chinese and Korean text in the UI shows as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: Only one Japanese system font was registered as the CJK UI fallback, and it lacks Hangul and simplified-only Han.

labels.symptom: Define Pattern names the pattern automatically without asking for a name.
labels.root_cause: The menu item ran the command directly instead of opening its dialog, and the name parameter was declared with the wrong type.

labels.symptom: GPU vs CPU parity test fails on NVIDIA by one f32 rounding step.
labels.root_cause: The 1/255 tolerance left no room for f32 rounding.

labels.symptom: Committing a selection on a large document freezes the canvas for seconds.
labels.root_cause: Every edit, even one that changes no pixels, triggered a full recomposite.

labels.symptom: GPU UI tests crash with a segfault in the Vulkan loader when several Vulkan drivers are installed.
labels.root_cause: Several GPU test harnesses created wgpu instances at the same time on parallel threads without a shared lock.

labels.symptom: In the browser build an export command downloads nothing and fails silently.
labels.root_cause: The export wrote through a filesystem write function whose wasm32 version always fails instead of using the browser download service.
bug_markers: no file system on the web

labels.symptom: New adjustment and fill layers have no mask when nothing is selected.
labels.root_cause: A mask was created only when a selection or path was active.

labels.symptom: The roadmap overstates how close the app is to parity with the commercial original.
In the Japanese interface, command names in History and tooltips use different words from the same commands in the menus.
labels.root_cause: Command-name translations were added separately from the menu translations and used different terms.

labels.symptom: The Fill dialog lists patterns by name only, with no swatches.
After editing layers, Restore Last Document State in layer comps loses the edited layout.
labels.root_cause: last_applied_comp stayed set after edits, so the backup was skipped.

labels.symptom: Saturation and Lightness slider tracks are plain grey instead of showing hue colours.
The Windows MSI installs silently with no wizard, folder choice or option to launch afterwards.
labels.root_cause: The MSI had no WixUI dialog set.

labels.symptom: Save As and Export dialogs don't open in the current document's folder, so you have to browse back to it every time.
labels.root_cause: The native file picker was only given a filename, not the suggested parent directory.

labels.symptom: Clicking the tab of a collapsed panel selects the tab but leaves the panel collapsed.
labels.root_cause: The tab strip set the selected tab without clearing the panel's collapsed state.

labels.symptom: The New Document dialog always opens at default size and resolution instead of the last used settings.
labels.root_cause: The dialog's last values were not saved in preferences.

labels.symptom: Very large documents fall back to slow CPU rendering, use huge amounts of memory, or crash.
labels.root_cause: egui-wgpu requests an 8192 px max texture dimension and each layer was one texture, so oversized canvases left the GPU path.

labels.symptom: Free Transform on a selected path shows a box but does not move the path.
labels.root_cause: Ctrl+T always started the pixel transform tool, even with a path selected.

labels.symptom: Fujifilm RAF raw files cannot be opened.
In Free Transform, edge handles always stretch one axis and Shift has no effect.
The web build offers only the embedded fonts, and variable fonts list only their default style.
labels.root_cause: Fonts could only be embedded in the wasm, and variable-font axes were not exposed as styles.

labels.symptom: The interface cannot be shown in Dutch.
Automation requests to create a new document with invalid parameters succeed silently with fallback values.
labels.root_cause: New-document parameters were not validated, so typos and out-of-range values fell back to defaults.

labels.symptom: The crop frame cannot be rotated by dragging outside it.
Selection tools show no add/subtract cursor badge, there is no scrubby zoom, outlines are invisible on light images, and Shift does not constrain brush strokes.
labels.root_cause: Tool feedback cursors, scrubby zoom and stroke constraints were not implemented, and previews used a hard-coded single colour.

labels.symptom: Automation refuses to edit the contents of embedded smart objects with a filesystem-access error.
labels.root_cause: The automation policy blocked these commands as ambient filesystem access even when the source was embedded in the document.
bug_markers: uses ambient filesystem paths and is disabled

labels.symptom: The brush preset grid sits off centre, and only the first row of each group is indented.
labels.root_cause: horizontal_wrapped after add_space indents only the first line, and the spare width was all left on the right.

labels.symptom: Clicking OK in the Selective Color dialog fails with an error about an array parameter, and junk number fields appear.
labels.root_cause: The dialog spec parser read trailing notes after the parameter object as parameters.

labels.symptom: The Open dialog does not start in the last-used folder.
labels.root_cause: File dialogs were opened without setting a starting directory.

labels.symptom: Without a usable GPU, the pixel grid at high zoom covers empty transparent areas too.
labels.root_cause: The CPU canvas fallback drew a full grid lattice instead of following the GPU shader's rule.

labels.symptom: The eyedropper samples only a single composite pixel and has no sample size or layer options.
Raw decoding was tested only against synthetic files, not real camera files.
Layer blending can give wrong colors after a tile because the Lab-mix and HDR blend-space flags are cleared.
labels.root_cause: in_blend_space cleared the blend-space flags after each tile instead of restoring their previous values.

labels.symptom: Running the corpus task with --all --update-manifest does not refetch every manifest.
Layer effects cannot be dragged onto another layer, and Alt-dragging them does not copy them.
Dragging a filter slider with preview on makes the window unresponsive.
labels.root_cause: Filter previews ran inline in the frame draw on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: Erasing on the locked Background layer shows the brush but leaves the pixels unchanged.
labels.root_cause: The eraser only removed opacity, which a layer with locked transparency cannot lose, so it never painted the background colour instead.

labels.symptom: Cmd+K opens Search instead of Preferences, unlike the reference app's defaults.
Importing a deeply nested or highly compressed SVG crashes the app with a stack overflow or huge memory use.
labels.root_cause: The XML parser recurses once per nesting level with no depth limit, and svgz inflation had no size cap.

labels.symptom: Raw files from some Sony cameras look washed out and include border pixels.
labels.root_cause: cRAW files without a BlackLevel tag defaulted to black level 0.

labels.symptom: With the system title bar enabled, the app icon and title appear twice, and the OS title doesn't show the open file.
labels.root_cause: The in-app title bar was still drawn in system title-bar mode, and the viewport title was never updated.

labels.symptom: Document tabs cannot be reordered by dragging and have no Reveal in Finder item.
Layer rows lack vector-mask thumbnails and link chains, and Channels/Paths panels miss temporary entries.
Pressing the pen barrel button often fails to open the right-click menu, so it has to be pressed repeatedly.
labels.root_cause: The menu opened on egui secondary_clicked, which needs a press and release without movement, and pen jitter breaks it.

labels.symptom: Paste inserts an old image even after text or something else has been copied to the system clipboard.
labels.root_cause: The session kept the last mirrored clipboard image after the OS clipboard no longer held an image.

labels.symptom: Transparent PNG or TIFF images open as an unlocked layer named Background instead of Layer 0.
labels.root_cause: The flat image importer always named the layer Background, whether or not the image had alpha.

labels.symptom: On non-square documents, percentage grid spacing draws square cells and snaps to the wrong lines.
labels.root_cause: The document width was used for both axes, and snapping used a single spacing value.

labels.symptom: New fill layers in Grayscale or CMYK documents show unconverted RGB colours until flattened or reopened.
labels.root_cause: Fill-layer creation commands stored RGB colours without converting them to the document's colour mode.

labels.symptom: Pattern fill layers in CMYK or Lab documents come back empty after saving to PSD and reopening.
labels.root_cause: PSD export rendered pattern fills with no patterns, so it stored transparent pixels that were kept on import in CMYK/Lab.

labels.symptom: Properties panel sections look inconsistent and offer no quick actions for each layer kind.
The app cannot run on Android phones.
Print Size view ignores the Screen Resolution preference.
labels.root_cause: Print Size used a hard-coded 72 ppi.

labels.symptom: Individual docked panel tabs cannot be closed from a right-click menu.
Imported adjustment layers whose settings can't be read open with no effect and no warning.
labels.root_cause: Unreadable adjustment blocks were kept as Unsupported without any warning.

labels.symptom: The 'Use Escape to commit' type preference has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The preference was not wired into the type tool.

labels.symptom: Equivalent Levels and Curves adjustments produce different pixels.
labels.root_cause: Curves applied per-channel curves before the master curve, opposite to Levels.

labels.symptom: Exporting the same image to PNG gives different file bytes on machines with different CPU core counts.
labels.root_cause: The parallel PNG writer split rows into bands based on the thread count, so the deflate output depended on core count.

labels.symptom: The placeholder-text preference for new type layers has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The preference was not wired into the type tool.

labels.symptom: On macOS the unsaved-changes prompt shows accelerator letters in its button labels, unlike native alerts.
labels.root_cause: Button labels included mnemonic markers on every platform.

labels.symptom: Converting a pattern fill layer to a smart object loses its pattern.
labels.root_cause: The embedded document was created without copying the parent document's pattern library.

labels.symptom: GPU tests fail or crash on FreeBSD with the RADV driver.
The 'Lowercase extension' preference does nothing when saving files.
labels.root_cause: The preference was never applied to save-dialog paths.

labels.symptom: Tab characters in text show up as missing-glyph boxes.
labels.root_cause: Literal tab characters were sent to font shaping without being replaced by whitespace.

labels.symptom: Dialogs forget the last-used settings every time they open.
labels.root_cause: Schema-generated dialogs rebuilt default values on every open.

labels.symptom: Dialogs are hard to drag unless the pointer is exactly on the title text.
labels.root_cause: The drag area was sized to the title label instead of the whole title row.

labels.symptom: Loading a LUT requires typing a file path by hand.
labels.root_cause: The Color Lookup editor had no file picker and open dialogs lacked extension filters.

labels.symptom: Rotating with Free Transform shows a generic cursor and no live angle readout.
labels.root_cause: The transform tool had no rotation cursor and no angle feedback.

labels.symptom: After a large brush library is imported, the app uses several GB of memory at every start.
labels.root_cause: Every imported brush tip was decoded at full resolution at startup and kept in memory twice.

labels.symptom: Some PSD files render or import incorrectly compared with the reference app.
labels.root_cause: PSD import and compositing edge cases found by the psd-tools corpus.

labels.symptom: Patterns show in colour in Grayscale or CMYK documents.
labels.root_cause: Compositors drew pattern pixels without converting them to the document's colour mode.

labels.symptom: Some PSD files do not decode or round-trip correctly (padding, transparency matte, CMYK colour).
labels.root_cause: Tagged blocks were aligned wrongly, transparent composites were matted wrongly, and ZIP streams were not fully validated.

labels.symptom: Opening a crafted or corrupt ZIP-based project file can use huge amounts of memory or crash.
labels.root_cause: The DEFLATE reader preallocated using the untrusted uncompressed size and overflowed computing max+1 for an unlimited limit.

labels.symptom: A pending crop box carries over to a new or switched document and Enter crops the wrong document.
labels.root_cause: Pending crop state was global UI state not tied to a document.

labels.symptom: Arrow keys don't nudge the crop box and there is no size readout.
An embedding app cannot hide the icon rail and the menu bar.
Scrolling the mouse wheel over the blend-mode menu does not step through the modes.
Outer Glow fills the interior of a shape layer whose Fill is 0%.
labels.root_cause: Outer glow compositing lacked the fill-transparency knockout used for drop shadows on CPU and GPU.

labels.symptom: Quick Selection floods whole similar regions instead of selecting around the stroke.
labels.root_cause: The algorithm modelled stroke colours globally rather than matching the reference app's local behaviour.

labels.symptom: Quick stylus taps leave full-pressure marks even when the pen is pressed lightly.
labels.root_cause: A release was also treated as a click, which drew a second stroke at pressure 1.0.

labels.symptom: Spot Healing with Proximity Match leaves repeated values and streaks in the healed area.
labels.root_cause: copy_within on the output buffer let overlapping regions read pixels that had already been modified instead of the original pixels.

labels.symptom: Healing with extreme search settings can be very slow or overflow.
labels.root_cause: Search radii weren't limited to the image size, and squared distances could overflow integer arithmetic.

labels.symptom: Gradients can't be edited after they are drawn because they aren't live gradient fill layers.
Deflate-compressed DNG files fail to open with an unsupported error.
labels.root_cause: DNG compression 8 with TIFF predictors was not implemented.

labels.symptom: Ukrainian wording for eyedropper and color picker options is unclear or ungrammatical.
With display scaling above 100%, the 100% zoom setting shows content larger than actual pixels.
labels.root_cause: The canvas mapped one document pixel to one logical point and ignored pixels_per_point.

labels.symptom: The app does not follow the system's light or dark mode.
labels.root_cause: There was only one saved theme and no detection of the OS appearance.

labels.symptom: In the web build on WebGPU the GPU renderer fails at once and the app falls back to CPU rendering.
labels.root_cause: A WGSL float literal slightly above f32::MAX is rejected by Chrome's Tint compiler, and the real error is lost because error scopes are popped too early.

labels.symptom: Clicking the gradient tool swatch does nothing instead of opening a gradient editor.
A submenu whose items are all disabled still looks enabled and opens onto greyed items.
labels.root_cause: The submenu enabled check was any_enabled || !child.is_empty(), which is true for every non-empty submenu.

labels.symptom: Some settings in Preferences have no effect when changed.
labels.root_cause: The preferences were stored but never read by the UI.

labels.symptom: Keyboard shortcut sets from the commercial app cannot be imported.
Imported gradient overlays with Smooth interpolation show the wrong opacity ramp.
labels.root_cause: The Smoo interpolation method was treated as Classic and was not applied to opacity stops.

labels.symptom: Clicking Play in the Actions panel does nothing when no action is selected.
labels.root_cause: Playback depended only on the selected index and errors were ignored silently.

labels.symptom: Recorded actions can't be exported to a file or imported from one.
Text layers imported from PSD files can't be edited as text.
labels.root_cause: Imported PSD type data was turned into a static fallback layer, not live text.

labels.symptom: The browser build runs heavy image operations on a single thread, so they are slow.
labels.root_cause: Parallel code paths are gated off for wasm32, so the web build never uses rayon or Web Workers.

labels.symptom: Trash deletes the whole layer when the mask is selected, and double-clicking a solid fill thumbnail doesn't open the color picker.
Paint.NET .pdn files cannot be opened.
Clicking website, Help-menu or Discord links does nothing, especially on Windows.
labels.root_cause: egui's ctx.open_url and hyperlink_to aren't reliably handled by eframe on native.

labels.symptom: In the About window's contributor table, the header scrolls away, columns shift when sorting and some are clipped.
labels.root_cause: Column widths were not measured up front, and the header was inside the scroll area.

labels.symptom: Imported brush files lose their folder hierarchy and land in one flat group.
labels.root_cause: The ABR phry hierarchy section was skipped during parsing.

labels.symptom: In the Studio themes, the colour chips use the old overlapping-square style.
On some Linux desktops Alt-click does nothing in the canvas because the window manager takes it to move the window.
labels.root_cause: Desktops like Cinnamon, MATE, Xfce and older KDE grab Alt+left-press for window dragging.

labels.symptom: Gradients with hard stops show gray blending on the canvas where the export is a clean edge.
labels.root_cause: The GPU samples gradients through a 4096-entry LUT that interpolates across coincident stops.

labels.symptom: Chisel bevels show stair-step stripes on edges that are not at a multiple of 45°.
labels.root_cause: The distance was measured to the nearest pixel centre of a thresholded mask, so it rippled along oblique edges.

labels.symptom: Selecting one of two identical brushes highlights the wrong one and edits deselect the brush.
labels.root_cause: Selected preset was found by comparing brush settings rather than identity.

labels.symptom: User-visible strings still mention the commercial app that this app copies.
labels.root_cause: Labels, messages and translations were hard-coded with the commercial product's name.

labels.symptom: PDFs cannot be opened page by page or exported from multiple tabs into one PDF.
After Save As on a new document, the tab and title still show Untitled instead of the chosen file name.
labels.root_cause: A successful save did not update the document's name, path and saved revision.

labels.symptom: The colour swatches in the Fill and Stroke dialogs open a basic popup instead of the full Color Picker.
16/32-bit and Lab PSD files render with wrong pixels.
labels.root_cause: Gradient fill geometry and adjustment layers did not match Photoshop's behaviour.

labels.symptom: Lossy-compressed DNG raw files refuse to open with an unsupported error.
labels.root_cause: The raw decoder had no handler for DNG compression 34892 (baseline JPEG tiles).

labels.symptom: Stroking a selection draws half-transparent edges and draws nothing along the canvas border.
labels.root_cause: Center strokes straddled the edge by w/2, and distances were measured only inside the canvas.

labels.symptom: The crop overlay button does nothing and the crop box always shows rule of thirds.
Very large layered PSB or EXR files fail to open or run out of memory.
labels.root_cause: Files were decoded with whole-image and whole-channel allocations and uploaded to the GPU in full, with no tiled scratch storage.

labels.symptom: Thai text shows as empty boxes when the chosen font has no Thai glyphs.
labels.root_cause: The font fallback list had no Thai-capable families, and the system script fallback was disabled.

labels.symptom: Clicking with a shape tool does nothing instead of opening a dialog to enter the size.
labels.root_cause: A click with no drag produced geometry under 1 px, so shape creation returned early.

labels.symptom: Affinity documents with special parametric shapes don't import correctly.
The History panel's Delete current state and New Document buttons do nothing.
labels.root_cause: The button clicks were discarded.

labels.symptom: Value dialogs open with no field focused, so you have to click into a field and clear it before typing.
labels.root_cause: Dialogs did not request focus on their first number field when they opened.

labels.symptom: A test fails on Windows CI because the path in an error message doesn't match.
labels.root_cause: Debug formatting escapes backslashes in Windows paths, so a substring match on the raw path fails.

labels.symptom: Focus-stacked blends keep artifacts from per-pixel mask errors and halos around bright objects.
labels.root_cause: The merged layer came from blending per-pixel one-hot masks rather than fusing per pyramid level.

labels.symptom: A New Document dialog opened through automation does not match the size of the image on the clipboard.
labels.root_cause: The control server's path did not use the clipboard-aware dialog initializer.

labels.symptom: JPEG XL-compressed DNG raw files open only as a low-quality 8-bit preview.
labels.root_cause: There was no decoder for DNG compression 52546.
bug_markers: JPEG XL-compressed DNG is not supported

labels.symptom: Layer style and text style settings use compact colour popups instead of the shared Color Picker.
The documentation claims more image format support and gives older decode limits than the app actually has.
labels.root_cause: The docs were not updated to match the codec capability tables.

labels.symptom: Choosing a different workspace preset leaves the panel layout the same as the default.
labels.root_cause: The workspace match returned the same layout for every preset.

labels.symptom: Converting several selected layers to a Smart Object converts only one of them.
labels.root_cause: The conversion targeted a single layer instead of every selected layer root.

labels.symptom: Gradients with hard stops look different on the GPU than on the CPU.
labels.root_cause: The GPU sampled gradients through a 4096-entry lookup table instead of evaluating hard stops exactly.

labels.symptom: Imported brush presets disappear after reloading the browser tab.
labels.root_cause: Browser build did not persist imported presets to IndexedDB.

labels.symptom: Several View menu toggles, such as Pixel Aspect Ratio Correction and Show Mesh, change only their checkmark and nothing on the canvas.
labels.root_cause: No code outside the view commands reads the view flags and pixel aspect fields.

labels.symptom: A vector-masked pattern fill reopens from PSD as a shape layer covering the whole canvas.
labels.root_cause: The PSD importer treated pattern-filled vector-masked fills as shape layers.

labels.symptom: Auto-Align fails on focus or exposure brackets with 'couldn't find enough matching detail'.
labels.root_cause: Alignment relied only on feature matching, which fails on nearly identical frames.

labels.symptom: The preference usage test fails on main because one preference read looks unused.
labels.root_cause: A test module placed above the code hid the preference read from the audit scan.

labels.symptom: Saving a large document freezes the window with no progress and the OS marks it Not Responding.
labels.root_cause: Encoding and writing ran on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: Auto-blending a focus stack cannot produce a depth map for lens blur.
Very tall documents with many styled layers use tens of GB of memory and stop responding.
labels.root_cause: Effect maps for shapeless layers were built over the whole canvas and kept for every layer at once.

labels.symptom: Expanding, contracting or bordering a selection is slow and gives wrong distances on images wider than 4096 pixels.
labels.root_cause: Serial column distance transform using f32 parabola intersections that lose precision past coordinate 4096.

labels.symptom: On GNOME, after launch the pointer keeps showing a spinning 'starting' cursor even though the window is already open.
labels.root_cause: The desktop entry sets StartupNotify=true, but the app never completes the startup-notification handshake.

labels.symptom: Users want a Solarized Dark UI theme.
While Free Transform is open, the preview ignores changes to layer opacity or visibility.
labels.root_cause: The preview used the opacity and document snapshot taken when the session began and never refreshed them.

labels.symptom: Image rotation rotates only the active layer instead of the whole canvas.
Notices stay on screen until you close each one by hand.
labels.root_cause: Notices had no timer to hide them.

labels.symptom: Healing with proximity match is slow on large holes.
labels.root_cause: A full-region summed-area table was built and every candidate SSD computed to completion without pruning.

labels.symptom: Layer style colours render as RGB in Grayscale or CMYK documents.
labels.root_cause: Commands that create effects stored their RGB colours without converting them to the document's colour mode.

labels.symptom: The 32-bit Preview Options dialog is wider than the window, so its controls and buttons are cut off.
labels.root_cause: Each slider took the full available width and its numeric field added more beside it, so the dialog had no width limit.

labels.symptom: Releases are not versioned and drafted automatically.
Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: Releases ship only standalone Flatpak bundles with no hosted OSTree repository.

labels.symptom: Brush strokes in mask view appear only after the mouse button is released.
labels.root_cause: The mask texture was built from the committed document instead of the live stroke preview.

labels.symptom: In the browser, non-Latin text such as Arabic shows as boxes in the default font.
labels.root_cause: Served fonts were not registered as per-script fallbacks.

labels.symptom: Brush strokes glide, begin with a straight segment and no pressure ramp-in, and a held airbrush does not build up.
labels.root_cause: Stroke points from the canvas always had time 0 and the first pointer moves of a press were dropped.

labels.symptom: Caps Lock state can't be detected, so features that depend on it do nothing.
labels.root_cause: egui and winit expose no Caps Lock key or modifier state, so the OS has to be polled directly.

labels.symptom: Fast pen strokes show stair-stepped line weights because pressure changes in jumps.
labels.root_cause: The stylus feed kept only the latest sample per frame so all moves shared one pressure value.

labels.symptom: Clicking the Add Mask button a second time, or Alt-clicking it, deletes the layer's existing mask.
labels.root_cause: The mask button ran Reveal/Hide All commands that replace the layer mask instead of adding a vector mask.

labels.symptom: The app seems to close on launch and hangs without a window while loading a large crash-recovery autosave.
labels.root_cause: Recovery snapshots were decoded synchronously during app construction, blocking startup.

labels.symptom: Multi-part EXR files whose first part is depth-only fail to open.
labels.root_cause: The decoder always used part 0.

labels.symptom: No benchmark tracks the cost of resizing a chisel bevel layer effect.
The crop tool has no Straighten option for levelling the image by drawing a line.
The crop shield has a fixed colour and opacity, and there is no way to hide the cropped area.
There is no searchable in-app documentation and no place for personal notes.
Releasing a long brush stroke on a large canvas freezes the UI for a moment.
labels.root_cause: When the stroke was committed, it was drawn a second time on the UI thread and its whole bounding box was composited and uploaded again.

labels.symptom: Non-DNG raw photos look flat, grey and slightly green next to the camera's own rendering.
labels.root_cause: Non-DNG raws have no colour calibration, so they were developed with a neutral fallback.

labels.symptom: Cloud and heart shapes in imported Affinity files have inaccurate outlines.
labels.root_cause: The cloud and heart outlines were hand-tuned instead of derived from Affinity's shape parameters.

labels.symptom: Clicking a hyperlink in the About dialog does nothing, and the console logs that links are not enabled.
labels.root_cause: egui's hyperlink relies on ctx.open_url, which needs the egui_winit "links" feature, and that feature is not enabled.
bug_markers: Cannot open url - feature "links" not enabled

labels.symptom: Editing keywords in File Info removes unrelated metadata translations.
labels.root_cause: Every submitted field was rewritten into XMP, not just the fields that changed.

labels.symptom: Mask edge refinement with large shift radii is slow on big images.
labels.root_cause: Morphology ran one 3x3 pass per radius step.

labels.symptom: The Preferences dialog stays at a fixed size and does not grow or shrink with the window.
labels.root_cause: The Preferences dialog used a hard-coded fixed size.

labels.symptom: Menus show the wrong Enable/Disable Layer Mask label whatever the mask's current state.
labels.root_cause: Menu labels were hard-coded instead of derived from the mask state.

labels.symptom: Saving as TGA drops the document's alpha channel, so the file has only RGB.
labels.root_cause: Flat exports never read the document's channels, so TGA alpha came only from layer transparency.

labels.symptom: In command search, typing a command's exact name does not list that command first.
labels.root_cause: Equal fuzzy scores were broken alphabetically and exact matches got no boost.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking a layer mask thumbnail does not open Select and Mask.
labels.root_cause: The preference to launch Select and Mask on a mask double-click was hidden and not wired up.

labels.symptom: Changing a bevel effect's size on large images is about twice as slow as it used to be.
labels.root_cause: Distance fields were computed in overlapping bands, one after another, with single-threaded CPU passes.

labels.symptom: A layer mask thumbnail does not update after an invert or another whole-mask edit.
labels.root_cause: The thumbnail cache key ignored the surface's default pixel, so edits that only changed it did not invalidate the cache.

labels.symptom: Soft brushes paint hard-edged strokes and thin lines look beaded.
labels.root_cause: The soft tip used a smoothstep falloff that saturates when dabs overlap, and small dabs were point-sampled at pixel centres.

labels.symptom: No menu option makes the interface theme follow the system light/dark appearance.
labels.root_cause: Theme menus lacked an Auto/System entry and only one egui style branch was written.

labels.symptom: When no Arabic system font is installed, Arabic text has no fallback font and Arabic families are missing from the font picker.
labels.root_cause: The bundled Arabic craft fonts were not registered.

labels.symptom: The Smudge tool ignores the brush spacing setting.
labels.root_cause: Retouch commands defaulted spacing to a fixed 25% instead of using the session brush's spacing.

labels.symptom: Popup menu buttons need a click and then a second click; you can't press, drag onto an item and release to pick it.
labels.root_cause: egui Popup::menu opens only on a full click, without press-drag-release handling.

labels.symptom: The Opacity and Fill labels in the Layers panel don't line up on the right.
labels.root_cause: Zero item spacing set for the lock icons also applied to the Fill label in the same row.

labels.symptom: Contributors are not told which docs to read for a task or where to report performance measurements.
A layer with Lock All can still be deleted.
labels.root_cause: Layer deletion did not check explicit Lock All on targets, ancestors or descendants.

labels.symptom: The preference to open documents as tabs is ignored.
labels.root_cause: The preference was hidden and not wired up.

labels.symptom: Cryptomatte ID layers in EXR files can't be read.
CI workflows show Node 20 deprecation warnings.
labels.root_cause: The workflows pin GitHub Actions versions that run on the deprecated Node 20 runtime.

labels.symptom: Copying and pasting layers loses their editable layer masks.
labels.root_cause: The whole-layer clipboard path did not carry masks.

labels.symptom: The docs don't explain how to register the MCP server from an installed release.
labels.root_cause: The docs covered only source builds; installers don't put the CLI on PATH.

labels.symptom: No RISC-V Linux builds are published.
Deleting the active layer jumps the selection to the top layer instead of a neighbouring one.
labels.root_cause: After deletion the engine selected doc.top_layer() instead of a neighbouring layer.

labels.symptom: The macOS app cannot check for or install updates by itself.
There is no Remove tool for filling painted areas from their surroundings.
A preferences-usage test fails on main, reporting preferences as unread.
labels.root_cause: A test module declared at the top of a file hid the rest of the file from a source-scanning test.

labels.symptom: Pen pressure feels choppy and there is no way to change the pressure response curve.
Clicking the Layers trash button deletes layers without asking for confirmation.
On some Intel GPUs the app crashes as soon as an image is opened, with "Format Rgba32Float is not renderable".
labels.root_cause: Render pipelines used Rgba32Float targets without checking whether the adapter can render to that format.

labels.symptom: Targeting a layer mask does not switch the foreground and background colours to white and black.
labels.root_cause: There was no separate colour pair for masks, and adding a mask did not target it.

labels.symptom: While transforming a layer, the parts outside the canvas stay visible on the pasteboard.
labels.root_cause: The transform preview mesh was clipped to the viewport, not to the document bounds.

labels.symptom: Content-aware fill smears texture instead of copying it, and the patch tool has no content-aware mode.
labels.root_cause: The fill algorithm, sampling area and colour adaptation differed from the reference behaviour.

labels.symptom: On Linux the window edges are hard or impossible to grab for resizing, show the wrong cursor, and stop responding after a resize.
labels.root_cause: Custom title bar resize zones used cursor names missing from some themes, were too thin, and the compositor swallowed the button release after BeginResize so the edge stayed pressed.

labels.symptom: On Linux with NVIDIA, choosing CPU rendering mode makes the app fail to start with no graphics adapter found.
labels.root_cause: CPU mode restricted the wgpu instance to GL, which cannot present on NVIDIA EGL, with no Vulkan fallback.

labels.symptom: On large images, filter previews show features at a different scale than the applied result.
labels.root_cause: The preview ran on a downscaled proxy without scaling each filter's pixel-size parameters to match.

labels.symptom: Translated button labels in a dialog are wider than their column and overlap nearby content.
labels.root_cause: The buttons were laid out without wrapping, so longer translated labels overflowed.

labels.symptom: Layer style effect names are untranslated or mistranslated in Russian.
Code comments describe the wrong order for applying Levels and Curves channels.
labels.root_cause: The comments were not updated after the evaluation order was fixed.

labels.symptom: Automation commands refuse absolute file paths even when they lie inside the allowed root.
labels.root_cause: The automation path check accepted only relative paths and rejected drive prefixes.
bug_markers: drive, device and stream prefixes are not allowed

labels.symptom: The brush picker can't be scaled and its display settings aren't remembered.
Shape layers only offer stroke width and colour in the UI, with no dash, cap, join or alignment options.
The app is not listed in the Omarchy app catalog.
labels.root_cause: There is no omastore.toml manifest.

labels.symptom: On Wayland, pasting an image copied in another app does nothing, and copied images can't be pasted into other apps.
labels.root_cause: arboard was built without the wayland-data-control feature, so it used only the X11 clipboard.

labels.symptom: The Hand tool shows a four-arrow move cursor on Windows and a plain arrow while panning.
labels.root_cause: winit maps Grab/Grabbing to IDC_SIZEALL on Windows, and the grabbing cursor branch was unreachable during drags.

labels.symptom: Duplicated smart objects no longer share contents; editing one doesn't update the other.
labels.root_cause: Duplicates did not keep a shared contents identity.

labels.symptom: SVG files cannot be selected in the Open or Place file picker, and mislabeled files fail to import.
labels.root_cause: The file dialogs had no SVG filter and the format was detected from the extension, not the file contents.

labels.symptom: Borders between the title bar, toolbar and panels look two pixels thick in places instead of a hairline.
labels.root_cause: Panels drew their own outlines by hand on top of the outline egui::Panel already draws.

labels.symptom: Automation commands with misspelled, wrongly typed or out-of-range parameters report success and silently use defaults or clamped values.
labels.root_cause: Command parameters were not validated against documented bounds before running.

labels.symptom: Applying an image adjustment to a smart object changes its pixels permanently instead of adding an editable smart filter.
labels.root_cause: Adjustment commands always took the destructive path, even on smart object layers.

labels.symptom: Builds and tests are not checked on FreeBSD.
RAW files without camera calibration open with generic colours, and there is no Auto tone button.
labels.root_cause: No bundled camera profiles were available.

labels.symptom: The web build fails its wasm size gate.
labels.root_cause: The JPEG XL decoder (jxl-oxide) pushed the wasm over the 24 MiB limit.

labels.symptom: Saving a layered edit of a flat image suggests the original flat format and risks overwriting the original file.
labels.root_cause: Save defaulted to the source format even when that format cannot keep layers.

labels.symptom: Smart selection that finds nothing clears the existing selection and appears to do nothing.
labels.root_cause: In Replace mode, an empty result cleared the current selection.

labels.symptom: In small windows the toolbar buttons overflow and become unreachable, and the collapse button does nothing.
labels.root_cause: Toolbar columns had no scroll area and collapse was blocked under a height threshold.

labels.symptom: Layer effects in imported PSD files render differently from the original.
labels.root_cause: Effect blend modes stored as long string IDs were ignored, and spread used the wrong distance metric.

labels.symptom: Pixel mask Density and Feather cannot be edited in Properties.
The mode buttons stay stacked vertically when the toolbar has two columns.
labels.root_cause: The mode buttons always used a vertical layout.

labels.symptom: Importing a CSV with quoted multiline text cuts the text and creates extra rows.
labels.root_cause: The importer split records on line breaks before handling quotes.

labels.symptom: Holding Cmd/Ctrl with painting tools didn't switch to the Move tool temporarily.
Dragging with the Move tool on a locked layer does nothing and shows no message.
labels.root_cause: There was no check for locked layers before the move started.

labels.symptom: On 4K monitors the controls are too small because the UI scale preference is ignored.
labels.root_cause: The UI scale preference was stored but never applied to the egui zoom.

labels.symptom: The cursor over a selection does not show whether a press will cut, copy or drag the pixels.
On first launch a keyboard shortcut set found on the computer was applied without asking.
labels.root_cause: auto_import applied the set without asking first.

labels.symptom: Numeric fields don't accept parentheses, powers or constants, and some fields accept only plain numbers.
labels.root_cause: The shared expression parser was limited, and some numeric inputs bypassed it.

labels.symptom: With several layers selected, Rasterize converts only the active layer.
labels.root_cause: The rasterize commands and their enable rules looked only at the active layer.

labels.symptom: Layer menu items are enabled based on the active layer while commands act on the selection or another layer.
labels.root_cause: Enable rules and command targets used the active layer instead of the selected layers.

labels.symptom: The Clone Stamp tool has no opacity or flow settings.
labels.root_cause: The options bar did not expose opacity and flow, and strokes did not use them.

labels.symptom: OpenRaster (.ora) files can't be opened or saved.
Pasting a very long string into a numeric field such as Zoom makes the app stall while it lays out the text.
labels.root_cause: The shared numeric input widget had no length limit, so oversized text went straight to egui text layout.

labels.symptom: Large layered documents are very slow, and moving a layer can freeze and then crash the app.
labels.root_cause: Every layer was composited over the whole canvas in one GPU submission, which lost the GPU device.

labels.symptom: The scorecard lists features as missing or partial even though they are already implemented.
A page that embeds the web build cannot load a document into it or get the edited document back.
There is a blank gap of a few pixels between the document tab bar and the canvas in some themes.
labels.root_cause: egui's default vertical item spacing is added after the tab strip is allocated.

labels.symptom: With several text layers selected, font changes apply to only one of them.
labels.root_cause: Formatting commands targeted only the active text layer.

labels.symptom: Exports and automation inputs can write outside the chosen folder through path traversal or symlinks.
labels.root_cause: Output paths and automation inputs were not confined or validated, and imported slice HTML was not escaped.

labels.symptom: On FreeBSD, GPU tests crash with a segfault, the RAM size is guessed, and CJK text has no fallback font.
labels.root_cause: wgpu devices were created at the same time on llvmpipe, RAM was not read via sysctl hw.physmem, and the FreeBSD Noto CJK font paths were not listed.

labels.symptom: Release builds download unpinned tools and actions without checking them.
labels.root_cause: Release workflows used mutable action tags and downloads with no checksum.

labels.symptom: Magic Wand selection follows hidden image content inside fully transparent areas.
labels.root_cause: Fully transparent pixels kept their RGB values, and the wand compared those invisible colours.

labels.symptom: Thai characters in file names and paths show as square boxes in the user interface.
labels.root_cause: The fallback font loader only loaded fonts for CJK characters, not Thai.

labels.symptom: Long undo histories use too much memory and have no RAM or disk limits to configure.
Unsaved documents and their undo history are lost when the app crashes.
The eraser is locked out on the Background layer after clicking its lock button.
labels.root_cause: The simple lock button toggled lock-all instead of unlocking the layer.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking a preset in the New Document dialog does not create a document.
The app has no way to check for or notify about new releases.
The File menu has no Open Recent list.
A crash, full disk or killed process during a save can destroy the previously saved file.
labels.root_cause: Documents were written in place with fs::write instead of being written to a temp file and renamed.

labels.symptom: While drawing a polygonal selection zoomed in, moving past the viewport edge does not scroll the canvas.
labels.root_cause: No edge autoscroll during polygonal lasso.

labels.symptom: The Studio theme's dotted canvas background cannot be turned off.
A fresh checkout fails to build with no hint about which prerequisites are missing.
labels.root_cause: Prerequisites are only described in docs and CI YAML; nothing checks for them.

labels.symptom: Effect labels in the Layer Style dialog stay highlighted after their checkbox is unticked.
labels.root_cause: Label colour combined enabled state with page selection.

labels.symptom: Popup menus have different spacing from the main menus, and hovered items have poor text contrast.
labels.root_cause: Secondary menus did not use the shared popup styling.

labels.symptom: You cannot press a grouped tool, drag into its flyout and release over another tool to select it.
In a narrow panel, the Opacity label overlaps neighbouring controls.
labels.root_cause: The blend-mode dropdown kept a fixed minimum width regardless of available space.

labels.symptom: With the Hand tool selected, dragging a Free Transform handle pans the view instead of resizing.
labels.root_cause: The Hand tool's pan branch and event suppression took over the pointer even while a transform box was open.

labels.symptom: Stroke layer effects on imported shape layers look different from the original file.
labels.root_cause: Strokes were built from the layer's pixels instead of the shape's vector outline.

labels.symptom: Changing the UI Scale setting also magnifies the image on the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The canvas zoom was not divided by the full pixels_per_point (already fixed earlier).

labels.symptom: Crop and marquee size readouts and the Properties panel fields stay in pixels when rulers are set to another unit.
labels.root_cause: Those readouts formatted values in pixels instead of the ruler unit.

labels.symptom: There is no theme that matches KDE Plasma's Breeze look.
Multi-part EXR files cannot be imported as separate layers.
Retouch tools paint the layer pixels even when a mask or channel is targeted, and Sample All Layers is ignored.
labels.root_cause: run_stroke never checked the paint target, and the Sample All Layers checkbox was never passed to the command.

labels.symptom: With Colorize on and saturation at 0%, Hue/Saturation still tints the image.
labels.root_cause: Saturation was floored at 25% in both the CPU and GPU paths.

labels.symptom: The app never says when a newer version is out and has no way to download or install updates.
labels.root_cause: No update check or updater exists.

labels.symptom: Valid ICC DeviceLink profiles are reported as invalid or corrupt.
labels.root_cause: The LUT channel check assumed 3 output channels.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab do not switch between open documents.
labels.root_cause: No commands were bound to these shortcuts, and focused widgets took the Tab key.

labels.symptom: iPhone HEIC photos open with slightly wrong colours.
labels.root_cause: The HEIF decoder ignores the HEVC VUI colour signalling and falls back to BT.709 limited range.

labels.symptom: Artboards in current Affinity .af files open as ordinary masked shapes on one canvas.
labels.root_cause: The reader only recognized the legacy ABEn flag and not the phrp/aprp artboard properties.

labels.symptom: Size dialogs open with no field focused, so you have to click into the first field before typing.
labels.root_cause: Dialogs that draw their own body skipped the first-number-field auto-focus logic.

labels.symptom: On Linux, opening a file from the file manager while the app is running starts a second app window instead of opening the file in the existing window.
labels.root_cause: There was no single-instance mechanism on Linux/BSD, so every launch started a separate process.

labels.symptom: With a Chinese interface, file-open progress messages and some panel labels still appear in English.
labels.root_cause: Background job progress messages and some panel labels were not passed through translation when drawn.

labels.symptom: Re-saved PSD files can't be read by other PSD readers.
labels.root_cause: Export wrote smart object data under the wrong block key and padded global blocks to even lengths instead of 4.

labels.symptom: The Dehaze adjustment gives poor results and can damage shadow detail.
labels.root_cause: Dehaze used a simple luminance correction instead of a per-pixel transmission estimate.

labels.symptom: On minimal Linux systems the app panics at start-up because libxkbcommon-x11 is missing, and the web build's wasm file is too big for some hosts.
labels.root_cause: winit and wgpu load libraries with dlopen, so the package dependencies didn't list them.

labels.symptom: Fujifilm lossless compressed RAF files open only as their embedded JPEG preview.
labels.root_cause: No native decoder for compressed RAF strips.

labels.symptom: The app cannot check for or install updates from the About dialog on Windows.
Content-Aware Fill opens a generic parameter dialog, not a workspace where you paint the sampling area and see a live preview.
Large textured brush strokes lag while painting.
labels.root_cause: Brush rasterization and compositing run on a single thread with costly per-pixel math.

labels.symptom: On Windows, after an MSI install, the taskbar button and the shortcuts show a blank page icon instead of the app icon.
labels.root_cause: The MSI's advertised shortcut uses an Icon Id with no file extension, so the shell can't read the cached icon (ICE50).

labels.symptom: There are no performance budgets or a scorecard tracked in CI.
Holding Shift with the polygonal lasso does not snap segments to 45-degree directions.
labels.root_cause: Shift angle constraint was not implemented for the polygonal lasso.

labels.symptom: Dragging the Opacity or Fill label does not change the value; only dragging the number works.
labels.root_cause: Labels were not draggable scrub controls.

labels.symptom: The Align and Distribute panel has no buttons to make horizontal or vertical spacing equal.
labels.root_cause: The panel never exposed the existing distribution commands.

labels.symptom: Colour profile tests fail on Debian/Ubuntu hosts with colord installed.
labels.root_cause: The malformed colord x11-colors.icc named-colour profile fails to parse and the test did not skip it.

labels.symptom: While painting, the brush preview shows hard polygon wedges, then snaps to the real stroke on release.
labels.root_cause: The preview used a thick egui polyline, which folds over itself when the line is much wider than the spacing between pointer samples.

labels.symptom: On some Windows systems the custom-title-bar window shows black bars at the top and left, and the mouse pointer hits the wrong controls.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 gives undecorated windows WS_CAPTION | WS_BORDER, and the compositor offsets the surface by that frame while input stays at the client origin.

labels.symptom: Shortcuts using period or comma with Shift never fire on Nordic and German keyboard layouts.
labels.root_cause: Shortcut matching used logical keys, so Shift+period arrived as colon and matched a different shortcut.

labels.symptom: The scorecard check fails on main.
labels.root_cause: A change edited the scorecard data without regenerating docs/scorecard.md.

labels.symptom: Pressing F2 does not rename the selected layer.
Stroke Path paints on a layer whose pixels are locked or that has Lock All set.
labels.root_cause: Stroke Path checked only the transparency lock, not the pixel or all locks inherited from groups.

labels.symptom: On narrow windows or at high UI scale the document title is drawn over the menus and title-bar controls.
labels.root_cause: The title was centred in the title bar without accounting for the space taken by the menus and right-hand controls.

labels.symptom: Fill Path paints outside the active selection.
labels.root_cause: path_fill ignored the selection mask.

labels.symptom: The automation job listing shows finished jobs before running ones.
labels.root_cause: The ended jobs were chained before the running jobs, against the documented order.

labels.symptom: Local test runs are slow because test binaries link with full debug info and run one after another.
labels.root_cause: Dev profile used full debuginfo and there was no parallel test runner config.

labels.symptom: Documents opened through automation save to the wrong place, such as the filesystem root, when the app was started with / as its working directory.
labels.root_cause: Documents opened through automation kept relative paths as their desktop save destinations instead of canonical absolute paths.

labels.symptom: Every redraw of a large document with several feathered masks freezes the app for seconds.
labels.root_cause: The combined-mask cache was too small and thrashed, rebuilding masks with a single-threaded blur.

labels.symptom: After Merge Down, multi-layer duplication or a transparent canvas extension, the Background layer's locks are lost or kept when they should not be.
labels.root_cause: Those operations did not keep the distinction between a locked Background and an ordinary layer.

labels.symptom: Transforming a selection moves the whole linked layer mask, so the mask no longer lines up with the pixels.
labels.root_cause: The transform warped the whole linked mask instead of only its selected region.

labels.symptom: Save and export dialogs don't remember the folder each document was last saved to.
A PSD with type layers, re-saved without edits, can no longer be opened by Photoshop.
labels.root_cause: The document-wide Txt2 block was rebuilt from scratch, which dropped keys and style runs and re-encoded strings.

labels.symptom: Layer comps copied into a duplicated document report missing layers and don't restore their layout.
labels.root_cause: Duplication gave layers new IDs without remapping the layer comp references.

labels.symptom: Sending a key with the Ctrl modifier over the automation channel succeeds but triggers no shortcut on Windows or Linux.
labels.root_cause: The control server set the ctrl and command modifiers independently, but egui matches shortcuts on command, which must equal ctrl off macOS.

labels.symptom: Hovering over a font in the font picker doesn't preview it on the text.
Save As on macOS has no file format selector, and on Windows some writable formats are missing from the list.
labels.root_cause: rfd merges its save filters into a single AppKit allowed-type list, and the Windows format list was hard-coded.

labels.symptom: Batch export overwrites files whose names collide but still reports each as exported.
labels.root_cause: Sanitized output filenames were not checked for collisions before writing.

labels.symptom: Quick Selection strokes are slow on large documents.
labels.root_cause: Max-flow path augmentation was repeated on large graphs.

labels.symptom: The Linux build instructions list only Debian package names, so installing prerequisites fails on Arch and Fedora.
labels.root_cause: The docs gave only apt package names.

labels.symptom: Some smart object menu commands fail with 'pass path' because no file picker opens.
labels.root_cause: No file dialog was wired to these menu commands.

labels.symptom: Raw photos from some Canon cameras open with a magenta cast.
labels.root_cause: The CR2 reader assumed an RGGB colour filter pattern for every Canon model.
bug_markers: Canon sensors are RGGB from the top-left of the image area

labels.symptom: Replaying a recorded layer selection on another document fails or picks the wrong layer.
labels.root_cause: Recorded actions stored numeric layer ids instead of layer names.

labels.symptom: While a file opens, a long file name wraps the progress card title and pushes the Cancel button outside the card.
labels.root_cause: The opening card had a fixed size and its rows were laid out without a height limit or truncation.

labels.symptom: There is no quick way to switch to a favourite theme without opening the settings.
After inverting a layer mask, the canvas shows tile-sized blocks that are not inverted.
labels.root_cause: The GPU compositor's staleness check ignored changes to a surface's default pixel, so tiles that are not stored kept the old value.

labels.symptom: The Remove tool on an empty layer runs for seconds and adds an undo step that changes nothing.
labels.root_cause: The fill ran even when the sampled window was fully transparent.

labels.symptom: Grayscale OpenEXR and HDR exports store display-encoded values instead of linear ones.
labels.root_cause: The export path's convert_rgb returns None for gray layouts, so gray samples were written as stored.

labels.symptom: Some Preferences settings do nothing, and the recent files list is lost after a restart.
labels.root_cause: Many preference keys were never read, and the recent files list was never written to preferences.

labels.symptom: Exported images show the original, unedited photo as their thumbnail in file browsers.
labels.root_cause: Exports copied the source's EXIF, including the embedded IFD1 thumbnail.

labels.symptom: Image Size resampling gives different results from the reference app, and some bicubic methods are missing.
labels.root_cause: Bicubic used Catmull-Rom with different sampling positions, and Bicubic Smoother, Bicubic Sharper and Automatic were not implemented.

labels.symptom: Missing fonts cannot be downloaded and installed from inside the app.
Menus are very slow to respond when a large document is open.
labels.root_cause: Every frame the menu bar rebuilt all its items, and each enabled-state check did an expensive document lookup.

labels.symptom: The Color panel's field stays small when the panel is made taller.
labels.root_cause: The field height was fixed at 120 pt.

labels.symptom: Text set to vertical orientation is still drawn horizontally.
labels.root_cause: The vertical orientation was stored, but the text layout engine had no vertical layout.

labels.symptom: At high zoom the pixel grid shows false contours across smooth areas of the image.
labels.root_cause: The grid colour switched between white and black at a luminance threshold.

labels.symptom: Test builds are slow because every integration test file links its own binary.
labels.root_cause: There is one test binary per tests/*.rs file.

labels.symptom: Some window titles and buttons stay in English when another interface language is selected.
labels.root_cause: Some UI strings were hardcoded and not wrapped for translation.

labels.symptom: Holding Shift while dragging a marquee selection doesn't make it a square, and there is no draw-from-centre option or size readout.
labels.root_cause: The marquee preview and commit passed a hard-coded false for the shift constraint.

labels.symptom: Some noise filter dialog labels stay in English in the Spanish UI.
labels.root_cause: The Spanish catalog was missing translations for these labels.

labels.symptom: Edit > Fill refuses an adjustment layer's mask with 'not a pixel layer'.
labels.root_cause: edits_mask() did not list edit.fill or the fill keys.

labels.symptom: Renaming a layer strips its leading and trailing spaces.
labels.root_cause: The rename command stored the trimmed name.

labels.symptom: Very tall documents with stroked layers take a very long time to composite.
labels.root_cause: Layers with tsly off were composited across the whole canvas instead of only the area the stroke affects.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking with a pen's barrel button does nothing, even though mouse right-click works.
labels.root_cause: winit's Windows pointer handling drops the Windows Ink barrel-button flags during hover and contact.

labels.symptom: Document sizes in inches, millimetres, centimetres and picas show too few decimal places.
labels.root_cause: The dialogs used a shared one-decimal formatter, and the per-unit decimal counts were wrong.

labels.symptom: Panel tabs can't be detached into floating groups and redocked.
While being transformed, a layer is drawn above the layers that should cover it.
labels.root_cause: The transform preview drew the moving pixels over the whole composite.

labels.symptom: Layer commands that name a layer explicitly fail when no layer is selected, and Deselect Layers errors when nothing is selected.
labels.root_cause: The availability check ignored the command parameters and required an active layer.

labels.symptom: A 32-bit TGA opens with its alpha as layer transparency instead of as an alpha channel, so it loses alpha when saved again.
labels.root_cause: The importer mapped the alpha to layer transparency.

labels.symptom: The crop tool cannot crop to a specific width, height and resolution.
labels.root_cause: Crop only supported ratio presets.

labels.symptom: Moving a selection while a layer mask is targeted moves the layer pixels instead of the mask.
labels.root_cause: select.float ignored the mask target.

labels.symptom: Filter previews show features several times larger than the applied filter produces.
labels.root_cause: Filters were previewed on a downscaled proxy without scaling their pixel-size parameters.

labels.symptom: The CLI's MCP bridge and serve commands ignore the control-port environment variable and start a headless session instead of connecting to the running app.
labels.root_cause: The CLI's mcp and serve commands only read the port from flags, not from the CONTROL_PORT environment variable.

labels.symptom: Automation requests that time out return a bare "timeout" error that doesn't say whether the command is slow or the window stopped drawing frames.
labels.root_cause: The control server used one generic timeout string for both queued-never-dispatched requests and long-running commands.

labels.symptom: A bevel with a contour renders much narrower and weaker than expected.
labels.root_cause: The bevel height went through the glow-style range stretch.

labels.symptom: The script Browse file picker shows image formats instead of script files.
labels.root_cause: The picker was opened without an extension filter.

labels.symptom: Opening a camera raw file gives a confusing TIFF error or opens only the small preview.
labels.root_cause: Raw files are TIFF-structured and were sent to the TIFF decoder.
fixed_markers: camera raw files (such as CR2, NEF, ARW or DNG) are not supported

labels.symptom: Japanese and Chinese text wraps at the wrong places because word segmentation isn't available.
labels.root_cause: Parley's complex-scripts feature was off, so no dictionary segmenter was available for CJK.

labels.symptom: Committing a Distort at an extreme angle leaves transparent, broken areas in the image.
labels.root_cause: Per-tile source bounds were computed from corners mapped through the inverse homography even when a tile crossed the horizon.

labels.symptom: On Alpine, NixOS or AppImage installs, startup prints a warning about missing X11 libraries even though they are installed and the app runs fine.
labels.root_cause: When `ldconfig -p` can't be read, the startup library check falls back to a fixed list of directories and warns about any library it doesn't find there.
bug_markers: could not find these libraries the X11 session needs

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Arabic.
Automation calls through the MCP bridge fail after the agent pauses for more than 30 seconds, or time out with no diagnostics.
labels.root_cause: The bridge kept one persistent connection that the control server closes after 30 s idle, and its 60 s call timeout raced the app's 60 s reply deadline.
bug_markers: operation may have completed; inspect state before retrying

labels.symptom: Linked smart objects don't update when their source file changes while the document is open.
Ctrl+S on a flat PNG or JPEG opens the save dialog instead of saving over the file.
labels.root_cause: Save in place was only allowed for native and PSD/PSB formats.

labels.symptom: Saving through the automation channel freezes the window, and large saves time out.
labels.root_cause: The control server's save handler encoded and wrote the file on the UI thread inside drain_control.

labels.symptom: The app crashes when the GPU device is lost during heavy rendering instead of falling back.
labels.root_cause: wgpu's default device-lost/uncaptured-error handlers panic and the canvas kept using invalid buffers.

labels.symptom: Some filter dialogs fail with 'invalid type: floating point 1.0, expected u32' because whole numbers arrive as floats.
labels.root_cause: The schema dialog sends numeric values as JSON floats, and serde rejects them for u32 fields.

labels.symptom: The Use Smart Quotes preference does nothing when typing text.
labels.root_cause: The smart quotes setting was not read by the text input path.

labels.symptom: A zoomed-out filter preview shows strokes and textures several times larger than what is actually applied.
labels.root_cause: The preview filtered a subsampled image with unscaled pixel-sized parameters instead of filtering at full resolution and then downscaling.

labels.symptom: Alt+dragging a layer onto itself or below the last layer does not make a copy.
labels.root_cause: The Layers panel only accepted drops inside another row's rect.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking the Zoom tool does not zoom to 100%.
Automation paths that look like the workspace root or climb out of it must be refused.
Selection feather comes out half as wide as expected.
labels.root_cause: The Gaussian sigma was set to radius/2 instead of the radius.

labels.symptom: Copy, paste, fill or transform on very large images can crash when memory runs out.
labels.root_cause: Full-image buffers were allocated infallibly, so a failed allocation aborted the app.

labels.symptom: The Dynamic Color Sliders preference did nothing.
labels.root_cause: The setting was never wired to the slider drawing.

labels.symptom: With Resample off, the Image Size dialog shows pixel edits that will be ignored.
labels.root_cause: The dialog accepted pixel width and height edits even though resample-off only changes the resolution.

labels.symptom: Side panel tabs can't be moved, pulled out into their own panel, or brought back once closed.
labels.root_cause: The side panel was a fixed set of groups wired by hand through an enum and match blocks.

labels.symptom: Font menus give no sign of whether a font family covers Arabic.
The Resize Image During Place preference had no effect on placed images.
labels.root_cause: Place always fitted large images regardless of the preference.

labels.symptom: The Warp Text dialog ignores the layer's current warp and shows no live preview.
labels.root_cause: The dialog always opened with fixed defaults and had no preview path.

labels.symptom: The Always Create Smart Objects When Placing preference does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The preference was never read.
