labels.symptom: The crop tool rotates the box instead of turning the image behind an upright box.
Automation calls with an invalid filter option silently run with the default and report success.
labels.root_cause: Choice parameters for the extended filters were not validated.

labels.symptom: Drawing a new crop inside the default frame gets pulled away from the pointer by snapping, even with snapping turned off.
labels.root_cause: Snapping treated drawing a new crop as moving the canvas-sized default frame and used edge snapping.

labels.symptom: Stylus strokes paint at full pressure because tablet pressure and tilt are ignored on macOS and Linux.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 drops tablet data on macOS and Linux.

labels.symptom: Layers using certain blend modes look wrong when Fill is below 100%.
labels.root_cause: Fill was treated as plain opacity instead of being applied inside the blend for the special eight modes.

labels.symptom: Colour channels turn back on when hidden while an alpha or mask is shown, and the Magic Wand samples RGB instead of the visible channel.
labels.root_cause: Channel visibility forced RGB on and selection ignored the visible channel.

labels.symptom: Ctrl/Cmd plus an arrow key does not nudge the selected object.
labels.root_cause: egui's consume_key never ignores an extra Ctrl/Cmd modifier.

labels.symptom: Select Modify Smooth leaves half-selected pixels along the edges.
labels.root_cause: A soft contrast curve was used instead of a hard threshold at one half.

labels.symptom: Pressing Shift just after mouse-down but before dragging makes a marquee selection add to the old selection instead of replacing it with a square.
labels.root_cause: The marquee selection mode was read when the drag was recognised instead of at mouse press.

labels.symptom: The color panel offers no cube, wheel or slider-set modes.
Selecting a layer mask does not switch the foreground and background swatches to black and white.
labels.root_cause: Mask target sync was not called when a mask was selected.

labels.symptom: A one-pixel-wide marquee selection shows while dragging but disappears on release.
labels.root_cause: Release deselected any rectangle under 2 px, which disagreed with the preview.

labels.symptom: Select Modify Border gives a thin hard ring instead of a soft band.
labels.root_cause: Border was built as expand minus contract, not as a distance-based soft band 2r wide.

labels.symptom: The layer outline shows the previously selected layer and trails behind it while moving.
labels.root_cause: The outline was painted before tool events, from the committed document instead of the preview.

labels.symptom: On macOS with the native menu bar, Cmd+C/X/V does not work in text fields.
labels.root_cause: AppKit consumes the shortcuts as menu key equivalents, so text fields get plain key presses instead of Copy/Cut/Paste events.

labels.symptom: Some colour swatches open a basic popup instead of the full color picker, and they show and store the wrong shade.
labels.root_cause: color_edit_button_rgb treats values as linear RGB, but the stored values were sRGB.

labels.symptom: No European Portuguese interface language is available.
With Show Channels in Color on, a single colour channel shown on the canvas stays gray while its thumbnail is tinted.
labels.root_cause: The canvas channel overlay hard-coded in_color = false instead of reading the preference.

labels.symptom: The nightly performance regression check never actually runs.
labels.root_cause: The only perf baseline came from a developer machine whose class never matched the CI runner, so the comparison was always skipped.

labels.symptom: Trackpad pinch always zooms the canvas, even with the pinch-zoom preference turned off.
labels.root_cause: Pinch zoom was not gated by the preference, and on Windows the raw-input hook always turned Ctrl+wheel into a pinch.

labels.symptom: Iris Blur is slow on large images.
labels.root_cause: Pin geometry was recalculated repeatedly and halo margins that cannot affect the output were still blurred.

labels.symptom: Opening and saving large images is slower than it needs to be.
labels.root_cause: Redundant allocations and copies happen in the codec and compositing code.

labels.symptom: Opening a native document saved in directory form over the automation channel fails with 'automation read path is not a regular file'.
labels.root_cause: The automation workspace read path only accepted regular files, so directory bundles were rejected.
bug_markers: automation read path is not a regular file

labels.symptom: Dragging the Zoom tool on a rotated canvas moves the point that was under the mouse.
labels.root_cause: The drag anchor ignored the view rotation and mirroring.

labels.symptom: Menus say "Reveal in Finder" on Windows and Linux.
labels.root_cause: The label was hard-coded with macOS wording on all platforms.

labels.symptom: The Type units preference did not change the units shown for type sizes.
labels.root_cause: The preference was never wired to the type panels.

labels.symptom: Facet and Color Halftone filters are slow on large images, especially CMYK and Lab.
labels.root_cause: The same quadrant statistics and dot radii were recalculated for neighbouring pixels.

labels.symptom: In a normal-sized window the Language option in Preferences is pushed out of view below large theme previews, so users can't switch away from the OS language.
labels.root_cause: Large theme preview cards filled the Interface preferences page and pushed the Language dropdown below the visible area.

labels.symptom: Manual and optical kerning in PSD text is lost when the file is opened and saved again.
labels.root_cause: Import mapped Optical kerning to Metrics and dropped manual kerning values, and export wrote every run with Kerning 0.

labels.symptom: Clicking between the letters of a text layer with Auto-Select picks the layer below.
labels.root_cause: The hit test used the alpha of a single pixel instead of the text bounds.

labels.symptom: In 32-bit HDR documents, adjustment layers and stack statistics clip highlights to 1.0.
labels.root_cause: Float adjustment and statistics paths clamped values to the 0..1 range.

labels.symptom: Content-Aware Scale is very slow on large images.
labels.root_cause: The full-resolution energy map was recomputed for every removed seam.

labels.symptom: On KDE the application menus do not appear in the global menu bar, or show stale labels and states.
labels.root_cause: No D-BusMenu global menu integration; property changes not signalled via ItemsPropertiesUpdated.

labels.symptom: An automation command with an unknown filter option name is silently ignored and reports success.
labels.root_cause: The set_choice return value was not checked, and gallery filters had no parameter validation.

labels.symptom: Opening and saving a PSD silently removes the layer's Blend If settings.
labels.root_cause: Layer blending ranges were parsed but not modelled, and full ranges were always written.

labels.symptom: CJK characters in the interface sit higher than the Latin text next to them.
labels.root_cause: egui centres a fallback font's row inside the primary font's row, so a CJK face with a large line gap rides above the Latin baseline.

labels.symptom: Free Transform opens on a locked layer and only fails when the transform is committed, so the work is lost.
labels.root_cause: The transform entry point had no lock check; locks were only checked at commit.

labels.symptom: Entering a colour value that contains non-ASCII characters causes an internal error.
labels.root_cause: Hex colour strings were byte-sliced into pairs, which can split a multibyte UTF-8 character.

labels.symptom: When quitting with several unsaved documents, answering No leaves the tab open, so the same prompt seems to repeat.
labels.root_cause: Discarded documents were only crossed off a list and not closed until the end.

labels.symptom: After Save As to a flat format like JPEG, Ctrl+S opens a Save As dialog instead of saving the original layered file.
labels.root_cause: Save As to a flat format replaced the document's path and name with the exported file.

labels.symptom: Hover previews in dropdown lists flicker as the pointer crosses the gaps between rows.
labels.root_cause: egui leaves gaps between list rows where no row counts as hovered, so the preview falls back to the current value.

labels.symptom: Shift-clicking New Group creates an empty group instead of grouping the selected layers.
labels.root_cause: The button did not check for the Shift modifier.

labels.symptom: Converting a Duotone document to RGB, CMYK or Lab turns it neutral gray.
labels.root_cause: The conversion used the stored gray pixels and ignored the inks.

labels.symptom: Legacy Brightness/Contrast gives results that are too dark when both sliders are moved.
labels.root_cause: Contrast was applied before brightness, with a half-level pivot error.

labels.symptom: Ruler tick marks and labels draw over the corner square where the two rulers meet.
labels.root_cause: Ruler drawing used a painter clipped to the whole canvas area instead of to each ruler's own strip.

labels.symptom: The status bar keeps showing document dimensions in pixels after the ruler unit is changed.
labels.root_cause: The status bar always formatted dimensions in pixels and ignored the units preference.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, menus and tooltips show Mac shortcut symbols such as ⌘ instead of Ctrl.
labels.root_cause: UI strings hardcoded macOS shortcut glyphs instead of rendering bindings in the platform's notation.

labels.symptom: Selecting or resetting a saved workspace brings back the menu bar and tool rail that an embedding app had hidden.
labels.root_cause: Deserializing saved workspaces filled the omitted host flags with visible defaults.

labels.symptom: Warp only responds to grid points and is missing from the transform context menu.
Moving an artboard past the canvas edge leaves its shapes invisible or clipped.
labels.root_cause: Shapes were re-rendered before the canvas was grown by fit_canvas.

labels.symptom: Dragging a docked panel's splitter stops dead at the next panel instead of pushing it out of the way.
labels.root_cause: The splitter only traded height with its immediate neighbour group and stopped when that group hit its minimum.

labels.symptom: A tool shortcut key always picks the first tool in its group instead of the last one used.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut handler always chose the group's first tool and never asked which tool was used last.

labels.symptom: With a non-English interface language, items added at run time are missing from their menu.
labels.root_cause: The menu path was built from translated strings, but menus group items by the untranslated English path.

labels.symptom: CMYK solid and gradient fills change colour after a PSD round trip.
labels.root_cause: Fills were not generated directly in ink channels, so rendering and PSD export used different samples.

labels.symptom: A marquee selection dragged past the canvas extends outside the document.
labels.root_cause: The plain marquee path didn't clip the shape to the document bounds.

labels.symptom: Arabic text gets broken apart by tracking, the caret moves the wrong way in right-to-left text, and there is no right-to-left direction control.
labels.root_cause: Text layout and caret navigation did not handle bidirectional or Arabic shaping rules.

labels.symptom: The command palette shows blank separator rows among search results.
labels.root_cause: The palette did not skip menu separators, which matched on their menu path.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking the empty area around the image does not open a background colour menu.
An open dropdown list gets slightly wider while you scroll and hover over its options.
labels.root_cause: Selectable rows gain a stroke width only when hovered, and the combo popup keeps the widest width it has seen.

labels.symptom: Pressing Delete with a layer mask selected deletes the image layer instead of the mask.
labels.root_cause: The Delete shortcut dispatch ignored the selected mask target.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Vietnamese.
Middle-clicking a document tab does not close it as it does in browsers.
labels.root_cause: Tab strips only handled a primary click on the close button.

labels.symptom: The layer mask properties panel has no Refine row with Select and Mask, Color Range and Invert.
On macOS, the font list includes hidden system fonts whose names start with a dot, and font family order changes from run to run.
labels.root_cause: Families registered from font collections came back in an unstable order, and dot-prefixed private faces were not filtered out.

labels.symptom: The brush HUD hardness/opacity preference and the brush preview colour preference had no effect.
labels.root_cause: The preferences were never connected to the HUD code.

labels.symptom: Curved shapes report bounds one pixel wider than drawn.
labels.root_cause: f32 coverage accumulation in the rasterizer left tiny residue past the right edge.

labels.symptom: The Spot Healing brush preview ignores hardness and pen pressure.
labels.root_cause: The trail stamped a hard capsule at the base brush size instead of using the brush renderer.

labels.symptom: In the web build, a single Ctrl/Cmd+V pastes twice when the clipboard holds text.
labels.root_cause: eframe's web runner sends both the key press and a Paste event, and the shortcut handler counted each one as a paste.

labels.symptom: On macOS, choosing the text tool freezes the whole app for over a minute.
labels.root_cause: System fonts are discovered by scanning directories and merging into Fontique's generic collection on the UI thread instead of using the CoreText backend.

labels.symptom: Persian and Arabic text shows as empty boxes, and there is no Persian UI translation.
labels.root_cause: No font fallback for Arabic script was loaded.

labels.symptom: There is no local AI background removal in the layer context menus.
Converting several layers to a smart object wraps them in an extra group inside its contents.
labels.root_cause: convert wrapped the selected layers in a temporary group before embedding them.

labels.symptom: The Cancel and Commit buttons in options bars sit at the far right edge, far from the controls they belong to.
Copying and pasting a smart object layer with no selection turns it into a pixel layer.
labels.root_cause: Copy always took rendered pixels, and Paste always made a raster layer.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking a mask thumbnail doesn't open the mask's settings.
Reusing variable pixel replacement definitions switches As Is to Fit.
labels.root_cause: The method serialized as 'asis' instead of camelCase 'asIs'.

labels.symptom: Automation input commands with misspelled or wrong-typed parameters report success and act on defaults.
labels.root_cause: The control channel's input methods fell back to defaults instead of validating their parameters.

labels.symptom: The Beep When Done preference does nothing when a background job finishes.
labels.root_cause: No beep hook was wired to the job finish event.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking, masking or cutting the locked Background layer doesn't behave like the reference app.
labels.root_cause: The Background layer's locks weren't handled in double-click, mask and cut commands.

labels.symptom: Some UI strings stay untranslated because the translation check never sees them.
labels.root_cause: The i18n test cut each source file at its first test module, so it never checked tl! literals that came after it.

labels.symptom: There's no Background from Layer command, and the Background layer can be moved like any other layer.
labels.root_cause: The Background was only a locked layer with no ordering rules.

labels.symptom: Merging or collapsing layer groups on a large canvas freezes the app for several seconds.
labels.root_cause: Merges composited the full canvas into large intermediate buffers.

labels.symptom: Moving layers in very large documents is slow.
labels.root_cause: Translated surfaces pre-fill every tile pixel by pixel before overwriting it.

labels.symptom: The Font Preview Size preference does nothing and font menu samples are always medium size.
labels.root_cause: The font menu sample size was hard-coded and ignored the preference.

labels.symptom: Rasterizing a raster layer doesn't bake in its layer effects or convert its vector mask.
labels.root_cause: The rasterize command only handled type, shape, fill and smart object layers.

labels.symptom: The portable Windows zip writes its settings to the roaming AppData folder instead of next to the executable.
labels.root_cause: The config directory always resolved to the platform's per-user folder, with no portable-mode check for a marker file beside the exe.

labels.symptom: Users cannot choose Don't Save / Cancel / Save answers in the unsaved changes prompt on Windows and Linux.
With Auto-Select on, the Move tool's drag box and snapping follow the previously selected layer instead of the layer being dragged.
labels.root_cause: The snap gesture was set up before Auto-Select changed the selection.

labels.symptom: Loading files into a stack as a smart object wraps the layers in a group inside the contents.
labels.root_cause: Loaded layers were grouped and passed to layer_to_smart instead of layers_to_smart.

labels.symptom: UI scale preset jumps from 75% to 100% with no options in between, awkward on small laptop screens.
labels.root_cause: UI scale presets lacked intermediate values.

labels.symptom: There's no way to search for a setting in Preferences.
labels.root_cause: The Preferences dialog had no search field.

labels.symptom: The full Brush Settings options can't be reached for built-in brushes; the brush picker shows only a fixed grid of round tips.
labels.root_cause: The options bar had no way into the Brush Settings panel, and the preset picker was a hard-coded grid.

labels.symptom: The New Document dialog has no social media formats or search and opens wherever it was last dragged.
A Cmd/Ctrl-drag with the temporary Move tool moves the layer but shows no drag box and doesn't snap.
labels.root_cause: The snap gesture was chosen from the selected tool instead of the tool the press actually acts as.

labels.symptom: Some filters, such as Extrude, Wind, Spin Blur, Lens Correction and Trap, are very slow on large images.
labels.root_cause: Source and sampling work was repeated for every output pixel.

labels.symptom: Copying and pasting a type, shape or group layer with no selection flattens it to pixels.
labels.root_cause: Layer-based copy only handled smart objects.

labels.symptom: On Windows, after an MSI install, the taskbar button and the shortcuts show a blank page icon instead of the app icon.
labels.root_cause: The MSI's advertised shortcut uses an Icon Id with no file extension, so the shell can't read the cached icon (ICE50).

labels.symptom: File Info does not show camera data such as exposure, aperture, ISO and lens.
The Pencil cursor is square even when the stroke is round, and there is no hard-edged pixel eraser.
labels.root_cause: The cursor always drew the grid square, and the eraser only had a soft brush stroke.

labels.symptom: Copying and pasting a single colour channel copies the whole layer and pastes it as a new layer.
labels.root_cause: Copy and paste ignored the targeted channel in the Channels panel.

labels.symptom: Progress and parity documentation is missing or out of date.
Cmd/Ctrl-dragging a guide with a selection tool moves the layer instead of the guide.
labels.root_cause: Selection tools keep their own tool under Cmd, so the Move tool's guide hit test never ran.

labels.symptom: The Minimum and Maximum filters always give boxy corners.
Typing a custom width and height in the New Document dialog is ignored, and the canvas is created at 1920x1080.
labels.root_cause: Typed sizes were stored as JSON floats, but the command read them with as_u64, which returns None for floats, so it fell back to the default.

labels.symptom: Free Transform on a text layer with a selection previews only part of the text, and Distort or Perspective fail when committed.
labels.root_cause: The UI framed only the selection, while the engine transformed the whole layer, and the distort modes were not disabled for type layers.

labels.symptom: Some themes do not show the painting symmetry control in the options bar.
labels.root_cause: The control was drawn only inside a theme-specific branch of the options bar.

labels.symptom: No command can target a layer mask or vector mask; channel.target rejects "mask".
labels.root_cause: Mask targeting was stored only in UI shell state, and ChannelTarget had no mask variants.

labels.symptom: Opening a 16/32-bit PSD with an unreadable layer block silently drops all layers, and saving writes two layer lists.
labels.root_cause: The parse error was dropped and the raw block was re-emitted on save.

labels.symptom: There is no on-canvas drag gesture to change brush size and hardness.
Cut with a single colour channel targeted clears every channel of the layer.
labels.root_cause: edit.cut didn't follow the Channels panel target.

labels.symptom: The Liquify preview looks soft when zoomed in past 100%.
labels.root_cause: The preview used a 1600 px proxy at every zoom level.

labels.symptom: Changing the Pixel Aspect Ratio setting doesn't change how the canvas is displayed.
labels.root_cause: The pixel aspect ratio was stored but never applied to the canvas transform.

labels.symptom: The Color Replacement tool can't be chosen from the toolbar.
Dropdown menus have a fixed height and scroll even when the window has plenty of room for them.
labels.root_cause: The menu ScrollArea was capped at the popup's previous-frame height (egui's default 400pt) because min_scrolled_height was not set.

labels.symptom: The Wet Edges brush option draws a chain of rings instead of one stroke.
labels.root_cause: The wet-edge profile was applied to each dab instead of to the whole stroke.

labels.symptom: Crop presets can't be saved or deleted.
Scrolling the mouse wheel over the Navigator preview does not zoom the document.
labels.root_cause: The Navigator preview did not handle mouse-wheel events.

labels.symptom: Holding Shift after a brush stroke shows no preview of the straight line that will be drawn.
Pressing Delete with one colour channel targeted clears every channel of the layer.
labels.root_cause: The clear command ignored the targeted channel in the Channels panel.

labels.symptom: Single entries in the start screen's Recent list cannot be removed.
labels.root_cause: The Recent list had no per-entry remove control.

labels.symptom: On a rotated canvas view, the live outline of a shape selection is drawn in the wrong place while dragging.
labels.root_cause: The preview was an axis-aligned screen box through two projected corners instead of the rotated document-space shape.

labels.symptom: Tab characters in text show as boxes or single spaces instead of advancing to tab stops.
labels.root_cause: Text layout didn't expand tabs to tab stops.

labels.symptom: Cmd/Ctrl-dragging with the Lasso draws an outline instead of moving the layer.
labels.root_cause: The Lasso pointer handler took the press before the temporary Move check ran, and it did not pass the drag events on.

labels.symptom: The layer edges outline stays at the old position while a layer is being moved.
Toggling or editing a smart filter freezes the window until every filter re-renders.
labels.root_cause: Smart filter edits re-rendered the whole filter stack on the UI thread with no cached stages.

labels.symptom: Marquee selection outlines are invisible while dragging on a white canvas.
labels.root_cause: The drag preview was drawn as a 1 px white outline, which doesn't show on white.

labels.symptom: Moving a selection outline snaps the pointer instead of the selection's edges.
labels.root_cause: Snap gesture was chosen from the tool alone, ignoring that the drag moves the selection.

labels.symptom: Pressing Delete with an alpha channel or Quick Mask targeted clears the layer instead of the channel.
labels.root_cause: The clear command was not routed to the targeted channel.

labels.symptom: Recorded actions do not include Save and Save As steps.
labels.root_cause: Save commands run in the desktop shell and never go through the session journal that recording reads from.

labels.symptom: The brush cursor ring is too large for soft brushes.
labels.root_cause: The cursor still used the old falloff's 50% radius formula after the tip falloff changed.

labels.symptom: Standard fill and colour shortcuts are missing or hardcoded and can't be rebound.
labels.root_cause: D/X were hardcoded in shortcuts::handle, and there were no fill-key commands.

labels.symptom: PDF files fail to open on desktop.
labels.root_cause: The existing PDF import was never integrated into the main branch.

labels.symptom: There is no tool to pin colour sample points and read them in the Info panel.
Saving and opening large PSD files is slow.
labels.root_cause: PackBits RLE encoding, the layer gather and channel decoding all run on a single thread.

labels.symptom: There are no tools to add or delete anchor points on a path.
A quick pen tap paints at full or zero pressure instead of the pressure actually applied.
labels.root_cause: The pen sample is cleared or reset to zero pressure by the platform before the UI frame reads it, so the tap reads as a mouse or as the lift's zero.

labels.symptom: Text in scripts like Thai, Arabic or Devanagari shows missing-glyph boxes in the interface.
labels.root_cause: The UI font loader only had fallbacks for CJK and a few Thai fonts.

labels.symptom: Exported PSD files can have misaligned layer data for pattern, solid and gradient fill layers.
labels.root_cause: Regenerated fill tagged blocks were padded to an even length instead of a multiple of 4.

labels.symptom: Saving a Targa file doesn't let you choose 24 or 32 bits per pixel.
labels.root_cause: TGA depth was chosen automatically with no option.

labels.symptom: Batch and droplets reject actions that contain recorded zoom or fit steps with an unknown command error.
labels.root_cause: Every step was checked against the engine command registry, and shell-only view steps are not in it.

labels.symptom: Healing a grainy flat area leaves a smooth patch with no grain.
labels.root_cause: Texture synthesis averaged overlapping blocks 50/50, which reduced the grain.

labels.symptom: Every arrow-key nudge is saved as its own history step, so each Undo only takes back one pixel.
labels.root_cause: Each nudge is stored as a separate history state with no coalescing.

labels.symptom: Pressing Esc does not clear the current selection.
Free Transform handles do not respond to drags while the Lasso tool is selected.
labels.root_cause: The Lasso's own input reader dropped pointer moves and the release when no lasso outline was in progress.

labels.symptom: Recorded actions cannot be renamed and keep their default names.
labels.root_cause: There was no rename command and double-clicking an action played it.

labels.symptom: A quick two-finger trackpad tap opens a popup that disappears at once.
labels.root_cause: When press and release arrive in one frame, pixel rounding puts the opening press outside the popup so it is dismissed as an outside click.

labels.symptom: Panel tabs can't be dragged to reorder them; dragging moves the whole group instead.
labels.root_cause: Dock tabs only responded to clicks, not drags.

labels.symptom: A Cmd-drag with a painting tool sent through the control channel moves the whole layer instead of the selected pixels.
labels.root_cause: The selected-pixel checks read the physically held tool override rather than the tool derived from the event's modifiers.

labels.symptom: The Eraser has no Block mode.
labels.root_cause: The paint engine had no square dab.

labels.symptom: Dithered gradient layers under a Color Dodge layer show speckles and coloured fringes.
labels.root_cause: Dithered gradient fill pixels were kept in float instead of being rounded to the document's bit depth.

labels.symptom: The save dialog test fails on Windows CI because it expects '/' path separators.
labels.root_cause: The test hard-coded '/' separators, while Path::join uses '\' on Windows.

labels.symptom: Batch, scripts and droplets report success when a step inside a nested action fails.
labels.root_cause: Step runners treated only Err as failure and ignored the nested failed entry; batch scratch sessions had no actions list.

labels.symptom: Applying a data set to a text layer loses its weight, italic, tracking and other styling.
labels.root_cause: Replacing the text cleared the layer's style runs.

labels.symptom: There is no Pencil tool, Fill dialog or rasterize prompt.
Panel edges around the canvas flash a white line on hover, while the dock splitters use the accent color, and the left toolbar edge has no divider.
labels.root_cause: egui's own panel separator lines don't use the theme's divider styling.

labels.symptom: Command-line batch fails on every file when an action plays another action.
labels.root_cause: Each batch session started with no actions loaded and --actions accepted only one action.

labels.symptom: Shift plus scroll wheel cannot snap the canvas zoom to standard zoom levels.
Layer via Copy with several layers selected duplicates only the active layer.
labels.root_cause: layer_via handled only the active layer and never used the multi-layer duplicate path.

labels.symptom: On Linux X11, the app looks zoomed in because it scales to the panel's physical DPI instead of the desktop scale.
labels.root_cause: winit uses the DPI that XRandR reports, and the desktop launcher does not pin WINIT_X11_SCALE_FACTOR.

labels.symptom: Smoothing and feathering a selection is slow on large canvases.
labels.root_cause: Naive single-threaded blurs whose cost grew with the radius.

labels.symptom: Droplets fail on every file when their action plays another action.
labels.root_cause: Droplet files did not include actions called by Play Action steps.

labels.symptom: Turning on Pattern Preview does nothing instead of tiling the document seamlessly around the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The view.patternPreview flag was toggled but never read by the canvas renderer.

labels.symptom: Content-aware spot healing takes hundreds of milliseconds per small dab.
labels.root_cause: The inpainting initial fill compared every source patch exhaustively without early exit.

labels.symptom: Thin 1 px pencil lines look uneven, with doubled pixels at each step.
labels.root_cause: Dabs were spaced by distance rather than stepped pixel by pixel, so grid snapping left L-shaped corners.

labels.symptom: In the web build, File > Open opens only one of several selected files.
labels.root_cause: The web file dialog called pick_file() and ignored the multiple flag, and the answer type could only hold one file.

labels.symptom: Free Transform shows an unthemed rotate cursor and an angle label that disappears over light images.
labels.root_cause: Rotate cursor and readout were drawn in fixed colours without the themed readout widget.

labels.symptom: Rendering sometimes freezes forever at 0% CPU.
labels.root_cause: A OnceLock initialiser ran Rayon work, and work stealing re-entered the same lock on the same thread, causing a deadlock.

labels.symptom: There is no way to select an object from the Cryptomatte IDs in an EXR render.
The web (wasm32) build prints dead-code warnings and fails strict clippy.
labels.root_cause: Constants used only by native code paths were not cfg-gated for wasm32.

labels.symptom: Remove Background is hard to find; there is no contextual task bar on the canvas.
Some interface strings are untranslated in Russian.
labels.root_cause: Missing entries in the Russian translation file.

labels.symptom: Docked panels show a dark scroll-fade gradient over their content, and the preview doesn't resize with the panel group.
labels.root_cause: Dock scroll areas used egui's default scroll fade, and the preview had a fixed size.

labels.symptom: In the Warp Text dialog, the orientation field appears below the bend and distortion sliders.
labels.root_cause: The command's params doc listed orientation last.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Simplified Chinese.
Double-clicking a shape layer's thumbnail opens layer style instead of a colour picker for its fill.
labels.root_cause: Shape thumbnails' double-click was not routed to layer content options.

labels.symptom: Drag-selecting text in a single-line field follows vertical mouse movement instead of horizontal, selecting all to the start or end.
labels.root_cause: egui's Galley::cursor_from_pos snaps to text start or end when the pointer is more than 5 pt above or below, even in single-line TextEdits.

labels.symptom: Tool options reset to defaults every time the app is restarted.
labels.root_cause: Tool options were never saved to or restored from the preferences file.

labels.symptom: The Pen tool cannot continue open paths, insert or delete anchors, or shift-lock angles.
There is no way to reset a tool's options or all tools to their defaults.
labels.root_cause: No Reset Tool / Reset All Tools commands existed.

labels.symptom: The roadmap lists an already implemented feature as pending.
On Linux, a system light/dark theme change made during startup is lost and the app keeps the old theme.
labels.root_cause: The app read the portal appearance before subscribing to SettingChanged, so a change in between was missed.

labels.symptom: On Windows the Zoom tool shows a plain arrow cursor, and the eyedropper ring shows the new color in place of the previous one.
labels.root_cause: winit maps the ZoomIn/ZoomOut cursors to IDC_ARROW on Windows, and the eyedropper ring reads the foreground color after it has already been replaced.

labels.symptom: No FreeBSD release download is offered.
Right-clicking during Free Transform lists only the modes, without rotate and flip items.
labels.root_cause: The transform context menu lacked rotate/flip entries acting on the live box.

labels.symptom: Hovering with the Move tool doesn't show which layer Auto-Select would pick.
Rotate and flip transforms change the layer instead of the targeted alpha channel or Quick Mask.
labels.root_cause: Transform presets and the transform command without an explicit target ignored the Channels panel target.

labels.symptom: Several contributors end up fixing the same issue in parallel.
labels.root_cause: There was no documented way to claim an issue.

labels.symptom: Single Row and Single Column Marquee tools are missing.
Dragging from an empty spot with the Move tool moves the selected layer instead of drawing a marquee to select layers.
labels.root_cause: No box-select of layers was implemented for the Move tool.

labels.symptom: A file dialog test fails on Windows CI because it expects forward-slash paths.
labels.root_cause: Test expectations hard-coded '/' separators while the code builds paths with Path::join.

labels.symptom: Dropdowns need two clicks; pressing, dragging onto an option and releasing chooses nothing.
labels.root_cause: egui ComboBox opens only on a full click and its rows respond only to clicks, not press-drag-release.

labels.symptom: The Freeform Pen and Curvature Pen tools are missing.
Gradient stop controls in Properties and the Gradient Editor are inconsistent and hard to use.
There are no Type Mask tools for making a selection shaped like typed text.
There is no Artboard tool for drawing, selecting or resizing artboards on the canvas.
Commands that panic or hang on bad parameters can be merged unnoticed because the panic test never runs in CI.
labels.root_cause: panic_hunt is #[ignore]d and no CI workflow runs it.

labels.symptom: There is no Perspective Crop tool to straighten a keystoned subject while cropping.
Individual steps of a recorded action can't be switched off, so every step always runs.
JPEG XL images cannot be opened.
labels.root_cause: No JPEG XL decoder was included.

labels.symptom: In MCP bridge mode, inspecting a document by index always returns the active document.
labels.root_cause: The bridge backend sent document.inspect with empty params and dropped the index.

labels.symptom: Running Select Subject again on an unchanged image is as slow as the first run.
labels.root_cause: The full subject-selection pipeline reran on every call with no cache of the last result.

labels.symptom: Many listed image formats cannot be exported.
Status bar buttons and value fields clip into the bar's edges, and their labels are off-centre.
labels.root_cause: The controls used the full theme interact height and padding, which was taller than the status bar.

labels.symptom: Holding Space and then Alt pans the canvas instead of zooming out.
labels.root_cause: The temporary Zoom Out key was bound only to Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+Space.

labels.symptom: There is no way to fill a selection from a text prompt using a generative AI provider.
There is no Generative Fill button in the selection tools' options bar.
Smart objects and smart filters are flattened to pixels when saving PSD.
The Tilt-Shift filter is slow and panics when the blur amount is NaN.
labels.root_cause: Every Gaussian level was computed across the full halo, and a NaN amount reached an invalid clamp bound.

labels.symptom: Feathering or smoothing a selection on a large photo takes several hundred milliseconds.
labels.root_cause: Serial padding, cropping and tile-copy passes around the parallel blur dominated the command time.

labels.symptom: Duplicating a large layer is slow.
labels.root_cause: The edit reported no damage region, so the whole document was recomposited.

labels.symptom: Painting with very large brushes on big canvases is slow and the stroke is replayed on release.
labels.root_cause: Large dabs were rasterized as dense masks on the CPU and live strokes replayed on pointer release.

labels.symptom: Hovering over transform handles shows the plain move cursor until the user first interacts with a handle.
labels.root_cause: Cursor selection only checked for an active free-transform session and ignored the Move tool's transform controls shown before a session starts.

labels.symptom: Long operations block the app and cannot be cancelled.
labels.root_cause: The engine had no job API with progress reporting and cancellation points.

labels.symptom: Shift-click straight lines with a pressure-sensitive pen use the same pressure at both ends instead of blending between them.
labels.root_cause: Only the previous stroke endpoint's coordinates were stored, so the connecting stroke reused the new click's pressure at both ends.

labels.symptom: There are no light or light-gray versions of the Pro theme.
Scorecard rows list work as missing that is already done and tested.
labels.root_cause: The scorecard rows were stale.

labels.symptom: Dialogs are pinned to the centre of the window and can't be moved.
labels.root_cause: Dialogs were drawn at a fixed centred position with no title-bar dragging.

labels.symptom: Long operations and file opens freeze the window, with no progress shown and no way to cancel.
labels.root_cause: Commands and file opens ran on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: Brush dabs on large 16-bit or 32-bit documents stutter.
labels.root_cause: When a layer's region grew, its GPU page texture was recreated and every tile was converted and uploaded again; 32-bit tiles also went through a slow general conversion.

labels.symptom: Combine Shapes does nothing when several shape layers are selected.
labels.root_cause: The operations changed only the path components of the active layer and did not merge the selected layers.

labels.symptom: Making a marquee selection on a large document is slow.
labels.root_cause: The ellipse selection was written pixel by pixel on one thread, and the combine modes went through full-canvas float buffers.

labels.symptom: Clicking outside an active free transform does not apply it; Enter has to be pressed.
labels.root_cause: Clicks outside the box were only handled as rotation drags.

labels.symptom: Copying a selection with transparent margins to the OS clipboard loses its frame and positioning.
labels.root_cause: The clipboard export cropped to the content instead of using the selection bounds.

labels.symptom: The Frame tool is missing from the toolbar.
There are no built-in rainbow gradient presets.
Pasting a layer into a large document is slow.
labels.root_cause: Paste reported no damage region, so the whole document was recomposited.

labels.symptom: Raw Shadows/Highlights/Whites/Blacks sliders give different results from the reference app.
labels.root_cause: The sliders were applied to developed pixels after the tone curve, with guessed curves.

labels.symptom: Contributing guide does not explain how to report skipped checks and the tested commit.
Entering Quick Mask with nothing selected shows the whole canvas as selected, and Select All is lost when leaving Quick Mask.
labels.root_cause: An empty selection was stored as an all-white mask, the same as Select All.

labels.symptom: Clippy fails on main because a test helper is never used.
labels.root_cause: A local closure shadowed the top-level joined() test helper.

labels.symptom: Each time the AppImage starts, it overwrites the desktop launcher and erases any environment variables or arguments the user added.
labels.root_cause: AppRun replaced any desktop entry that differed from the packaged template instead of updating only the keys the user hadn't changed.

labels.symptom: New Guide Layout opened a generic form with no live preview on the canvas.
Toolbar tool icons look small and thin in the Pro themes.
labels.root_cause: Toolbar glyphs used the generic icon-button proportion (16 px in a 30 px button).

labels.symptom: CI test jobs take 35-40 minutes on Windows and Linux runners.
labels.root_cause: The CI workflow and test runner configuration were not tuned for wall time.

labels.symptom: On Linux with the theme set to follow the system, an idle window stays dark even though the system uses a light theme.
labels.root_cause: A desktop portal appearance reply arriving after the startup wait was stored without requesting a repaint.

labels.symptom: GIMP XCF files cannot be opened.
The UI library tests fail to compile on main because a helper is missing.
labels.root_cause: Two parallel merges both removed the joined helper.

labels.symptom: Typing a letter in an open dropdown doesn't jump to an item, and triggers a tool shortcut instead.
labels.root_cause: Shared dropdowns had no type-ahead and did not take keyboard focus away from shortcuts.

labels.symptom: Layer Style has no contour picker or editor.
Right-clicking a layer effect row does nothing instead of opening the layer style menu.
Right-clicking in a text field shows no Cut/Copy/Paste menu and clears the selection.
labels.root_cause: egui's TextEdit has no context menu.

labels.symptom: The Show Transformation Values preference has no effect on size and angle readouts.
labels.root_cause: The preference was never read.

labels.symptom: Rulers are hidden again after every restart, and guides lose precision.
labels.root_cause: Ruler visibility was unsaved UI state, and guides were stored as f32.

labels.symptom: FITS astronomy images cannot be opened or saved.
Compressed Olympus ORF/ORI raw files cannot be opened, and 14-bit files show a purple shadow haze.
labels.root_cause: There was no decoder for compressed ORF, and BlackLevel2 was not scaled for 14-bit data.

labels.symptom: Paste from the Edit menu does nothing while typing text into a document.
labels.root_cause: Menu paste, copy and select-all ran the pixel commands instead of routing to the active text edit.

labels.symptom: On Linux, some installed fonts (e.g. Japanese/CJK fonts) don't show up in the font list.
labels.root_cause: Font discovery scanned fixed directories instead of using Fontconfig's configured font locations.

labels.symptom: On Linux X11 with several monitors, the screen color picker reads colors with the wrong monitor profile.
labels.root_cause: Only the root window's _ICC_PROFILE was read instead of each RandR output's profile.

labels.symptom: On Linux X11, colors on screen don't use the monitor's ICC profile.
labels.root_cause: There was no monitor profile discovery on X11 (colord/RandR).

labels.symptom: The Enable Flick Panning preference does nothing; the view stops dead when a Hand drag is released.
labels.root_cause: The preference was never read.

labels.symptom: No Linux riscv64 release download is available.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow had no riscv64 job, and the Linux library fallback used the x86_64 triplet.

labels.symptom: Opening a crafted PSD/PSB can use huge CPU and memory while it is parsed.
labels.root_cause: Parse-time ZIP validation of the merged image was bounded by the declared size instead of MAX_DECODED_BYTES.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking while editing text on the canvas does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The canvas tool menu had no entry for the Type tool, and the inline editor is not a TextEdit.

labels.symptom: Select and Mask has no live preview or view modes.
Saved PSD files carry no thumbnail, and the Image Previews preference does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The preference was never wired to the save paths.

labels.symptom: Opening a crafted file with very deeply nested layer groups through some import paths can build an unbounded tree and exhaust the stack.
labels.root_cause: The public PSD converter and layered TIFF import skipped the group-depth preflight and built the full layer tree before capping it.

labels.symptom: Quick right-clicks close context menus at once, fast trackpad scrolling barely pans the canvas, and short gradients cannot be drawn.
labels.root_cause: Multiple causes, including smoothing that throttled the wheel/trackpad delta.

labels.symptom: Creating or editing a pattern fill layer opens no dialog, so its pattern can't be adjusted.
The interface is not available in Russian, and some labels stay in English in every translation.
labels.root_cause: Some UI strings were never wrapped in tl!, so the coverage tests did not catch them.

labels.symptom: The automation inspect output reports a layer with a vector mask as unmasked.
labels.root_cause: hasMask covers raster masks only.

labels.symptom: The Show Font Names in English setting has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The preference was saved but never read.

labels.symptom: The Type Anti-Alias None item sits last and is never checked, and menu checks ignore the edited type layer.
labels.root_cause: The item was missing from the menu catalog and check state read only the active layer.

labels.symptom: The README does not show the repository size.
Unsharp Mask with a large radius is very slow to apply and to preview.
labels.root_cause: Large tile halos were filtered and copied over and over in direct convolution.

labels.symptom: Automation can open a raw adjustment dialog but cannot commit or cancel it.
labels.root_cause: The control server rejected every menu request while any modal dialog was open.
bug_markers: menu command is unavailable while a modal dialog is open

labels.symptom: Select and Mask has no Refine Edge Brush for painting hair or fur edge refinement.
labels.root_cause: The tool was not implemented.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Spanish.
The pixel grid shows patchy bright and dark lines over mid-tone images.
labels.root_cause: The grid line colour flipped between white and black at a hard luma threshold of 0.55.

labels.symptom: SVG import no longer rejects deeply nested markup or caps the size of inflated .svgz files.
Select Subject has no AI high-quality mode, and the Magic Wand has no Sample Size option.
Variable fonts show no axis sliders, and optical size doesn't follow the type size.
A stress test sometimes reports a text command as hung on a busy machine, then passes when run again.
labels.root_cause: The first text command starts a one-time system font scan that can take longer than the test's 4 s per-command deadline under heavy load.

labels.symptom: An animated GIF opens as its first frame only.
labels.root_cause: The GIF decoder only decoded the first frame.

labels.symptom: Layer style effects only showed on the canvas after pressing OK.
Core creative tools behave like decorative shells or have interaction bugs.
Malformed keyboard shortcut strings are quietly read as a different shortcut, and Plus-key shortcuts display wrongly.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut parser did not check for unknown parts, duplicate modifiers or extra keys.

labels.symptom: Select and Mask cannot output the refined selection to a new document.
labels.root_cause: select.refineEdge only supported four of six output targets.

labels.symptom: Warping live type lets you shape the mesh, but committing fails and the work is lost.
labels.root_cause: Transform Warp on a type layer opened the generic mesh warp, which the engine rejects for unrasterized type.

labels.symptom: The clone and healing brush cursor shows the crosshair before Option is held, and the source crosshair only follows after the button is released.
Profile menus list only the built-in ICC profiles, not the ones installed in the OS.
Cmd-dragging a corner of editable type in Free Transform distorts it, then the commit fails and the transform is lost.
labels.root_cause: The corner-drag gesture code does not check the layer kind before allowing distort.

labels.symptom: File › Print can't reach a printer on Windows.
labels.root_cause: Print spooled jobs with lp, which doesn't work on Windows.

labels.symptom: Some labels in a generated dialog stay in English in every other UI language.
labels.root_cause: The translation catalogs had no rows for the labels generated from parameter names.

labels.symptom: Printing fails with an 'lp' error in the Flatpak, without a default printer, or on Windows.
labels.root_cause: Printing spawned the Unix lp command, which is missing in sandboxes and on Windows.

labels.symptom: The marquee preview test fails on CI at random.
labels.root_cause: The ellipse check took too few samples along a dashed line, so the result depended on the dash phase.

labels.symptom: Shape stroke controls are unavailable at zero width, and nested dropdowns interfere with their parent popup.
A Traditional Chinese system shows the interface in English unless LANG is set.
labels.root_cause: There was no Traditional Chinese catalog, and language detection did not fall back to the OS locale.

labels.symptom: Layer masks can't be copied to other layers or documents.
Automation accepts only one read root, so a library folder and a working folder can't both be readable.
Warp, Distort and Perspective on a shape layer fail on commit with a rasterize error.
labels.root_cause: The transform and warp commands only handled affine maps for shape paths.

labels.symptom: Camera photos tagged sRGB only through EXIF open oversaturated when the working space is wide-gamut.
labels.root_cause: The EXIF ColorSpace tag was never read, so such files were treated as untagged.

labels.symptom: Right-click or two-finger trackpad context menus flash open and close immediately.
labels.root_cause: When press and release arrive in one frame, physical-pixel rounding places the opening press just outside the popup, so it counts as an outside click.

labels.symptom: The app freezes for a long time the first time text tools are used, while installed fonts are scanned.
labels.root_cause: The system font scan runs lazily inside a OnceLock on the UI thread during the first frame that needs the font list.

labels.symptom: Distort, Perspective and Warp on a path are refused when the transform is committed, and the edit is lost.
labels.root_cause: path.transform accepted only affine matrices.
bug_markers: Distort and Perspective can't be applied to a path

labels.symptom: Single Row and Single Column Marquee selections show as Rectangular Marquee in History.
labels.root_cause: select.rect chose the History step name only from the ellipse flag.

labels.symptom: The clipping-mask marker in the Layers panel points right instead of down toward the base layer.
labels.root_cause: The marker was drawn with the font glyph ↳, which points right, instead of a downward bent arrow.

labels.symptom: Stroke Path only offers brush, pencil and eraser and has no Simulate Pressure option.
The Artboard tool has no '+' buttons to add a board beside the selected one, and Shift does not keep proportions while resizing.
Committing a Type Mask with Shift or Alt always replaces the selection, and the working text shows up as a layer.
labels.root_cause: The type tools never sent the selection operation to type.createSelection.

labels.symptom: Recorded actions apply some steps twice on playback.
labels.root_cause: Nested commands run through execute are journaled along with the outer command.

labels.symptom: An artboard moved left of or above the origin ends up off-canvas.
labels.root_cause: fit_canvas only grew the canvas to the right and bottom.

labels.symptom: Decimal values in a value field with a suffix, such as the status bar zoom label, overflow their box.
labels.root_cause: The value field reserved too much width for the suffix.

labels.symptom: With the Freeform Pen, Alt-click does not draw straight segments and Cmd/Ctrl does not switch to Direct Selection for the moment.
Clipping groups break when layers are added, moved or deleted.
labels.root_cause: Layer add, move and delete operations never updated the clipped flag.

labels.symptom: A recorded Last Filter action fails on playback or applies a different filter.
labels.root_cause: The Last Filter wrapper command was journaled instead of the concrete filter it repeated.

labels.symptom: The Content-Aware Move tool has no Transform On Drop option.
Panels can now be docked, grouped and floated with shared layouts saved in workspaces.
Painting with very large brushes is slow.
labels.root_cause: Dense coverage mask generation and per-pixel sample conversion are expensive.

labels.symptom: Closing a document, reverting, quitting or closing the window throws away unsaved changes without asking.
labels.root_cause: Commands that discard work and the native window close did not check whether documents had unsaved changes.

labels.symptom: Numeric fields reject typed units, labels can't be dragged to scrub, and double-click doesn't reset values.
labels.root_cause: Shared value-field widgets lacked unit parsing, scrubby labels and reset.

labels.symptom: When the web version is embedded in a host page, the host cannot open files in it, and saves become browser downloads.
Content-aware scale opens a dialog instead of a transform box with a live preview.
Layer › New › Layer… makes a layer right away instead of opening a dialog.
Shift+Plus/Minus do not cycle blend modes, and effects dropped on the Trash are not deleted.
Curves has no pencil mode or Smooth button.
Brush strokes can paint on a layer mask while Lock All is on.
labels.root_cause: Painting on a mask did not check the effective Lock All setting.

labels.symptom: Bracket-style keyboard shortcuts don't work on German and other non-US keyboard layouts.
labels.root_cause: egui has no key for layout-specific characters like ö or #, so it reports the physical key, which no shortcut is bound to.

labels.symptom: In right-to-left languages, the interface layout is not mirrored.
labels.root_cause: The window chrome was hard-wired left to right.

labels.symptom: The Properties panel of a Curves adjustment layer has no black, gray or white point eyedroppers.
The Puppet Warp mesh has a staircase outline, and pinning one shape drags nearby separate shapes along with it.
labels.root_cause: The mesh was built from square grid cells that touched opaque pixels.

labels.symptom: Dragging a layer mask thumbnail to the Trash deletes the whole layer instead of asking about the mask.
labels.root_cause: The mask thumbnail had no drag of its own, so a drag from it moved the whole layer row.

labels.symptom: A Gradient Fill layer can still be edited after Lock All is turned on.
labels.root_cause: gradient.fill.set and gradient.fill.stop did not check the layer's effective locks.

labels.symptom: Spot channels saved to TIFF land in the transparency sample, so a RIP treats the ink as holes.
labels.root_cause: The TIFF writer did not write spot and alpha channels as extra samples with Photoshop channel resources.

labels.symptom: There is no one-step command to build a choked DTF spot channel plate.
The Actions panel has no sets, checkboxes, button mode, playback options or .atn import.
Dragging a vector mask thumbnail to the Trash deletes the whole layer.
labels.root_cause: The mask-drag check only recognised pixel masks, so a vector mask drag started an ordinary layer-row drag.

labels.symptom: New Document presets ignore the preset resolution preferences.
labels.root_cause: Nothing read the preference; presets used hard-coded resolutions.

labels.symptom: Levels has no black, gray or white point eyedroppers, and the Curves eyedropper does nothing on a smart object.
labels.root_cause: Levels lacked eyedroppers, and the smart filter recorded the raw eyedropper params instead of the resolved curve.

labels.symptom: Popup and panel shadows look muddy and harsh.
labels.root_cause: The theme uses heavy single-layer drop shadows.

labels.symptom: The open issue and PR backlog is unlabelled and many PRs have gone stale with merge conflicts.
labels.root_cause: No automated labelling or rebasing of open items.

labels.symptom: Text in a fully locked type layer can still be replaced.
labels.root_cause: The shared type-edit path did not check the layer's effective All lock.

labels.symptom: The Vanishing Point filter has no on-canvas plane editor, so plane corners must be typed as JSON.
RISC-V Linux releases ship only a tar.gz, with no deb or rpm packages.
labels.root_cause: The riscv64 release job packages only the tar format and runs on ubuntu-24.04.

labels.symptom: The New Document dialog's Recent tab shows a fixed list instead of the documents you actually created.
labels.root_cause: The Recent category was hard-coded and nothing recorded created document settings.

labels.symptom: Inserting text with CRLF line endings returns a caret position beyond the end of the stored text.
labels.root_cause: The caret was computed from the raw input instead of the CRLF-normalized text.

labels.symptom: Right-to-left names such as Arabic or Hebrew show their words in reversed order in UI lists.
labels.root_cause: egui shapes runs per word but lacks paragraph bidi reordering, so runs are placed in logical left-to-right order.

labels.symptom: When several dialogs stack up, the one in front can be greyed out and ignore clicks, so the app has to be quit.
labels.root_cause: egui raised an older disabled modal above the live one, which egui then blocked from input.

labels.symptom: Moving the caret to the next or previous line does nothing in text with large leading.
labels.root_cause: Line navigation hit-tested a point just past the caret, which stayed closest to the current line when leading was large.

labels.symptom: Older Sony ARW raw files open with estimated white balance, wrong black level and uncropped sensor size.
labels.root_cause: Applied white balance and black levels stored in encrypted SR2SubIFD metadata were not read.

labels.symptom: CLI batch replay of recorded actions fails when they contain zoom, fit or save steps.
labels.root_cause: CLI batch sent every recorded step to the headless command registry instead of skipping non-editing view and save steps.

labels.symptom: The Window menu does not list open documents.
Perspective Warp with a selection warps the whole linked layer mask, so unselected pixels change visibility.
labels.root_cause: Perspective Warp applied the warp to the full linked mask instead of splitting it by selection like Free Transform.

labels.symptom: Dropdowns in dialogs start on the first option instead of the declared default.
labels.root_cause: The Choice parameter kind discarded explicit defaults and initialised fields to options[0].

labels.symptom: Panasonic RW2 RawFormat 3/4 files can't be decoded.
Clearing the transparent color-table entry leaves the image transparent.
labels.root_cause: Clearing the entry skips zero-alpha pixels, so their alpha is never restored.

labels.symptom: The Spanish interface has mistranslations, for example Dodge and Burn are swapped.
labels.root_cause: Errors in the Spanish translation catalog.

labels.symptom: Arbitrary canvas rotation fails with a lock error when a group contains a position-locked layer.
labels.root_cause: Movement locks are released only on top-level layers, not on layers inside groups.

labels.symptom: Some filters report success on an untouched Reveal All mask but leave it unchanged.
labels.root_cause: The mask's content bounds are empty, so filter area planning skips the canvas.

labels.symptom: After a crop extends the canvas, the new border on the Background stays transparent even after Fill.
labels.root_cause: The Background stays locked for transparency after the crop extends the canvas.

labels.symptom: Applying an identity Free Transform makes the edges of a feathered selection translucent.
labels.root_cause: The lift-and-composite-over path double-counts partial coverage even when the transform changes nothing.

labels.symptom: Exporting an animated GIF turns transparent pixels opaque black.
labels.root_cause: Frames were quantised without a transparent index and written with the 'leave in place' disposal mode.

labels.symptom: On desktops that move windows with Alt+drag, Alt-click inside the app does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The window manager grabs every Alt+left press, so the click never reaches the app.

labels.symptom: On a large 4K monitor set to 100% scaling, the window and UI open at double size.
labels.root_cause: Auto UI scale forced 200% when a 4K display reported a system scale of 1.0.

labels.symptom: On a system with no fonts installed, SVG text vanishes without any warning and the file opens as an empty drawing.
labels.root_cause: With an empty font database, usvg drops text elements while parsing, so the code that warns about missing fonts never runs.

labels.symptom: SVG and PDF exports flatten vector shapes into one bitmap.
labels.root_cause: The exporter rasterised the whole document.

labels.symptom: Fast strokes with a pen or mouse come out as jagged straight-line segments instead of smooth curves.
labels.root_cause: The canvas read only one pointer position per frame and dropped the PointerMoved events that piled up in between.

labels.symptom: There is no Docker Compose setup for building and running the web app locally.
On older Intel Macs (Iris Pro, macOS Monterey) the app crashes at startup with a 'Parent device is lost' GPU error.
labels.root_cause: wgpu compiles indirect-call validation compute shaders by default, and the Metal compiler on Intel Iris Pro crashes on them.

labels.symptom: Clicking to hit-test text can select text layers that sit inside hidden groups.
labels.root_cause: Hit testing checked only the layer's own visibility flag, not whether its parent groups were hidden.

labels.symptom: With the caret at the start of a wrapped line, caret queries and line navigation report the line before.
labels.root_cause: Line lookup picked the first line containing an offset that two adjacent lines share.

labels.symptom: Creating a layer mask from transparency hides the parts of the layer that were outside the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The alpha transfer was limited to where the layer bounds overlap the document bounds.

labels.symptom: Linked layers copied into another document become linked to unrelated layers already there.
labels.root_cause: Copying between documents kept the source's document-local link-group IDs, which could clash with IDs already used in the destination.

labels.symptom: Undoing a new layer after deselecting all layers selects the Background layer instead of leaving nothing selected.
labels.root_cause: History restore only handled targets with an active layer, so an empty target fell through to the code that picks a fallback active layer.

labels.symptom: Phone photos open sideways, and exports keep the old EXIF orientation, so viewers rotate them twice.
labels.root_cause: EXIF orientation was ignored on decode but kept in metadata on export.

labels.symptom: Shift-click range selection in the Layers panel picks the wrong rows around expanded groups.
labels.root_cause: Range selection used Document::walk order, which differs from the panel's visual order.

labels.symptom: A group with reduced fill opacity reopens fully opaque after saving as OpenRaster.
labels.root_cause: The ORA exporter wrote group opacity without folding in the group's fill opacity.

labels.symptom: Numerically scaling a path on a layer other than the active one moves it to the wrong place.
labels.root_cause: path.transform took the pivot from the active layer's path rather than the targeted layer's.

labels.symptom: Editing an endpoint of a scaled line shape shrinks its thickness back to the original.
labels.root_cause: Scaling updated the live line's endpoints but not its stored weight.

labels.symptom: History Brush and Fill with History fail when the source history state had locked pixels.
labels.root_cause: The history read used the write-target helper, which enforces pixel locks.

labels.symptom: On Windows, pasting an image copied from another program says the clipboard holds no image, or pastes it with a black background.
labels.root_cause: The arboard image reader cannot decode some CF_DIB clipboard images and drops their alpha.

labels.symptom: On Windows the GPU texture memory budget ignores installed RAM: too small on large machines and too large on 8 GB laptops.
labels.root_cause: The physical memory query had no Windows implementation, returned None, and a 16 GB default was assumed.

labels.symptom: Playing back a recorded action that ran a script applies the script's edits twice.
labels.root_cause: The recording kept both the script's commands and the enclosing Browse script command.

labels.symptom: Applying a feathered layer mask gives the layer a hard edge instead of the soft one shown before.
labels.root_cause: Apply read mask coverage through LayerMask::values_into, which skips feathering.

labels.symptom: Restoring video frames blanks the imported footage, and hiding altered video still shows the edited frames.
labels.root_cause: Video layers did not keep separate snapshots of the original imported frames.

labels.symptom: Dissolve blend mode gives uniform gray instead of scattered pixels on adjustment, clipped and effect layers.
labels.root_cause: Specialised composition paths used ordinary opacity interpolation instead of Dissolve coverage.

labels.symptom: A crafted camera RAW file can make the importer allocate a decode buffer larger than the allowed memory limit.
labels.root_cause: Per-segment and lossless-JPEG intermediate buffers were sized from tile geometry declared in the file and were not checked against max_alloc.

labels.symptom: After Image Size, Canvas Size or Crop, a smart filter's mask applies the filter to the wrong part of the image.
labels.root_cause: The shared layer-surface traversal skipped smart-filter mask surfaces.

labels.symptom: The System Info dialog lacks the OS version, CPU, memory, fonts and log location that a bug report needs.
Reapplying unchanged dimensions to a scaled rounded rectangle changes its corners.
labels.root_cause: The live shape's path was regenerated whenever geometry parameters were supplied, even if they were unchanged.

labels.symptom: Formatting an empty last paragraph after a trailing newline changes the paragraph before it instead.
labels.root_cause: The caret at the end of the text was mapped to the paragraph before it, and zero-length paragraph runs were dropped during normalization.

labels.symptom: The repository has no license files or attribution for bundled fonts, icons and assets.
labels.root_cause: License files, NOTICE and attribution were never added to the repo.

labels.symptom: The macOS command-line tool download looks unsigned and Gatekeeper may block it.
labels.root_cause: A bare CLI binary can't hold a stapled notarization ticket, and nothing in the release workflow checked that the CLI was notarized.

labels.symptom: Adjusting exposure or white balance on raw import brings back flat neutral colour, and Nikon D5100 raws show a magenta border.
labels.root_cause: Tuned raw import skipped the fitted embedded-JPEG rendering, and no crop was set for the D5100 sensor area.

labels.symptom: Crop handles jitter while resizing and ratio changes don't apply immediately.
labels.root_cause: Snapped handles were computed from live geometry fed back by auto-center preview.

labels.symptom: Importing an OpenRaster file removes leading and trailing spaces from layer and group names.
labels.root_cause: The ORA reader trimmed name attributes.

labels.symptom: The crop tool's custom ratio width and height fields can't be edited and stay at 0.
labels.root_cause: The in-progress ratio values were kept only in frame-local variables, so they were thrown away every frame.

labels.symptom: The Convert Point tool is missing from the Pen flyout in the toolbar.
On Windows, GPU UI tests crash at random with an access violation when run in parallel.
labels.root_cause: Two WARP (DX12) devices rendering on parallel test threads crash inside d3d10warp.dll.

labels.symptom: Accepting the custom proof setup dialog without changes replaces the document's active proof profile.
labels.root_cause: The dialog was filled from defaults or remembered values instead of the document's current proof condition.

labels.symptom: Automation scripts limited to a read root cannot place a file into the open document.
labels.root_cause: file.placeEmbedded takes an unscoped path, so the automation boundary refuses it, and no root-scoped alternative existed.

labels.symptom: The Global Light dialog opens with default or stale values and overwrites the document's light angle on OK.
labels.root_cause: The dialog was initialized from schema defaults or remembered prefs instead of the document's global light.

labels.symptom: Moving a type layer imported from a PSD re-wraps its text or makes it disappear when its font is missing.
labels.root_cause: translate_layer re-rendered type layers on every whole-pixel move instead of shifting the rendered pixels.

labels.symptom: Video menu commands fail with 'need path' instead of opening a file picker, and the timeline lacks a working previous-frame icon and a Stop button.
labels.root_cause: Video commands were not registered to open dialogs from the menu, and the chevron-left icon asset was missing.

labels.symptom: Content-aware scale, Gaussian blur and median filters are slow on large images.
16-bit Affinity files import with an empty pixel layer or lose precision down to 8 bits.
labels.root_cause: The reader did not recover pixel layers backed by the embedded original and quantized 16-bit tiles to 8 bits.

labels.symptom: Linked layers copied into another document join unrelated linked layers there and move together with them.
labels.root_cause: Cross-document layer copies kept their link group IDs without remapping them against the destination document.

labels.symptom: Recording a shortcut like Ctrl+F in Keyboard Shortcuts saves Ctrl+ControlLeft instead.
labels.root_cause: egui reports modifier keys as their own key presses, and the capture took the first key press it saw.

labels.symptom: Automation refuses to export layers or data sets, or import CSVs, even for paths inside the granted roots.
labels.root_cause: These commands take ambient paths instead of writing and reading through the authorized workspace roots.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: Applying a feathered layer mask bakes in a hard edge instead of a soft one.
labels.root_cause: Applying the mask read only mask density and ignored the feather blur that the compositor applies.

labels.symptom: Soft, low-flow brush strokes on 8-bit documents show visible banding.
labels.root_cause: Strokes composited in float were rounded to 8 bits without dithering.

labels.symptom: Some camera raw files develop black, fall back to the embedded JPEG, or are rejected as too large.
labels.root_cause: Wrong Nikon NEF decoding and crop metadata, plus an overly conservative estimate of working memory during development.

labels.symptom: Dragging one panel tab to another dock group moves the whole tab group instead of just that tab.
labels.root_cause: Dropping a tab on another group's tab strip was handled as a move of the whole group.

labels.symptom: Liquify strokes tear the image along the edge of the brush.
labels.root_cause: The falloff did not reach zero at the brush edge, and the Density setting worked backwards.

labels.symptom: The brush outline cursor lags behind the mouse pointer.
labels.root_cause: The outline was painted on the canvas instead of being used as a native OS cursor on non-Windows platforms.

labels.symptom: Saving a document opened from a TIFF, JPEG, PNG or WebP file asks for Save As instead of saving in place.
Automation clients cannot subscribe to document opened, saved and closed events or check which features the app supports.
Scripts cannot launch the app as an external editor and wait until the file is closed.
Opening a file while the app is already running starts a second copy instead of using the running one.
Preferences changes can't be saved without closing the dialog.
In menus a submenu closes, and other rows open, when the pointer moves diagonally toward the submenu.
labels.root_cause: egui's SubMenu keeps a submenu open only while the pointer heads straight at it (is_moving_towards_rect), with no triangle tolerance.

labels.symptom: Many interface strings stay untranslated in Brazilian Portuguese.
labels.root_cause: The pt-br catalog was missing entries.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking the canvas with the Zoom or Hand tool does nothing instead of opening a view/zoom menu.
The whole screen flashes white when picking a color from the screen.
labels.root_cause: The picker viewport was shown before its captured frame was painted.

labels.symptom: Retouch brushes change a larger area than the cursor outline shows.
Khmer, Lao and Burmese text shows as empty boxes even though the system has a font for the script.
labels.root_cause: The font fallback list had no Khmer, Lao or Myanmar font families.

labels.symptom: An inline rename field stays open after clicking elsewhere, and starting a second rename leaves several fields open, so the panel stops responding.
labels.root_cause: The rename text field called request_focus() every frame and rename state was stored per item, so focus was never lost and several fields kept taking focus from each other.

labels.symptom: The bracket-key brush size shortcut stops at 2 px and never reaches 1 px.
labels.root_cause: The size decrease rounding did not floor, so the size stayed at 2 px.

labels.symptom: On Windows 7 or 8 the app installs but will not start, showing a 'ProcessPrng could not be located' error.
labels.root_cause: Rust 1.78 and later need ProcessPrng, which exists only on Windows 10 and later, and the MSI had no OS version launch condition.

labels.symptom: Copy ignores a targeted layer mask, so masks cannot be copied to other layers or documents.
labels.root_cause: The copy command did not route to the targeted mask.

labels.symptom: Photoshop refuses to open exported 32-bit PSD files.
labels.root_cause: The Color Mode Data section was written empty instead of with the HDR toning record.

labels.symptom: Typing right-to-left text pushes the text the wrong way and leaves the caret behind, and pressing Space while typing switches to the Hand tool.
labels.root_cause: Layout pinned the left edge for RTL point text and dropped trailing whitespace, and the hold-key handler did not treat canvas text editing as a focused text field.

labels.symptom: Indexed-colour PNG exports reopen at 72 ppi instead of the document resolution.
labels.root_cause: The palette PNG encoder never wrote a pHYs chunk.

labels.symptom: Dragging the color picker knob to the bottom-right corner makes it jump to the bottom-left.
labels.root_cause: The saturation/value field rebuilds HSV from RGB each frame, and black loses its saturation.

labels.symptom: There's no preference to turn off UI animations such as fading menus and smooth scrolling.
labels.root_cause: egui's animation_time and scroll animation are always left at their default values.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Czech.
The Vanishing Point window can't tear off perpendicular planes or clone in perspective.
When the canvas view is rotated, the rulers lose most of their ticks and guides stay level instead of turning with the image.
labels.root_cause: Rulers and guides were placed using the rotated view transform, so document axes no longer lined up with the screen axes.

labels.symptom: Smart filter blending options are missing, and opacity changes translucent alpha slightly.
labels.root_cause: Filter strength did not interpolate premultiplied results.

labels.symptom: Smooth gradients imported from PSD files dip darker than their stops, so flat stretches look wrong.
labels.root_cause: Catmull-Rom interpolation of baked gradient stops overshoots between equal-coloured stops without clamping.

labels.symptom: Compressed Panasonic RW2 raw files open only as a low-resolution embedded preview.
The Dust & Scratches live preview looks blocky on large documents.
labels.root_cause: The filter was missing from the full-resolution preview allow-list.

labels.symptom: The Layers panel has no flyout menu and no thumbnail size options.
Pressing Cmd+Enter (Ctrl+Enter) does not turn the current path into a selection.
labels.root_cause: The Make Selection from Path command had no default shortcut.

labels.symptom: Opening large PNM images uses several times more memory than the decode budget allows.
labels.root_cause: The PNM decoder built a wide intermediate sample buffer that was not counted against max_alloc.

labels.symptom: An image file can't be imported directly as a brush tip.
Opening several files at once gives tabs in random order instead of name order.
labels.root_cause: Background opens added each tab when its decode finished, and the paths were never sorted.

labels.symptom: A tiny crafted native document can declare a huge canvas and make the app use enormous CPU time and memory when it opens.
labels.root_cause: The native loader accepted the manifest's declared canvas size without checking it against any size limit.

labels.symptom: A smart filter mask can't be painted after it is created.
Opening a document with a huge declared canvas can exhaust GPU memory.
labels.root_cause: GPU canvas textures were allocated with no aggregate memory budget.

labels.symptom: There are no project rules to stop panics and crashes from entering the code.
Clicking on the canvas with the Move tool does not select the layer under the pointer.
labels.root_cause: The Move tool's Auto-Select option was off by default.
