labels.symptom: Double-clicking text on the canvas with the Move tool does not start editing it.
The W and H fields in Free Transform have no way to pick a unit.
Brush dynamics cannot have their own response curve for pressure, tilt or other controls.
The LUT dropdown cannot be cycled with the arrow keys or the mouse wheel.
labels.root_cause: The Color Lookup control did not use the wheel-aware dropdown.

labels.symptom: On Windows 11, the taskbar turns black or glitched and cannot be clicked while the window is maximized or full screen.
labels.root_cause: The custom window frame's maximized size covers the taskbar area.

labels.symptom: The preference usage test fails on Windows CI when the code is checked out with CRLF line endings.
labels.root_cause: The test-module boundary scan only recognised LF line endings, so on CRLF checkouts it also counted unit-test code.

labels.symptom: The clone source overlay ignores its blend mode, and the W/H fields have no aspect-ratio link.
labels.root_cause: draw_clone_preview never read the stored overlay blend mode.

labels.symptom: On Windows 11, maximizing the window hides the taskbar as if the window were fullscreen.
labels.root_cause: The custom-titlebar window removes WS_CAPTION and WS_BORDER even while maximized, so Windows treats it as borderless fullscreen.

labels.symptom: While drawing with the Pen tool, Alt does not break a handle, and dragging on the first anchor does not pull out handles when closing the path.
UI scale jumps from 100% straight to 125% with no steps in between.
labels.root_cause: The list of UI scale presets has no values between 100% and 125%.

labels.symptom: Fast curved brush strokes look faceted, like polygons with visible corners.
labels.root_cause: Sparse pointer events were joined with straight lines, with no spline interpolation before smoothing and dab spacing.

labels.symptom: The Motion Blur dialog has only a linear angle slider and no interactive direction dial.
After Save As, reopening the saved file shows the old document name instead of the new filename.
labels.root_cause: The document is serialized before the session updates its name to the new filename.

labels.symptom: Color Range ignores the active selection and samples the whole canvas.
labels.root_cause: select.colorRange does not limit its result to the active selection.

labels.symptom: A child layer's effects appear clipped on the canvas when its group also has an effect, although the export looks right.
labels.root_cause: The group's effect region uses its children's pixel bounds and leaves out the children's own effect margins.

labels.symptom: The Color panel shows mid-grey as light grey (about 188 instead of 128), so its HSB values are wrong.
labels.root_cause: The panel converts colours with egui's Hsva, which works in linear light rather than on sRGB values.

labels.symptom: No native Windows ARM64 installer is offered.
labels.root_cause: The release pipeline built only x64 Windows binaries.

labels.symptom: Moving a shape layer from a PSD changes its anti-aliasing compared with Photoshop.
labels.root_cause: translate_vectors re-renders the shape on every move instead of shifting the rendered pixels.

labels.symptom: The [ shortcut can't make the brush smaller than 2 px.
labels.root_cause: A 25% step down from 2 px rounds back to 2, so the size never reaches 1.

labels.symptom: Automation agents may assume a command batch rolls back on error, but it does not.
labels.root_cause: The command_batch tool description did not say the batch is not atomic.

labels.symptom: Very large solid-colour documents save but fail to reopen, or use huge amounts of memory once reopened.
labels.root_cause: The loader decoded deduplicated tiles once per reference instead of once per distinct tile.

labels.symptom: In the colour panel, the middle of the brightness range shows light grey (about 188) instead of neutral grey (128).
labels.root_cause: The panel used egui's Hsva, which computes HSV over linear RGB instead of sRGB-encoded values.

labels.symptom: Free Warp, Distort and Perspective cannot be used on live type without rasterizing it.
Choosing or saving gradient presets requires opening a separate Gradients panel.
Preset or actions files that fail to load are overwritten on the next save, and their contents are lost.
labels.root_cause: Files that failed to load were not tracked, so the next sync rewrote them with only the in-memory entries.

labels.symptom: The app icon uses the old animal artwork instead of the letter monogram.
Tests fail at random in CI but pass when run alone.
labels.root_cause: Tests use small 'nonexistent' layer id sentinels like 9999 that can collide with real ids from a process-wide counter.

labels.symptom: Canon sRAW/mRAW files open only as their embedded JPEG preview.
labels.root_cause: The CR2 reader did not support subsampled lossless JPEG.
bug_markers: Canon sRAW / mRAW is not supported yet

labels.symptom: CMYK documents export to TIFF or JPEG as RGB, and K-only black turns into four-colour black.
labels.root_cause: The composite was converted CMYK to RGB and back through the profile instead of being blended on ink values.
bug_markers: Cmyk composite written as sRGB RGB

labels.symptom: The Minimum and Maximum filters are slow at large radii.
New layer masks in 16-bit or 32-bit documents behave differently after the document is reopened from PSD.
labels.root_cause: New masks were created with 8-bit samples instead of the document's depth.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, status messages show Mac modifier names such as Option-click or ⌘ instead of Alt or Ctrl.
labels.root_cause: Some hint strings had the macOS modifier notation hard-coded instead of using the platform's notation.
bug_markers: Option-click to define a source point

labels.symptom: Rounded colour swatches show white specks at their corners on dark themes.
labels.root_cause: A square checkerboard was painted under a rounded fill, so the checker showed past the rounded corners.

labels.symptom: Color Range selects matching pixels outside the active selection.
labels.root_cause: Color Range evaluated the whole canvas and ignored the existing selection mask.

labels.symptom: On small displays tall menus or submenus slide up over the menu bar, hiding menu titles and opening items by themselves.
labels.root_cause: Submenus were allowed the whole window height, so egui moved them up over the menu bar.

labels.symptom: Changing fill, stroke color or stroke width in the options bar does not update the selected shape.
labels.root_cause: The options bar only changed the defaults for the next shape.

labels.symptom: Gradients with stops very close together render with visible colour errors on the GPU.
labels.root_cause: The GPU gradient lookup table cannot resolve stops closer than one entry, and only identical stops fell back to the CPU.

labels.symptom: Render Video from the menu fails immediately because no output location is asked for.
labels.root_cause: Menu calls the render command with empty parameters and no save dialog.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app reopens as a tiny 160 × 64 strip on every launch after being closed while minimized.
labels.root_cause: eframe saves the minimized window size and restores it without applying the minimum inner size.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Bengali.
Pressing an adjustment dialog's shortcut again does not close the dialog.
labels.root_cause: Shortcut dispatch did not treat a repeated shortcut as dismissal.

labels.symptom: Images cannot be exported as JPEG XL.
Render Video from the menu fails immediately because no output location is asked for.
labels.root_cause: Menu calls the render command with empty parameters and no save dialog.

labels.symptom: Copying several selected layers pastes only one layer.
labels.root_cause: Copy took only the active layer's pixels.

labels.symptom: Content-aware fill and healing are slow, and cancelling a large fill takes too long.
labels.root_cause: Long stages never checked the cancel flag, and colour adaptation work was expensive.

labels.symptom: There is no UI Scale step between 100% and 125%, so 1440p displays are either too small or too large.
labels.root_cause: The UI scale enum had no steps between 100% and 125%.

labels.symptom: On Linux systems with no file-dialog portal or zenity, File Open and Save do nothing and show no message.
labels.root_cause: When the file dialog failed it returned an empty answer, which was treated as Cancel.

labels.symptom: The automation document-inspect command does not return the document's file path.
labels.root_cause: The inspect output did not include the path.

labels.symptom: Opening a crafted or corrupt TIFF file crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: The tiff 0.10 crate indexed an empty SampleFormat list.

labels.symptom: Automation sessions give no warning when text falls back from a missing font.
labels.root_cause: The headless serve and MCP replies don't include the missing-font warnings that the CLI prints.

labels.symptom: The Motion Blur angle can only be set with a straight slider instead of an angle dial.
labels.root_cause: The filter dialog drew every numeric parameter as a slider, and the only angle dial was private to the Layer Style dialog.

labels.symptom: When the color picker opens, you have to click the hex field and select its text before you can copy or paste a color code.
labels.root_cause: The hex field was not given focus or selected when the dialog opened.

labels.symptom: Pasted SVG arrives only as a bitmap, and embedded SVG cannot be edited in an external program.
An edited crop is not applied when switching to another tool from the toolbar.
labels.root_cause: Switching tools from the toolbar did not commit the pending crop frame.

labels.symptom: The Magnetic Lasso drifts off high-contrast edges instead of snapping along them.
labels.root_cause: The live-wire cost treated edge tangents as directed vectors, so a gradient polarity reversal penalized the same edge.

labels.symptom: The colour swap arrow in the toolbox is hard to recognise.
No tests check that recorded actions replay correctly on a second document.
The signed macOS app in the downloaded DMG fails code-signature validation.
labels.root_cause: Extended attributes added at build time and the DMG packaging step break the strict codesign check.

labels.symptom: Several tests fail intermittently under heavy machine load but pass on their own.
labels.root_cause: Creating a new font database bumped the global font generation, causing endless repaints, and other tests relied on fixed time windows.

labels.symptom: The app cannot be built or run on Android.
A double line appears between the menu bar and the options bar.
labels.root_cause: Separator lines were painted by hand even though the top panel already draws its own separator.

labels.symptom: PSD Filter Gallery smart filters open as kept but not editable.
labels.root_cause: The GEfc smart filter descriptor was never mapped on PSD import/export.

labels.symptom: Colors and contrast in the raw developer preview look different from the final applied image.
labels.root_cause: Preview pixels were drawn as raw 8-bit color, skipping the document-to-monitor display conversion.

labels.symptom: Automation server and MCP replies give no warning when text falls back from a missing font.
labels.root_cause: Missing-font warnings were only emitted on CLI convert/run/info paths, not on serve/mcp.

labels.symptom: After you create an adjustment or fill layer, Properties shows mask controls instead of the layer's settings.
labels.root_cause: Properties followed the targeted mask, not the new layer.

labels.symptom: On small screens long menus run under the taskbar or off-screen and their last items can't be reached.
labels.root_cause: The default window is larger than the display, and menus were sized to the window's content rect rather than the visible monitor area.

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
Switching themes replaces the selected Color panel with a different tab.
labels.root_cause: The theme switch kept the numeric tab index, but each theme orders the tabs differently.

labels.symptom: The Color Balance adjustment gives very different results from other editors, and mid grays are left unchanged by Shadows.
labels.root_cause: The sliders were treated as independent RGB offsets, and the tonal masks used encoded Rec.601 luma.

labels.symptom: After moving selected pixels, the transform controls stay at the old position.
labels.root_cause: The floating selection offset was ignored when drawing and hit-testing the transform controls.

labels.symptom: Splitters between docked panel groups are invisible and drags move them less than the pointer.
labels.root_cause: Splitter drawing gave no visual grip, and per-frame drag_delta dropped the movement made before the drag threshold.

labels.symptom: Duplicate Layer copies immediately without asking for a name or destination document.
Save As offers no PDF format.
labels.root_cause: The PDF writer lived only in the print path and could not be reached from the export dispatch.

labels.symptom: Perceptual, Linear or Smooth gradients from PSD files render as Classic after editing.
labels.root_cause: The importer read the interpolation method from the unused gs99 key instead of gradientsInterpolationMethod, and Smooth had no model.

labels.symptom: Color Balance adjustments render colours visibly different from the reference app.
labels.root_cause: Color Balance used a lightness-weighted additive model instead of per-channel levels and gamma curves.

labels.symptom: Warp presets like Arc, Flag and Squeeze produce shapes noticeably different from the reference app.
labels.root_cause: Presets used closed-form approximations instead of the reference app's bicubic Bezier control grids.

labels.symptom: Ctrl/Cmd-clicking a shape or path thumbnail doesn't load its outline as a selection and may select the whole canvas.
labels.root_cause: Thumbnail gesture was not wired up, and uncached shape transparency was treated as fully opaque.

labels.symptom: Opening images with odd or malicious EXIF orientation data can crash the app or bypass size limits.
labels.root_cause: Size limits were not checked again after rotation, the rotated buffer was allocated infallibly, and IFD parsing was too lax.

labels.symptom: Switching to another tool with an edited crop frame leaves the crop pending instead of applying it.
labels.root_cause: The tool-switch path did not commit the pending edited crop.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Vietnamese.
Run-time generated labels show in English in the Czech interface.
labels.root_cause: Dynamic labels were missing from the Czech catalog.

labels.symptom: Edits to action definitions cannot be undone with Ctrl/Cmd+Z.
labels.root_cause: There was no undo history for action-definition edits.

labels.symptom: New Document presets lump iOS and Android together and have no billboard sizes.
In the Studio-style theme, individual layer lock options disappear, leaving only Lock All.
labels.root_cause: The Studio layout skipped rendering the individual lock controls.

labels.symptom: Headless automation sessions can't load fonts from a file or folder.
The Actions step list stops growing at a fixed height even when its panel is enlarged.
labels.root_cause: The list height was capped at 320 points and nested inside the dock scroll area.

labels.symptom: Replaying a recorded action that toggles layer visibility misses or affects the wrong layer in another document.
labels.root_cause: Recorded visibility steps stored document-local layer IDs instead of portable name-based targets.

labels.symptom: Quick Export as PNG exports only one layer when several layers are selected.
labels.root_cause: Quick export took only a single source layer and was disabled for multiple selections.

labels.symptom: Holding the tilde key with the brush does not erase temporarily.
labels.root_cause: The brush and pencil had no hold-key Clear mode.

labels.symptom: Scripted commands that name a specific layer are refused when a different layer is selected.
labels.root_cause: The command availability check looked at the active layer instead of the layer named in the params.
bug_markers: the active layer is a Group layer, not a smart object

labels.symptom: The brush cursor is always a circle and doesn't show the shape of shaped brush tips.
Opening several files with mismatched color profiles shows all prompts at once, and each answer is applied to the active document instead of the file it was asked about.
labels.root_cause: The profile mismatch command acted on the active document, and files were not held back until their prompt was answered.

labels.symptom: The selected brush resets to the default after restarting the app.
labels.root_cause: The last-used brush was never saved to preferences.

labels.symptom: A scorecard entry wrongly says the save paths have no tests.
labels.root_cause: The scorecard entry was out of date.

labels.symptom: The scorecard lists features that already work as not done.
On Linux, the window is not matched to its launcher entry in docks and taskbars.
labels.root_cause: StartupWMClass in the .desktop file does not match the window's app id.

labels.symptom: Edit > Clear is very slow on large selections.
labels.root_cause: The whole selection bounds were processed in one f32 buffer on a single thread.

labels.symptom: Opening a tiny crafted document whose pattern claims a huge size makes the app abort.
labels.root_cause: Pattern dimensions from the file are not validated on load.

labels.symptom: Saving shows no percentage in the status bar or the document tab.
labels.root_cause: The export and the file write each ran as a single call with no progress reporting.

labels.symptom: On Windows, the mouse cursor stutters at a low frame rate while the app has focus and the pointer is over the title bar or outside the window.
labels.root_cause: The window is presented with AutoVsync on Windows.

labels.symptom: Opening large layered documents is slow.
labels.root_cause: ZIP entries are looked up linearly by name for every tile, and CRC-32 is computed one byte at a time.

labels.symptom: Triple, quadruple and five clicks in text editing do not select the line, paragraph or all text.
labels.root_cause: egui only counts clicks up to three, and the type tool handled only double-click.

labels.symptom: Panel buttons can change the document directly, without going through a command that automation can see.
labels.root_cause: No check made sure panel click handlers dispatch command ids.

labels.symptom: There is no user or security documentation book and no responsible disclosure policy.
The Color Picker dialog is larger than the original's and its buttons stretch across the whole column.
labels.root_cause: The color picker layout used oversized field, spacing and button widths.

labels.symptom: Documents with embedded blobs fail to load or crash when the size limit is set to unlimited.
labels.root_cause: The size bound used in blob decoding overflowed, and ZIP entry reads were sliced without bounds checks.

labels.symptom: Autosave reports a failure for a save that succeeded, and leftover recovery files are never cleaned up after a crash.
labels.root_cause: Removing unreferenced files after the commit failed the whole save, and partial recovery bundles and temp files were never swept.

labels.symptom: Monochrome DNG files fail to open with an unsupported LinearRaw error.
labels.root_cause: The DNG decoder only accepted LinearRaw data with 3 samples per pixel.
bug_markers: LinearRaw data with 1 samples per pixel

labels.symptom: The ruler zero point cannot be dragged from the ruler corner or reset.
While a crop is pending, Undo/Redo steps the document instead of the crop box.
labels.root_cause: Undo/Redo commands were not routed to the pending crop's own history.

labels.symptom: After installing the deb or Flatpak on Linux, the app has no launcher icon.
labels.root_cause: The .desktop file's StartupWMClass was wrong or missing and did not match the app id.

labels.symptom: Dragging the gradient midpoint diamond on the canvas had no regression test.
Scorecard rows list features as missing or partial after they have already landed.
labels.root_cause: The scorecard docs were not updated after the work merged.

labels.symptom: A README link points to the wrong architecture heading.
There is no Android tablet build with pen pressure support.
Exporting layers to separate files always uses the full canvas size, leaving transparent margins around each image.
In a dark theme, the foreground and background color chips show as large circles instead of squares.
labels.root_cause: The theme palette enabled round_chips.

labels.symptom: You cannot drag across several checkboxes to check or uncheck them in one stroke.
labels.root_cause: The shared checkbox widget sensed only clicks, not drags.

labels.symptom: Scrolling the mouse wheel over a closed dropdown does not change its selection.
labels.root_cause: Dropdown pickers handled only clicks and arrow keys, not wheel input.

labels.symptom: Smoothed brush strokes show no string from the brush to the pointer.
Pressing a tool shortcut key repeatedly cycles through the tools in its group instead of staying on the current tool.
labels.root_cause: The Use Shift Key for Tool Switch preference defaulted to false.

labels.symptom: A PSD saved with a new type layer fails to open in Photopea.
labels.root_cause: PSD export always writes a stub document-level Txt2 block with an empty resources dictionary.

labels.symptom: The app ships no bundled CJK fonts and relies only on system fonts.
The align bar shows only some align buttons with unclear icons, and its menu is text only.
labels.root_cause: Only three align commands were wired up, using generic placeholder icons.

labels.symptom: Clicking a state in the History panel is very laggy because the whole document gets redrawn.
labels.root_cause: Jumping to a state ran undo or redo once per step, which bumped the document revision each time and forced a full recomposite and GPU re-upload.

labels.symptom: The History panel has no menu, and Step Forward, Step Backward and Clear History can't be run as commands.
There is no History Options dialog, so non-linear history can't be turned on and layer visibility changes can't be made non-undoable.
The History Brush always paints from the oldest history state and the source can't be picked from the History panel.
A recorded Save in an action overwrites the original recording file instead of the file the action is played on.
labels.root_cause: Save of a flat file was recorded as Save As with a fixed path.

labels.symptom: The toolbar's one/two-column toggle is missing in non-Pro themes.
labels.root_cause: Toolbar chevron drawing was gated on Tokens.pro.

labels.symptom: After one interrupted start, every later launch silently uses software CPU rendering even though the GPU works.
labels.root_cause: Startup recovery automatically saved CPU rendering to preferences after fallback succeeded, without the user's consent.

labels.symptom: Fast brush strokes look jagged and the brush cursor lags behind the OS pointer.
labels.root_cause: Only one pointer position was sampled per frame and the cursor was drawn by canvas rendering.

labels.symptom: A PSD saved with a new type layer fails to open in Photopea.
labels.root_cause: PSD export always writes a stub document-level Txt2 block with an empty resources dictionary.

labels.symptom: The gradient tool icon is hard to recognise and gets mistaken for other tools.
Opening a malformed colour swatch or gradient file can crash, give wrong colours, or cut emoji names into broken text.
labels.root_cause: Standalone swatch and gradient parsers did not guard non-finite values and cut UTF-16 names in the middle of surrogate pairs.

labels.symptom: The History panel's camera button does not take snapshots.
The gutter preference in Units & Rulers has no effect on the first New Guide Layout.
labels.root_cause: The gutter setting was not wired to the guide layout dialog.

labels.symptom: The Character panel has no preset dropdowns for font size, leading and tracking.
A 32-bit Levels unit test fails in the full test run.
labels.root_cause: The test still expected 32-bit float Levels to clip to 0 and 255, after HDR values were made to stay unclipped.

labels.symptom: The New Guide dialog only takes whole pixels and has no colour option.
labels.root_cause: New Guide used the generic schema dialog.

labels.symptom: The CLI and MCP server bundled in the Linux AppImage cannot be started; any argument opens the GUI instead.
labels.root_cause: The AppRun script always runs the GUI binary and has no way to select the bundled CLI.

labels.symptom: The Character panel has no preset dropdowns for font size, leading and tracking.
The Recent Fonts setting does nothing, and recently used fonts don't show at the top of the font menu.
labels.root_cause: The type.recentFonts preference was never wired into the font menu.

labels.symptom: There are no Stamp Visible or Stamp Down commands for merging layers into a new layer.
After a PSD round trip, the Background layer opens in Photoshop as an ordinary layer.
labels.root_cause: The PSD exporter always writes a -1 transparency channel for the bottom layer.

labels.symptom: The set of MCP acceptance tasks is too small.
The Gradient tool icon looks like two overlapping circles and is hard to recognise.
labels.root_cause: The Gradient tool used the Lucide 'blend' glyph.

labels.symptom: In exported files, a type layer gets a made-up font name, so other apps report the font as missing and substitute another.
labels.root_cause: A PostScript name was made up from the family name instead of being resolved from the installed font face.

labels.symptom: The set of agent acceptance tasks is too small.
No tests check that recorded actions replay correctly on another document.
Clicking the original document state at the top of the History panel does nothing.
More automation acceptance tasks are needed.
A floating panel window that was open when the app was closed reopens on the next launch, even with no document open.
labels.root_cause: The saved workspace layout restores the floating window's visibility at startup.

labels.symptom: After Save As, the saved file still carries the old document name, so reopening it shows the previous name.
labels.root_cause: The document was serialised before its new name was adopted.

labels.symptom: A misspelled anchor in a canvas resize command silently places the canvas at an anchor nobody chose instead of returning an error.
labels.root_cause: Each axis was parsed separately with different case rules, and unknown values were not rejected.

labels.symptom: A tool settings panel left open at quit reappears over the home screen on the next launch.
labels.root_cause: The restored layout includes the brush settings panel's visibility flag.

labels.symptom: On Linux, software centres such as Ubuntu App Center don't show the app's icon properly or stall on the remote screenshot when installing the .deb.
labels.root_cause: The AppStream metainfo declares the icon as type stock and references a remote GitHub screenshot image.

labels.symptom: Several contributors open duplicate PRs for the same issue.
labels.root_cause: The contributing guide gives no rule about claiming an issue before starting work.

labels.symptom: Some exported PSD files with transparency and alpha channels fail to open in the reference app.
labels.root_cause: Alpha channel resources omitted the merged transparency entry, and DisplayInfo records were 14 bytes instead of 13.

labels.symptom: Precise and centre-source glow effects render very differently from the reference.
labels.root_cause: The ramp ended at size instead of size+1, and the centre inversion was applied before the contour.

labels.symptom: Fast smudge strokes leave visible bands or echoes instead of a smooth smear.
labels.root_cause: Smudge dabs were placed at the brush spacing, which is too far apart for the carried pixels on large brushes.

labels.symptom: No test checked that Color Range at Fuzziness 0 selects only exact matches.
UI choices such as the last-picked tool in a grouped toolbar slot go back to the default after a restart.
labels.root_cause: The UI state was stored with egui's temporary data API (insert_temp/get_temp), which is not saved when the app exits.

labels.symptom: Running fuzz targets locally leaves untracked files in the checkout.
labels.root_cause: The fuzz crates' .gitignore files are missing or don't match each other.

labels.symptom: With Simplified Chinese selected, many labels and panel section names still show in English.
labels.root_cause: The zh-hans catalog was missing keys, and some section names were painted directly without going through translation.

labels.symptom: Skew transform acts like Free Transform: corner drags scale the box and side handles move in any direction.
labels.root_cause: Skew was turned into modifier keys, which couldn't limit a corner or side to moving along one axis.

labels.symptom: A newly created adjustment or fill layer selects its mask, so its settings don't appear in the Properties panel.
labels.root_cause: Layer creation targeted the mask thumbnail instead of the layer itself.

labels.symptom: Chisel bevel facets are about twice as steep as in the reference app.
labels.root_cause: The facet slope and ramp ends were computed wrongly.

labels.symptom: The web build fails CI because the wasm file exceeds the size limit.
labels.root_cause: The wasm-release profile is optimized for speed instead of size.

labels.symptom: Free Transform cannot transform several selected layers together.
Filters applied through a selection run slowly on large images.
labels.root_cause: Selection mixing allocated a temporary vector for every pixel.

labels.symptom: A document with a gray ICC profile using an mBA LUT crashes when its profile is re-encoded.
labels.root_cause: The ICC writer panicked on a LUT stage layout it does not support.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking the canvas does not list the layers under the pointer.
labels.root_cause: There was no layer-pick context menu.

labels.symptom: In some themes a tool's options bar shows only a hint and no controls.
labels.root_cause: The options bar arm was gated on Pro themes.

labels.symptom: A smart object pasted into another document cannot be opened.
labels.root_cause: Copying did not carry the document's linked-layer blocks (lnk2/lnk3/lnkD).

labels.symptom: The Save As dialog leaves out some file formats the app supports.
labels.root_cause: The save dialog's format filter list was incomplete.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking with the Polygonal Lasso adds a point instead of closing the polygon, and the old selection stays visible while drawing a new one.
With an unlinked layer mask targeted, the Move tool moves the layer instead of only the mask.
labels.root_cause: layer.translate ignored the mask target.

labels.symptom: Some menu items and tooltips stay in English in every translated language.
labels.root_cause: Translation calls with variable arguments are missed by the literal string scan, so those strings never reach the catalogs.

labels.symptom: Memory keeps growing after repeated selection edits because old undo states aren't freed.
labels.root_cause: Selection masks weren't counted in the history's pixel memory budget, so trim never evicted those states.

labels.symptom: Desaturate, Equalize and Replace Color refuse to run on a smart object.
labels.root_cause: These commands checked for a pixel layer only and never used the smart-filter path.

labels.symptom: In translated interfaces, labels overlap neighbouring controls in fixed-width rows.
labels.root_cause: Translated labels next to fixed-width controls are not elided or clipped to the space they have.

labels.symptom: Holding Shift+Alt before a marquee drag should intersect the selection, but no test covered it.
On Windows the custom-titlebar window shows a black frame, offset input or a classic caption bar, or hides the taskbar when maximized or fullscreen.
labels.root_cause: The undecorated window keeps WS_THICKFRAME/WS_EX_WINDOWEDGE, and winit swallows WM_NCCALCSIZE, so the kernel's WFCPRESENT flag stays set.

labels.symptom: No responsive artboard variants or batch export.
Automation sessions give no warning when text uses a font that is not installed.
labels.root_cause: Missing-font warnings were only added to one-shot CLI commands, not session server replies.

labels.symptom: Opening a malformed HEIC file in the web build can crash the browser tab.
labels.root_cause: heic-rs 0.1.1 panics on malformed input, and panics abort on wasm32.

labels.symptom: Picking a color while editing text doesn't recolor the selected characters.
labels.root_cause: The color panels only set the foreground color.

labels.symptom: When resizing the crop frame with snapping on, the frame stops a few pixels short of or past the snap line.
labels.root_cause: Resizes without Auto Center snapped the pointer position rather than the frame handle, so the grab offset was ignored.

labels.symptom: With an AppImage integrator such as AppImageLauncher installed, two launchers for the app appear in the application menu.
labels.root_cause: The AppRun script writes its own .desktop file even when an external integrator already made one, and the packaged .desktop file lacks X-AppImage-Integrate=false.

labels.symptom: Copying several selected layers pastes only the last selected layer.
labels.root_cause: Copy packaged only one whole layer instead of all selected top-level layers.

labels.symptom: Hovering clickable tabs or buttons shows a text I-beam cursor instead of a pointing hand.
labels.root_cause: Clickable controls were built from selectable egui labels.

labels.symptom: Undo during Free Transform undoes the document's last step instead of the last transform step, and the handles are hard to grab.
labels.root_cause: Undo wasn't routed to the open transform session.

labels.symptom: A wide outside stroke effect has a faceted, polygonal outer edge.
labels.root_cause: The outside distance used a 5x5 chamfer distance transform instead of an exact Euclidean one.

labels.symptom: No scrollbars appear on the canvas when the document is larger than the view.
labels.root_cause: The canvas view had no scrollbar widget, and the overscroll preference was not wired up.

labels.symptom: CI fails on every run: formatting checks fail, new clippy lints fail, and GPU tests panic on Windows because of a shader compile error.
labels.root_cause: There was no rustfmt config, Rust 1.99 added new clippy lints, and FXC aborts when a shader loops over dynamically indexed vector components.

labels.symptom: Alt+right-drag with a brush does not change the brush size or hardness.
labels.root_cause: There was no handler for the Alt+right-drag brush gesture.

labels.symptom: Holding Alt and scrolling over the canvas does not zoom.
labels.root_cause: Wheel input did not treat Alt+scroll as a zoom gesture.

labels.symptom: HEIC/HEIF photos can't be opened and fail with 'unrecognized image format'.
labels.root_cause: There was no HEIF decoder.

labels.symptom: Long operations and file opens freeze the window, with no progress shown and no way to cancel.
labels.root_cause: Commands and file opens ran on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: There is no Arch Linux AUR package.
Paragraph text box handles can't be dragged to resize the box.
labels.root_cause: Pointer down on box handles only placed the caret.

labels.symptom: There is no TGA option in Save As or Export As.
labels.root_cause: The save filters and the export format list did not include TGA.

labels.symptom: After one automation request panics, every later request fails with a 'session lock poisoned' error.
labels.root_cause: The RPC handler did not catch panics, so the session mutex was poisoned and the connection thread died.

labels.symptom: There is no Patch tool for healing a selection.
Copying an image file in a file manager and pressing Ctrl+V does nothing and says the clipboard is empty.
labels.root_cause: The clipboard service only asked for image data and ignored copied file paths.

labels.symptom: Content-Aware Scale on large images takes many minutes.
labels.root_cause: Every removed seam recomputed the full energy map and copied the whole image on one thread.

labels.symptom: Content-aware scaling a 1 px wide or tall layer fails with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: The seam-carving loop stopped at width 1, so enlarging produced an image of the wrong size and a later step panicked.

labels.symptom: Saving a PSD whose text layer has unusual engine data crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: The PSD writer called expect on a missing EngineDict entry.

labels.symptom: The command id in the docs and MCP schema examples fails with unknown command.
labels.root_cause: The docs and schema descriptions used a command id that was never registered.

labels.symptom: The control protocol docs say file open and save commands work over the control channel, but the app refuses them.
labels.root_cause: The docs were out of step with the policy that refuses path-taking commands under automation.

labels.symptom: In the web build, running a timed command panics at runtime.
labels.root_cause: std::time::Instant::now() is used on wasm32-unknown-unknown, where it panics at runtime.

labels.symptom: Opening files shows a profile mismatch prompt between two identical sRGB profiles.
labels.root_cause: Profiles were compared by hash of ICC bytes rather than by colour behaviour.

labels.symptom: PSD files with smart filters on more than one smart object show a warning, and the later filter masks are not loaded.
labels.root_cause: The FEid reader read only the first length-prefixed section.

labels.symptom: Shapes with a hairline stroke show a solid dark edge.
labels.root_cause: The fitted stroke used the stroke colour at an alpha that was mostly the fill's.

labels.symptom: The Linux AppImage can't be delta-updated by AppImage update tools.
labels.root_cause: The AppImage had no embedded update information and no .zsync file was published.

labels.symptom: Image pyramid code could in theory crash on an empty level list.
labels.root_cause: Used expect on levels.last().

labels.symptom: Exposure adjustment on 32-bit documents gives much brighter/wrong results than expected.
labels.root_cause: Exposure applied a 2.2 tone curve to already-linear 32-bit samples, applying gamma twice.

labels.symptom: Opening a very large file fails with 'The parameter is incorrect (os error 87)', or File > Open quietly does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The whole file is read with one std::fs::read call, which can send a single huge ReadFile request that some Windows file systems reject.

labels.symptom: Levels clips input and output values in 32-bit documents.
labels.root_cause: The integer clipped Levels curve was used for float documents.

labels.symptom: Re-saving a PSD changes its layer lock flags.
labels.root_cause: The artboard lock was mapped to bit 0x10 instead of Photoshop's 0x08.

labels.symptom: The Camera Raw dialog has no histogram, clipping warnings or scopes.
French is not offered as a UI language.
Dragging the Angle slider for drop shadow or bevel effects does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The dialog had no Use Global Light option and never sent it, so the effect always used the fixed global light angle.

labels.symptom: Native release downloads are large, with a universal Mac app and the CLI bundled into GUI packages.
labels.root_cause: Universal binaries, uncompressed embedded Japanese fonts and no size-optimized release profile.

labels.symptom: A plain cargo build builds only the CLI and not the desktop app.
labels.root_cause: The workspace default-members list left out the desktop app crate.

labels.symptom: After editing a perspective-distorted smart object, it is re-rendered as a parallelogram.
labels.root_cause: Smart objects stored only an affine placement, so the fourth corner was lost.

labels.symptom: There is no report of how much of the UI each language translates.
Bit-depth labels do not say whether a depth uses integer or floating-point samples.
Contributor docs list the renamed VectorCraft sibling as DrawCraft.
labels.root_cause: Stale product name in AGENTS.md.

labels.symptom: On Wayland, dragging files onto the window does nothing and no explanation is shown.
labels.root_cause: winit does not support native file drag-and-drop on Wayland.

labels.symptom: Exporting very large documents produces a PSD over the 2 GiB format limit instead of a PSB.
labels.root_cause: Export did not estimate encoded size to switch to PSB above 2 GiB.

labels.symptom: The status bar doesn't show the document's active ICC color profile.
The Mixer Brush can't be selected from the toolbar.
When the GPU fails or can't present the window, the app crashes or renders nothing, and there's no way to choose CPU rendering.
labels.root_cause: Startup accepted adapters that couldn't present the window and had no CPU fallback when the GPU failed at runtime.

labels.symptom: Liquify has no redo.
An automation UI-settings call with unknown fields reports success but changes nothing, and the theme error lists only some themes.
labels.root_cause: The ui.set handler silently skipped unknown keys, and the theme list was a hardcoded string.

labels.symptom: The headless server's methods list leaves out the job list and cancel methods.
labels.root_cause: The hardcoded METHODS array was missing jobs.list and jobs.cancel.

labels.symptom: An MCP batch step with wait false still blocks until the command finishes instead of returning a job id.
labels.root_cause: command_batch dropped the per-step wait field when forwarding steps.

labels.symptom: A headless automation save without a path overwrites the opened flat file with a flattened export or the wrong format.
labels.root_cause: Headless and control-channel saves without a path fell back to the document's source file whatever the format.

labels.symptom: Batch processing silently overwrites outputs from inputs with the same name and still reports success.
labels.root_cause: Every output was named <stem>.<ext> in one folder without checking whether that name was already written in the run.

labels.symptom: Indonesian is not offered as a UI language.
Holding Alt with a painting tool doesn't sample a colour.
labels.root_cause: Painting tools had no Alt-eyedropper shortcut.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking a layer row always starts a rename instead of opening Layer Style.
labels.root_cause: Every double-click on a layer row went to rename.

labels.symptom: There is no lasso or mask hotkeys inside the Liquify editor.
Installer download instructions are hard to find in the README.
There is no way to create a new document from the clipboard image.
Camera Raw filter settings are dropped when exporting to PSD.
The CLI silently ignores misspelled flags, and running a subcommand with --help runs the subcommand instead of printing help.
labels.root_cause: The argument parser kept unknown flags, and each subcommand read only the flags it wanted.

labels.symptom: Liquify brush settings reset to their defaults each time it opens.
labels.root_cause: Liquify settings were not saved.

labels.symptom: The main window opens at a different offset from the top-left corner on each launch instead of centred.
labels.root_cause: The window was created without a position, so Windows placed it with its default cascade.

labels.symptom: Resetting a single colour-settings preference fails with an unknown preference error.
labels.root_cause: prefs.reset did not route nested colorSettings paths to the colour settings state.

labels.symptom: The Image Size dialog accepts a zero width and its preview disagrees with the size actually applied.
labels.root_cause: The shared dimension field allows values below 1, and the dialog did not clamp them before showing the preview.

labels.symptom: README lacks a star history chart.
Alt+bracket shortcuts for moving between layers are missing.
Building with an older Rust toolchain fails with many egui errors.
labels.root_cause: Declared rust-version was lower than egui 0.36 requires.

labels.symptom: Number keys do not set opacity, and the hardness and Camera Raw shortcuts are missing.
There is no Transform Again on a Copy (step and repeat) shortcut.
No shortcut to free-transform a copy of the layer.
There is no preference to show a bounding box instead of a live preview while dragging a layer.
Typing into the color picker's hex, Lab or CMYK fields is ignored or changes other values.
labels.root_cause: The fields were rebuilt from the colour every frame, and each keystroke was applied immediately through clamped sRGB.

labels.symptom: Dialogs jump and re-centre when their content changes height.
labels.root_cause: Dialogs were anchored at the screen centre instead of pinning their top-left after first layout.

labels.symptom: Many tool, filter and menu labels appear untranslated in the Spanish interface.
labels.root_cause: Spanish translation catalog was missing entries.

labels.symptom: On macOS the Dock icon does not use the layered system icon from the app bundle.
labels.root_cause: The runtime window icon overrides the bundle icon unless IconData::default() is passed.

labels.symptom: A text layer keeps its placeholder name after its text is edited.
labels.root_cause: Only the first editing session renamed the layer; later text edits kept the old name.

labels.symptom: The color picker dialog can't sample colors from the image with an eyedropper.
Dragging a layer larger than the canvas smears edge pixels instead of revealing the off-canvas part.
labels.root_cause: Move preview damage rect was clipped to the canvas at drag start, so incoming strips were never redrawn.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+Insert and Shift+Insert don't copy and paste on Linux, and Shift+Insert doesn't paste images on Windows.
labels.root_cause: egui-winit does not map Insert-key clipboard shortcuts on Linux, and it drops the paste when the clipboard holds only an image.

labels.symptom: The unsaved-changes prompt can't be answered from the keyboard, and Tab moves focus the wrong way with no visible focus ring.
labels.root_cause: egui moves Tab focus in drawing order, and the button row is drawn right to left; buttons draw no focus indicator.

labels.symptom: The roadmap, scorecard and README are out of date after recent fixes.
Editing commands could crash on unexpected document states.
labels.root_cause: Engine commands used unwrap and expect.

labels.symptom: The Gradient tool has no blend mode option.
Gradients ignore explicit transparency stops, and smart filter commands check the active layer instead of the targeted one.
labels.root_cause: Transparency stops were dropped when parsing gradient parameters, and command preconditions checked only the active layer.

labels.symptom: CLI batch mode accepts an output folder that is the same as the input folder, rejects recorded-action step formats, mishandles '--format .ext' and accepts out-of-range quality values.
labels.root_cause: The CLI had its own action parser and weak option validation, and it did not compare canonical in/out paths.

labels.symptom: Automation sessions exit on a bad request line, accept non-object params, miss finished background jobs, and lose batch results when a reply is too large.
labels.root_cause: The stdio server aborted on over-long or non-UTF-8 lines, headless requests did not sync finished jobs, params were not type-checked, and the batch reply budget did not count escaping.
fixed_markers: params must be a JSON object

labels.symptom: Closing a background window with unsaved changes opens the save prompt behind other windows.
labels.root_cause: The close guard didn't ask the window to take focus when it cancelled the close.

labels.symptom: Automation menu and dialog requests reply before their job finishes, and right-click menus opened by automation appear at the canvas centre.
labels.root_cause: Menu and dialog control methods did not wait for the jobs they started, and pointer right-clicks ignored the view transform.

labels.symptom: After a crash, recovered unsaved documents are lost if the app crashes again before the next autosave.
labels.root_cause: Recovery entries were deleted as soon as they loaded, and their keys used document ids that restart every launch.

labels.symptom: The app could crash when reading back from the GPU after the device is lost.
labels.root_cause: The GPU readback used expect on get_mapped_range, which can fail at runtime.

labels.symptom: History steps get the wrong names and undo/redo do not restore the layers that were targeted.
labels.root_cause: History did not record the targeted layers for each state, and some commands used the wrong labels or were recorded as several steps.

labels.symptom: Shortcuts pressed in quick succession are dropped, Shift+Delete cuts instead of filling on Windows, and colour picker popups jump while dragging.
labels.root_cause: Dispatch ran only the first matching shortcut per frame, egui-winit turns Shift+Delete into a Cut event, and the colour popup was re-placed every frame.

labels.symptom: Documents with deeply nested layer groups save but cannot be reopened, and some image import/export edge cases produce wrong results.
labels.root_cause: serde_json's 128 recursion limit rejected deep manifests on load; PSD headers with zero size were accepted; formats without ICC were not tagged sRGB.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking the canvas with the Pen tool does not show the full context menu Photoshop shows.
On Linux desktops with a global menu bar, the app's menus do not appear in it.
labels.root_cause: The app does not implement the com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar / dbusmenu protocol.

labels.symptom: The layers panel lists every possible layer effect, including ones that were never set up.
labels.root_cause: Effect placeholders marked present: false in PSD descriptors were not filtered out.

labels.symptom: Image algorithms such as panorama stitching could crash on unexpected input.
labels.root_cause: The algorithm crate used expect and unreachable on assumed invariants.

labels.symptom: Preferences changed in one browser tab or window are overwritten by another, failed preference saves are silently lost, and a failed web download leaves an endless loading screen.
labels.root_cause: Preference saves wrote the whole in-memory set without merging with storage and marked the revision saved even when the write failed; the web page had no fallback when the wasm never loaded.

labels.symptom: Opening a truncated or multi-frame image gives no warning that data is missing or was dropped.
labels.root_cause: Codecs had no way to pass decode warnings up to the import layer.

labels.symptom: The UI layer could crash on unexpected states such as a missing icon or malformed panel data.
labels.root_cause: UI crate code used unwrap/expect on states assumed to be impossible.

labels.symptom: FreeBSD CI often crashes with SIGSEGV in GPU integration tests.
labels.root_cause: The VM's software Vulkan driver crashes when several threads create GPU devices at once.

labels.symptom: Version bump to 0.3.0.
If a command or file import/export fails internally, the app closes and unsaved work is lost.
labels.root_cause: Nothing caught panics that escaped from commands or file services.

labels.symptom: Korean is not offered as a UI language, and changing the language needs a restart.
The window size and panel widths reset to defaults every time the app restarts.
labels.root_cause: eframe native persistence was not enabled, so UI state was never saved.

labels.symptom: Panicking shortcuts could be added to a crate without the linter stopping them.
labels.root_cause: The crate did not deny the panicking clippy lints.

labels.symptom: On a Mac with two displays, images look oversaturated on the external monitor when the monitor profile is set to auto.
labels.root_cause: The ICC profile was read for the main menu-bar screen from a windowless helper, not for the display the window is on.

labels.symptom: The CI format check fails on main.
labels.root_cause: A file was merged without running cargo fmt.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking a text layer's thumbnail opens Layer Style instead of editing its text.
The Smart Object right-click menu has no Edit Contents entry.
Some adjustment layers are dropped when saving and are ignored when opening layered files.
labels.root_cause: The vibA, blnc, blwh, phfl and mixr blocks were not read or written.

labels.symptom: Some generated labels, gallery names and secondary controls stay in English when the UI language is Korean.
labels.root_cause: Dynamically generated UI strings bypassed the translation lookup.

labels.symptom: Apply Image with Multiply onto a transparent layer fills it with opaque black.
labels.root_cause: Blending used the zero colour stored in transparent pixels and then forced the alpha to opaque.

labels.symptom: A filter progress test fails now and then because progress seems to go backwards.
labels.root_cause: Parallel tile workers report progress out of order, and the test assumed ordered delivery.

labels.symptom: Any local program can connect to the automation control port and run commands without logging in.
labels.root_cause: The control server did not authenticate clients and placed no limits on request size, batch length or number of connections.

labels.symptom: The UI scale setting offers only Auto, 100% and 200%, with no steps in between.
Changing the UI font size preference has no effect on interface text.
labels.root_cause: The font size preference was stored but never applied to the registered font faces.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland the AppImage shows the generic Wayland icon instead of the app icon.
labels.root_cause: An AppImage installs no host .desktop file for the compositor to match the window's app_id against, and winit has no Wayland window-icon support.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+'+' scales the whole interface instead of zooming the canvas, Ctrl hotkeys fire the wrong commands, keyboard copy/paste does nothing, clicking outside a dialog silently cancels it, and menus don't switch on hover.
labels.root_cause: egui's keyboard UI zoom was left on, shortcut matching ignored extra modifiers, egui-winit turned clipboard keys into events, and dialogs were modals with a click-to-cancel backdrop.

labels.symptom: The app can't be built or installed through Nix, and one test fails on NixOS.
Agents and the command line cannot record or play back actions.
labels.root_cause: Action recording and playback lived only in UI state, and authorization did not check commands nested inside a playback.

labels.symptom: Automation agents cannot turn a point into a text position or move the caret by word or line.
labels.root_cause: No control commands for text hit-testing or caret geometry existed.

labels.symptom: Box Blur at large radii takes seconds to apply.
labels.root_cause: Box Blur ran a direct 2r+1 tap kernel instead of running-sum box passes.

labels.symptom: An automation request with extreme coordinates crashes the app or silently wraps to a different position.
labels.root_cause: Coordinates were cast with 'as i32' and an empty render result was indexed without a bounds check.

labels.symptom: On macOS, double-clicking a file in Finder, using Open With or dropping it on the Dock icon does nothing.
labels.root_cause: winit ignores the kAEOpenDocuments Apple event, and the app only read file paths from the command line.

labels.symptom: The Minimum/Maximum filter is very slow at large radii.
labels.root_cause: The square mode scanned the whole window for each pixel instead of using a running extreme.

labels.symptom: Surface Blur takes over a minute at large radii.
labels.root_cause: The filter summed every sample in the full window for each pixel.

labels.symptom: The Windows CI test job fails because a test runs Unix-only binaries.
labels.root_cause: The monitor_profile test used /bin/sleep and /bin/sh without a cfg(unix) gate.

labels.symptom: README shows a stray 'ArtCraft' line before Star history.
While you drag the brush or eraser, it draws a hard flat line, and the soft stroke appears only when you release.
labels.root_cause: The canvas drew a temporary polyline preview instead of rendering the real stroke as it was drawn.

labels.symptom: Pressing Enter on a command palette entry that opens a dialog seems to do nothing, because the dialog closes right away.
labels.root_cause: The palette did not consume the Enter key, so the new dialog's OK footer read the same key press in the same frame.

labels.symptom: Deep OpenEXR files fail to open with a 'deep data not supported' error.
labels.root_cause: The exr crate rejects deep headers.

labels.symptom: A forced line break in imported text shows up as a missing-glyph box and the line no longer wraps.
labels.root_cause: The layout passed the U+0003 line-break character to the line breaker as an ordinary character instead of a newline.

labels.symptom: JPEG export fails with 'App segment exceeds maximum allowed data length' when the document carries large XMP metadata.
labels.root_cause: The JPEG encoder wrote the full XMP packet into one APP1 segment, which is limited to 65,533 bytes.
bug_markers: App segment exceeds maximum allowed data length

labels.symptom: After resizing an image, the outermost rows and columns of a full-canvas layer become translucent.
labels.root_cause: Resampling filter taps past the canvas edge read transparent default pixels instead of repeating the edge sample.

labels.symptom: Camera raw files fail to open with an unsupported-format error.
Undoing a text edit that also renamed the layer once reverts only the rename.
labels.root_cause: The rename and the text edit were recorded as two separate history transactions.

labels.symptom: Shift-click is ignored because modifier keys are not seen on some input sources.
labels.root_cause: Modifier state was read from separate ModifiersChanged events instead of from the pointer click event.

labels.symptom: Selecting several files in the Open dialog opens only one document.
labels.root_cause: File Open used a single-file native picker instead of a multi-file picker.

labels.symptom: Radial blur on large images looks banded because the samples are too far apart.
labels.root_cause: The number of sample intervals was capped at 64 regardless of path length.

labels.symptom: Documents that aren't sRGB show wrong colours on the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The canvas had no conversion from the document profile to the monitor profile.

labels.symptom: The arbitrary rotation dialog ignores the ruler tool's measured angle.
On first launch the interface may come up in a different language than the desktop.
labels.root_cause: Windows language detection read the regional format setting rather than the UI language, and macOS ran the defaults subprocess.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in German.
The Color panel's color chips ignore clicks, so a specific RGB or hex value can't be entered from the panel.
labels.root_cause: The chips were drawn without click handling.

labels.symptom: Users cannot Alt-click a layer's eye to show only that layer.
Users cannot drag down the layer visibility eye column to show or hide several layers at once.
On macOS, dragging from a menu title moves the window and menus blink because they open on release.
labels.root_cause: AppKit allowed dragging anywhere in the transparent title bar, and egui menu_button toggles on release.

labels.symptom: There is no way to add third-party filter plug-ins.
Skew, Distort and Perspective transform modes do not behave as separate modes.
Layered TIFF files open flattened and lose their layers on save.
labels.root_cause: Photoshop's private TIFF tags 37724 and 34377 were not read or written, including the byte-swapped form used in little-endian TIFFs.

labels.symptom: Image adjustments such as Curves do nothing, show no live preview, and Curves points can't be deleted.
labels.root_cause: Menus only routed adjustment kinds that had slider tables, and the engine ignored their params.

labels.symptom: Dragging a selection cannot move its outline or float the selected pixels.
The scorecard still lists atomic saves as missing even though they are done.
Vivid Light and Hard Mix blending give wrong results at extreme values when painting.
labels.root_cause: The generic blend functions used the PDF formulas instead of the Photoshop variants for Vivid Light and Hard Mix.

labels.symptom: Image Rotation rotates only the selected layer instead of the whole image, and the Magic Eraser and Background Eraser tools are missing.
labels.root_cause: Canvas rotation and flip were applied per layer rather than to the whole document.

labels.symptom: No Brazilian Portuguese UI language, and the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog shows menu paths in English.
labels.root_cause: shortcuts_body did not translate menu paths or command labels.

labels.symptom: Documents larger than 8192 pixels fall back to slow CPU rendering and use huge amounts of memory.
labels.root_cause: egui-wgpu requests a maximum texture size of 8192 by default instead of the adapter's own limits.

labels.symptom: Holding Alt during a freehand lasso does not let you add straight segments.
Automation clients can read and write files anywhere on disk through the control server.
labels.root_cause: Automation file paths were not restricted to granted read and write root directories.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland with an input method running, one key press in a text field repeats endlessly.
labels.root_cause: Calling request_focus every frame makes egui interrupt the IME, toggling text-input enable/disable every frame so key releases get lost.

labels.symptom: On macOS, exporting to a format gives the file a doubled extension such as .webp.psd.
labels.root_cause: The save dialog's filter list had no entry for the format, so the default filter's extension was appended.

labels.symptom: Loading a LUT file that declares a huge size crashes the app instead of showing an error.
labels.root_cause: Unchecked arithmetic on sizes taken from .cube and .look files overflowed.

labels.symptom: Typing arithmetic such as 1280*2 into a number field is ignored.
labels.root_cause: Numeric fields parsed only plain numbers.

labels.symptom: Dragging a Hue/Saturation range handle crashes the app when the range bounds are out of order.
labels.root_cause: f32::clamp panics because non-canonical range bounds make the lower limit greater than the upper limit.

labels.symptom: Migrated presets disappear after a restart.
labels.root_cause: Migration bumped only the preset revision and not the preferences revision, so the change was never saved.

labels.symptom: Setting a dialog field to a value of the wrong type through automation crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Dialog code indexes into a JSON value from ui.dialog.set without checking that it is an object.

labels.symptom: Adds optional generative AI image tools that use an OpenAI key the user supplies.
Picking another tool during Free Transform leaves the transform box active, and clicks keep going to it.
labels.root_cause: Switching tools did not apply or end the transform session.

labels.symptom: Exported web images carry the document's whole metadata packet, including layer text, adding tens of KB per file.
labels.root_cause: The embed-metadata option defaulted to true for flat exports.

labels.symptom: The Remove Background quick action does nothing.
labels.root_cause: No engine command was wired to the quick action.

labels.symptom: There is no filter for changing the direction of lighting in an existing photo.
Files dropped on the window always open at the end of the tabs, wherever they are dropped.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 file drops carry no pointer position.

labels.symptom: Photoshop .abr brushes and .grd gradients can't be imported, and stylus pressure and tilt are ignored.
labels.root_cause: There was no ABR/GRD importer, and pen pressure and tilt were hard-coded to 1.0 on the canvas.

labels.symptom: Opening a malformed pattern or brush file crashes the app or uses huge amounts of memory.
labels.root_cause: The pattern parser used unchecked i32 arithmetic and allocated memory from the declared rectangle, not the actual data.

labels.symptom: A brush size change made through automation is not recorded in history or action recordings.
labels.root_cause: The control server's ui.set wrote the brush size directly instead of sending the journaled tools.setBrush command.

labels.symptom: Opening a malformed DNG crashes or shows the wrong crop.
labels.root_cause: DefaultCropOrigin is added to the ActiveArea origin without overflow checks or bounds validation.

labels.symptom: WhiteIsZero TIFFs open with black and white swapped, and BigTIFFs with a rotation tag open sideways.
labels.root_cause: Gray samples were inverted a second time after the decoder had already normalised them, and the orientation parser only understood classic TIFF headers, not BigTIFF.

labels.symptom: A vector path with huge coordinates crashes the app or draws nothing.
labels.root_cause: The pixel-bounds helper adds one to an i32-truncated bound without saturating, so it overflows.

labels.symptom: A document with very large stored text run lengths or IDs crashes or corrupts styles when edited.
labels.root_cause: Unchecked integer addition on run lengths and IDs read from the document.

labels.symptom: Text with a huge size or tracking crashes the app or disappears.
labels.root_cause: Float glyph bounds were truncated to i32 and then incremented without overflow checks.

labels.symptom: A paint stroke with a huge brush size or a large time gap hangs or crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Brush size and airbrush catch-up dab count had no upper bound.

labels.symptom: Saving reports success but the document then fails to open because a damaged stored object was reused.
labels.root_cause: The directory save checked whether an object existed by file name only, without validating its content hash.

labels.symptom: Automation preview or screenshot requests fail with a PNG size error even when a small max_side is requested.
labels.root_cause: The PNG byte budget was checked before the max_side downscale was applied.

labels.symptom: A text edit with a reversed character range crashes or stores a huge run length.
labels.root_cause: Integer underflow when the range end comes before its start.

labels.symptom: Find and replace text crashes when only the active layer is searched and it is not a text layer.
labels.root_cause: The search loop indexed into an empty layer list.

labels.symptom: An automation client can read files and load modules anywhere on disk through commands and preferences that take file paths.
labels.root_cause: The automation file policy did not cover every engine command and preference key that resolves a host path.

labels.symptom: Select Linked Layers also keeps an unrelated active layer selected.
labels.root_cause: set_selection force-added the old active layer even when it was not linked.

labels.symptom: Docs refer to the renamed sibling app PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
labels.root_cause: Sibling app was renamed and docs were not updated.

labels.symptom: Creating a slice with a very large coordinate gives an internal error.
labels.root_cause: Rectangle corners were added in i32 without overflow checks.

labels.symptom: Spot healing with Sample All Layers on an empty layer has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The options bar never sent the flag and the command ignored it.

labels.symptom: Applying Stack Mode to a smart object whose source has no visible layers crashes with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: An empty frame list produced an empty pixel buffer with non-empty bounds, which tripped an assertion in write_region.

labels.symptom: An out-of-range dialog field value sent through automation crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Dialog state set through ui.dialog.set is stored as-is and then used as an index with no bounds check.

labels.symptom: Dragging a Warp point after the mesh changes mid-drag crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: A drag kept its point index from the old mesh after the mesh was replaced.

labels.symptom: An invalid --control port is silently ignored and the app starts without a control server.
labels.root_cause: The port was parsed with .parse().ok(), which turns errors into None.

labels.symptom: Contributor docs link to a private rules repository that returns 404 for outside contributors.
labels.root_cause: Docs reference the private craftrules repo as if public.

labels.symptom: The Camera Raw filter preview only fits the image to the view and cannot zoom or pan.
Very large PSB files open with no layers or with opaque black layers.
labels.root_cause: Decompression was capped at 2 GiB per decode.

labels.symptom: Small blur, sharpen or noise radius settings do nothing at all.
labels.root_cause: The box-blur radii worked out to zero for sigma below about 0.577, so the blur returned its input unchanged.

labels.symptom: The Type tool can only create horizontal text.
Layer Style dialog collapses multiple strokes or shadows into one and lacks preview, contour and default controls.
labels.root_cause: The dialog state stored one flat entry per effect kind.

labels.symptom: Auto-Align Layers always fails with "reference 0 is not a selected pixel layer".
labels.root_cause: The generic dialog showed the optional layer-id parameter as a number field defaulting to 0 and always sent it back.

labels.symptom: Opening a file with very deeply nested layer groups crashes the app with a stack overflow.
labels.root_cause: Recursive tree walks had no limit on nesting depth at import.

labels.symptom: Creating a guide layout with a huge number of columns or rows hangs the app.
labels.root_cause: The column and row counts had no upper limit, and each guide added did a duplicate scan, so the work grew with the square of the count.

labels.symptom: The CI format check fails on main.
labels.root_cause: Two merged entries together pushed a line over the rustfmt width limit.

labels.symptom: Giving two commands the same shortcut in one bulk change leaves both of them unbound and reports no conflict.
labels.root_cause: For each entry, the conflict pass checked the already-updated bindings and removed the shortcut from the other command set in the same call.

labels.symptom: Top-level menu bar items sit too close together and look crowded.
labels.root_cause: egui's menu-bar setup reduces horizontal item spacing, and the padding was not restored afterwards.

labels.symptom: The Color Range menu item runs at once with the foreground colour instead of opening a dialog with presets and eyedroppers.
CI runs on main are cancelled by each new merge, so main is never fully checked.
labels.root_cause: The workflow's concurrency setting cancelled in-progress runs on every branch, main included.

labels.symptom: The HDR Toning gamma slider works in the opposite direction to its documented behaviour.
labels.root_cause: The gamma value was used directly as the power-curve exponent instead of its reciprocal.

labels.symptom: Very large coordinates passed to commands silently move, select or crop the wrong area instead of returning an error.
labels.root_cause: 64-bit integer parameters were narrowed with `as i32`, which wraps instead of rejecting out-of-range values.

labels.symptom: The CI format check fails on main.
labels.root_cause: A merged file was not formatted with rustfmt.

labels.symptom: Colored Pencil and Neon Glow ignore the foreground and background colours.
labels.root_cause: uses_colours() was derived from the filters' parameter notation, which does not list the colours these two filters read.

labels.symptom: Template files are missing from the Open dialog and open under their own name, so a save can overwrite the template.
Commands given rectangles with extreme coordinates crash debug builds with an overflow panic.
labels.root_cause: Rect width and height used unchecked i32 subtraction.

labels.symptom: Cloning from a huge source coordinate with a rotated source crashes with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: Float coordinates cast to i32 saturate, and adding the apron then overflows.

labels.symptom: Undo and redo of small edits are slow on large documents.
labels.root_cause: Undo and redo cleared the damage area, so the whole canvas was recomposited.

labels.symptom: Two filter options show without Korean labels, so a CI test fails on main.
labels.root_cause: Two PRs merged separately added new filter options and a test that every option has a Korean label, so main broke once both landed.

labels.symptom: There is no modifier-click shortcut on the canvas to select the topmost layer under the pointer.
The Content-Aware Move tool is missing.
There is no way to search the Help menu for a command by name.
On Windows with DX12, the app crashes at startup or when opening a file if another program's dxcompiler.dll is on PATH.
labels.root_cause: wgpu's default Auto DX12 shader compiler setting loads dxcompiler.dll by name through the DLL search path, which can reach the current directory and PATH.

labels.symptom: In the New Document dialog, changing Resolution while a physical unit is shown changes the physical page size instead of the pixel count.
labels.root_cause: Changing Resolution updated only the resolution and did not rescale the pixel width and height.

labels.symptom: The formatting check fails on main.
labels.root_cause: Unformatted code was merged.

labels.symptom: User-created and imported brush presets are lost when the app restarts.
labels.root_cause: Brush presets were kept only in memory and never saved to disk.

labels.symptom: An automation call that sets several UI fields reports failure but still applies some of them, or silently ignores bad values.
labels.root_cause: The ui.set handler applied each field as it validated it, and it did not type-check nested or scalar values.

labels.symptom: A saved file damaged in place without changing its size or timestamp is trusted by later saves and never repaired.
labels.root_cause: The save cache trusted a file signature made only of length and modification time.

labels.symptom: The formatting check fails on main after two separately formatted changes are merged together.
labels.root_cause: Each branch was formatted on its own, the combined result was not, and main's CI run was cancelled by the next merge so nobody saw it fail.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking just above or below a layer name opens a different dialog instead of renaming the layer.
labels.root_cause: The name's hit area was only as tall as the text, not the full row.

labels.symptom: Remove Background deletes pixels instead of adding a mask, and dragging down the visibility eyes creates one undo step per row.
Scripted and command-line TIFF saves unexpectedly come out layered.
labels.root_cause: The default export options turned on TIFF layers for every save, including headless ones.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, dialog buttons appear in macOS order and the unsaved-changes prompt uses Don't Save / Cancel / Save instead of Yes / No / Cancel.
labels.root_cause: Every modal laid out its buttons in macOS order on all platforms.

labels.symptom: Some large, detailed PNG exports are corrupt and other programs can't open them.
labels.root_cause: The parallel deflate stopped a band's sync flush too early, because miniz_oxide can return with output space left before it has compressed its pending lookahead bytes.

labels.symptom: The brush size and hardness bracket keys cannot be remapped in Keyboard Shortcuts.
labels.root_cause: The bracket keys were hard-coded in the shell's key handler instead of being commands in the shortcut table.

labels.symptom: There's no way to convert a smart object back into layers.
Some camera raw files will not open, or open only as a preview.
Right-clicking the canvas with a selection tool shows only a few menu items.
labels.root_cause: The selection context menu included only five Select-menu rows.

labels.symptom: The close × on document tabs is drawn before the title on Windows and Linux instead of after it.
labels.root_cause: The tab layout put the close button on the left on every platform.

labels.symptom: In Brazilian Portuguese, different menu commands show the same label.
labels.root_cause: Duplicate translations in the pt-BR catalog.

labels.symptom: The i18n catalog consistency test fails because of duplicate Korean rows.
labels.root_cause: Two PRs each added the same Korean labels, so the catalog listed them twice.

labels.symptom: Unknown layer data in little-endian layered TIFF files is lost when the file is saved.
labels.root_cause: Unknown blocks in a foreign byte order were dropped instead of being kept verbatim.

labels.symptom: On large images, a filter preview affects the whole layer instead of only the selection.
labels.root_cause: The preview proxy was built without the selection.

labels.symptom: Pressing on a menu title, dragging into a submenu item and releasing should run that item.
Pressing Invert with a layer mask selected inverts the layer instead of the mask.
labels.root_cause: Menu commands ignored the mask edit target.

labels.symptom: A raw noise-reduction filter hangs when given a huge noise amount.
labels.root_cause: The noise parameters were not clamped, so a huge value made the blur radius unbounded.

labels.symptom: Non-sRGB and high-bit-depth images show the wrong colours or clipped highlights on the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The canvas used an 8-bit texture and no colour management, so wide-gamut and float values were shown raw or clipped.

labels.symptom: Path Blur fails with an internal error when a path's speed is very large.
labels.root_cause: Per-path speeds were not clamped, so the halo radius overflowed.

labels.symptom: Copy refuses to work on smart object, type or shape layers and says the layer has no pixels.
labels.root_cause: The Copy command's enabled check accepted only pixel layers.
bug_markers: the active layer has no pixels

labels.symptom: The format check fails on main.
labels.root_cause: A test file was merged without being run through rustfmt.

labels.symptom: Menu rows are spaced too far apart, so long menus run past the window, and submenus can open under the Windows taskbar.
labels.root_cause: Menu rows inherited the dialogs' 6 pt vertical item spacing, giving a 30 pt row pitch instead of about 24 pt.

labels.symptom: In exported PSDs, artboards are linked to the wrong guides.
labels.root_cause: Guide indices were numbered horizontal-first, but the guide resource is written vertical-first.

labels.symptom: Opening a large layered PSD is slow because the unused merged composite is decoded anyway.
labels.root_cause: The PSD importer always decoded the merged composite, even when nothing used it.

labels.symptom: Locking a layer group does not lock the layers inside it.
labels.root_cause: Lock checks used only the layer's own locks and ignored the locks of its parent groups.

labels.symptom: A warp command with an enormous rectangle fails with an internal error instead of a clear parameter error.
labels.root_cause: The warp target size was not limited.

labels.symptom: Image adjustment dialogs update their live preview slowly, about 285 ms per change.
