labels.root_cause: The preview re-ran the real command on the CPU for every change.

labels.symptom: Imported Photo Filter and gradient glow effects render with different colours than in Photoshop.
labels.root_cause: Photo Filter was computed in encoded RGB instead of XYZ, and glow gradients were laid across the canvas instead of following glow strength.

labels.symptom: Dragging a layer onto another document's tab does nothing.
labels.root_cause: There was no command to copy layers between documents.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Italian.
GPU UI tests pass by reporting 'no GPU adapter' even when a setup command fails.
labels.root_cause: catch_unwind wrapped the setup commands as well as the harness build.

labels.symptom: Tests fail on NixOS because /bin/sleep does not exist.
labels.root_cause: The test hardcoded /bin/sleep.

labels.symptom: There is no Android build of the app.
On Android tablets, a palm resting on the screen while drawing with a pen produces unwanted strokes.
labels.root_cause: winit discards pen and finger identity, so touches can't be rejected while the pen is in use.

labels.symptom: On Android the system bars stay visible and the app cannot go fullscreen.
labels.root_cause: The winit Android fullscreen flag does nothing.

labels.symptom: Large BigTIFF and multi-page TIFF files don't open fully or open slowly.
labels.root_cause: Only the first IFD was read, and decoding went through an extra full-size buffer.

labels.symptom: A brush stroke trails the pointer and a line segment pops in on release, and right-click paints like left-click.
labels.root_cause: Brush smoothing was hard-coded at 0.3, ignoring the options bar, and the secondary button was not handled separately.

labels.symptom: Resizing a large image to a tiny size uses gigabytes of memory.
labels.root_cause: The resample read window grows as 1/scale and was allocated in one piece.

labels.symptom: An automation session can run a denied command by calling an allowed command that runs it internally.
labels.root_cause: Only the top-level command was authorized; commands it ran internally were not checked.

labels.symptom: There is no Magnetic Lasso tool.
Paths from the pen or shape tools can't have their anchors or handles adjusted after they are drawn.
labels.root_cause: There was no Direct Selection tool and the Pen tool ignored the Ctrl and Alt modifiers.

labels.symptom: Gaussian or Box Blur with a large radius is very slow, including its live preview.
labels.root_cause: Each output tile was blurred with a materialised 3-sigma halo that was copied and transposed, so the work grew with the radius.

labels.symptom: Documents or automation commands with extreme numeric values crash the app or corrupt layers.
labels.root_cause: Unchecked integer arithmetic on untrusted numbers overflows, panicking in debug and wrapping in release.

labels.symptom: Dragging a shape tool shows only a 1 px box until the mouse is released.
labels.root_cause: The drag preview drew a placeholder box instead of the shape path that the commit creates.

labels.symptom: Over automation, applying a data set is always refused, even when it only sets text or visibility.
labels.root_cause: The command was on a hard-coded deny list for ambient filesystem paths.

labels.symptom: Painting and move tools still change a hidden active layer.
labels.root_cause: Tool commands did not check whether the target layer was visible.

labels.symptom: The Curves dialog has no black, gray or white point eyedroppers.
A dialog value set through automation can crash the app on the next edit.
labels.root_cause: The dialog wrote into nested JSON entries without checking they were objects, and automation could store any value there.

labels.symptom: The layered TIFF round-trip corpus test fails on every file.
labels.root_cause: The test still used default export options after the default changed to a flat TIFF.

labels.symptom: On Windows, automation tests fail with os error 32 when they delete the test folder.
labels.root_cause: The tests deleted the folder before the server task had dropped its open directory handles.

labels.symptom: On a first Windows launch, a warning says a settings file was skipped because the path cannot be found.
labels.root_cause: Missing-file detection matched error message text, which missed Windows os error 3 for a folder that doesn't exist.

labels.symptom: WebP export is lossless only, so photos come out very large.
CI never tested the deep OpenEXR decoder against real files.
labels.root_cause: The test images were copied in by hand and the test skipped when they were missing.

labels.symptom: Moving the drop shadow angle slider does not change the shadow direction.
labels.root_cause: Effects that use Global Light kept separate angles, so a later effect overrode the edited one.

labels.symptom: The font menu shows plain names with no preview and doesn't list recently used fonts first.
Opening a small malformed PSD file crashes the app with a huge memory allocation.
labels.root_cause: The layer pixel buffer was sized from the layer rectangle before any channel data was decoded.

labels.symptom: The swatches panel is a fixed grid and cannot import or export swatch files.
Holding Alt with the lasso subtracts even with no selection, and releasing Alt leaves the outline open.
labels.root_cause: The lasso's Alt state machine always latched subtract and did not close the outline when Alt was released.

labels.symptom: On Windows the command-line executable shows a generic icon and has no version information.
labels.root_cause: The CLI crate had no build script embedding the icon and VERSIONINFO resource.

labels.symptom: The New Document dialog does not offer the clipboard image's size.
On Intel integrated GPUs with DX12, zoomed-out canvas previews show checkerboard holes.
labels.root_cause: Mip generation sampled one mip while rendering into another mip of the same texture, which some drivers mishandle.

labels.symptom: Dragging a large layer with effects using the Move tool is sluggish.
labels.root_cause: Clipping the effect region to the canvas changed its size every frame, which forced a full rebuild of the effect maps.

labels.symptom: On macOS the menus are drawn inside the window instead of in the system menu bar, so VoiceOver, Help search and App Shortcuts cannot use them.
labels.root_cause: The app drew egui in-window menus and left winit's default menu bar.

labels.symptom: The Relight filter leaves seams between tiles and does nothing on images larger than 8 MP.
labels.root_cause: A fixed 97 px halo was smaller than the blur reach, and the kernel returned the input unchanged above 8 MP.

labels.symptom: Holding Cmd with a selection tool did not move or copy pixels the way the Move tool does.
Duplicating a duplicate layer gives names like 'copy copy' instead of numbered copies.
labels.root_cause: The ' copy' suffix was appended without stripping an existing copy suffix.

labels.symptom: The About window doesn't credit contributors or models.
Creating a huge new document hangs or runs out of memory.
labels.root_cause: fill_rect wrote every tile eagerly instead of sharing one copy-on-write tile.

labels.symptom: Median and Dust & Scratches filters get very slow at large radii.
labels.root_cause: Each pixel selected the median over the whole disc, so the cost grew with the square of the radius.

labels.symptom: Motion Blur takes seconds to minutes on large layers.
labels.root_cause: Each pixel took many edge-checked bilinear samples instead of a merged kernel.

labels.symptom: Advanced blending options such as knockout and blend-as-group are missing or not kept in files.
A foreground-to-transparent gradient paints fully opaque.
labels.root_cause: Canvas drags passed explicit opaque colors overriding the gradient preset.

labels.symptom: An outside stroke on a layer with fill below 100% fills the inside with the stroke colour instead of leaving it clear.
labels.root_cause: The outside stroke was painted at full coverage under the whole interior of pixel layers.

labels.symptom: There is no Pattern Stamp tool for painting a pattern with a brush.
The packaging lint CI job fails because actionlint rejects the macos-release runner label.
labels.root_cause: actionlint.yaml did not declare the org's custom macos-release larger-runner label.

labels.symptom: A rejected slice command still changes the document, and dividing a slice takes two undos.
labels.root_cause: The auto slice was promoted in its own history step before the command was validated.

labels.symptom: Exporting for web overwrites slices that share a name and leaves overlapping slices out of the HTML.
labels.root_cause: Output names weren't made unique, and the HTML table resolved overlaps by list order instead of stacking order.

labels.symptom: Automation clients can request huge previews or replies that use up memory.
labels.root_cause: The control server put no size limits on previews, replies or batch results.

labels.symptom: An automation command with an out-of-range numeric id changes or deletes a different, existing item.
labels.root_cause: Ids were narrowed with `as u32`, which wraps instead of rejecting.

labels.symptom: The Angled Strokes filter smears the image, and the Rough Pastels filter looks like noise.
labels.root_cause: The filters were built from box blurs and an even texture relief instead of discrete strokes.

labels.symptom: On Windows the crosshair pointer disappears over grey parts of the canvas, so you can't see where you are clicking.
labels.root_cause: The Windows system crosshair (IDC_CROSS) inverts the pixels under it, so it turns invisible over mid-grey.

labels.symptom: The Linux CI test job fails with 'No space left on device' in the craft-fonts test step.
labels.root_cause: A different package and feature selection made cargo rebuild the whole dependency graph into the same target directory.

labels.symptom: Dragging layers onto the Layers panel's footer buttons doesn't duplicate, group or delete them.
The brush cursor lags behind the mouse while hovering over the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The brush cursor was drawn as part of the canvas frame instead of as a native OS cursor.

labels.symptom: After you set a clone source, a crosshair marker stays on the canvas until the next stroke.
labels.root_cause: The source marker was drawn whenever a source was set, not only while painting.

labels.symptom: Ctrl/Cmd+Z does nothing in a dialog while one of its sliders has keyboard focus.
labels.root_cause: The global shortcut dispatcher returned early when egui wanted keyboard input, before the dialog's local shortcuts could run.

labels.symptom: The Crop tool shows no frame until you draw one.
Tall menus overlap the menu bar and switch the open menu on hover, or run past the bottom of the window.
labels.root_cause: Hover-switch logic ignored which layer was under the pointer, and menu height was never limited to the window.

labels.symptom: Pressing Ctrl+T while typing text starts Free Transform instead of toggling the Character panel.
labels.root_cause: While editing text, the shortcut fell through to the menu shortcuts.

labels.symptom: Pressing Shift or Alt partway through a shape drag doesn't constrain it.
labels.root_cause: The modifiers were read only when the drag started.

labels.symptom: Copying a selection to a new layer on a large photo stalls for seconds.
labels.root_cause: The whole layer was converted to RGBA before the selection's area was read.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux the OS title bar is stacked above the app's own top bar, and long context menus don't scroll.
labels.root_cause: The window kept OS decorations instead of drawing a custom title bar with caption buttons.

labels.symptom: Transform control handles are drawn but can't be grabbed.
labels.root_cause: The handles were only drawn and were never connected to Free Transform.

labels.symptom: Dividing very wide slices is rejected or overflows.
labels.root_cause: Widths were narrowed to i32 and coordinates were multiplied in i32.

labels.symptom: Moving a layer-based slice near the coordinate limits overflows.
labels.root_cause: Non-saturating arithmetic on slice margins.
